essays.title: 公路与公共交通的投入
essays.prompt: Some people think more public money should be spent on roads and motorways than the public transport system. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有些人认为，政府在公路和高速公路上的支出应该多于公共交通支出。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 增加公交预算能帮谁解决哪一段通勤困难？
哪些道路工程值得花钱，这是否足以让道路整体优先？
essays.t: public spending on roads and public transport|道路与公共交通的财政投入
essays.s: public transport should usually receive more funding than roads in crowded cities|在人口稠密的城市，公共交通通常应获比道路更多的经费
a: an early direct bus can bring hospital staff to work before dawn|清晨直达公交能让医院员工在天亮前到岗
nurses on the existing route may lose more time waiting for a connection than riding the bus|乘现有线路的护士，等换乘的时间可能比坐车还长
a bus timed to arrive before handover removes the uncertain wait for a connection|一班能在交班前抵达的公交车让护士不用再等一趟时间难以把握的接驳车
more reliable journeys for nurses who do not drive|不开车的护士有了更可靠的通勤安排
fewer gaps in hospital rotas caused by unreliable transport|因交通不可靠而导致的医院排班缺口减少
widening the road alone would leave these nurses waiting at the same stop|单单拓宽道路，护士仍得在原来的站点等车
b: road repairs deserve priority where an essential connection is missing|如果必要通道缺失，修路值得优先考虑
residents of isolated villages|偏远村庄的居民
a road that remains passable after heavy rain|一条在暴雨过后仍可通行的路
reach a clinic or take produce to market|前往诊所或把农产品运到市场
repairing a rural bridge can restore the only route used by both buses and ambulances|修复乡村桥梁能恢复公交车和救护车共用的唯一通道
the value of road spending depends on the journey it makes possible|道路投资的价值取决于它让哪些原本走不通的行程变得可行
targeted repairs can be justified without giving motorways a larger budget everywhere|有针对性的维修有其理由，无须因此让各地高速公路都获得更多预算
z: cities should normally give public transport the larger share of new funding, with road investment targeted at specific barriers to access|城市通常应把较多新增资金投向公共交通，并把道路投资用在真正阻碍通行的地方
direct buses spare early-shift nurses a long wait|直达公交让上早班的护士免去漫长的换乘等候
repairing a rural bridge can reopen the only road to a clinic|修好一座乡村桥梁可能让通往诊所的唯一路径恢复通行
v: the larger share of new funding
新增经费中较大的一份
essays.transfer: 比较两笔预算时，让同一位通勤者分别面对两种投资，再比较哪一种消除了她遇到的障碍。
r: urban deliveries deserve priority|市内货运应当优先
extra buses cannot clear a freight bottleneck|加开公交不能疏通货运堵点
lorries block a junction while unloading|货车卸货时堵住了路口
a loading bay can ease this particular obstruction|专用装卸车位可以缓解这个具体堵点
cities reserve space for deliveries|城市预留装卸货空间
queues of delivery vehicles|送货车辆排队
giving public transport priority in crowded cities|在人口密集的城市优先投资公共交通
essays.stanceSummary: 人口密集地区应优先改善公交，缺少必要通道时再优先修路
essays.noun2: targeted road investment|有针对性的道路投资

essays.title: 高中美术必修课程
essays.prompt: Some people think painting and drawings are as important as other subjects, and they should be compulsory in high school education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为绘画和素描与其他学科同样重要，应当列为高中必修课。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 绘画能训练什么其他课堂较少练到的能力？
认可艺术的价值后，是否仍要所有高中生全程必修？
essays.t: painting and drawing in high school|高中阶段的绘画和素描教育
essays.s: drawing deserves a place alongside core subjects at first, but its value does not justify compulsory study throughout high school|高中初期，绘画值得与核心学科一同列入课表，但它的价值不足以证明高中全程都应必修
a: drawing teaches careful observation through close attention to shape|绘画通过引导学生关注形状来培养细致观察力
comparing a sketch with the object reveals small differences in shape|把草图与实物对照，能发现形状上的细微差异
a student drawing a leaf may notice a pattern in its veins that a written description missed|画一片叶子时，学生可能发现文字描述中遗漏的叶脉排列规律
more precise observations in subjects such as biology and design|在生物和设计等学科中开展更准确的观察
a habit of checking details before accepting a first impression|养成先核对细节再相信第一印象的习惯
introductory art can benefit students with very different interests|基础艺术课可以让兴趣迥异的学生受益
b: older pupils need room to pursue their own interests|较高年级的学生需要选择自己感兴趣的课程
students preparing for a music audition|正在准备音乐专业面试的学生
some choice over their weekly timetable|一定的每周课表选择权
reserve enough time for rehearsals as well as academic work|在完成学业之余为排练留出足够时间
a young musician may gain more from rehearsal than from another compulsory term of painting|年轻的音乐学习者可能从排练中获得比再上一学期必修绘画课更大的收获
recognising the value of one art form need not prevent students from specialising in another|认可一种艺术的价值，不必妨碍学生专长于另一种艺术
art should be available at an advanced level to those who want to continue|应为希望继续深造的学生提供进阶艺术课
z: drawing and painting merit a place in every pupil's early high-school education, with further study offered as an elective|高中初期，每名学生都值得有机会学习素描和绘画，之后则可将进阶学习列为选修
drawing a leaf teaches pupils to notice its finer details|画一片叶子能训练学生留意细节
a flexible timetable leaves older students enough time for music rehearsals|灵活的课表让高年级学生有足够时间排练音乐
v: 注意到其中更细微的特征
essays.transfer: 回应“同样重要”和“应当必修”这两个主张，可区分共同的入门体验和后续的专业化选课。
r: art should remain compulsory|美术应继续列为必修
beginners may underestimate their ability|初学者可能低估自己的能力
a first sketch goes badly|第一张素描画得不理想
teachers can show pupils their own progress|教师可以让学生看到自己的进步
pupils compare early and recent drawings before choosing electives|学生在选课前对比早期和近期的画作
premature decisions to drop art|过早放弃美术课的决定
a common introduction followed by elective study|人人接受入门教育后再自由选修
essays.stanceSummary: 人人都应尝试绘画，高中后期应允许按兴趣选修
essays.noun2: the freedom to specialise|选择专长方向的自由

essays.title: 社交媒体与新闻获取
essays.prompt: Many people use social media everyday to keep in touch with friends and get social news. Do you think the advantages of it outweigh the disadvantages?
a: neighbourhood groups help friends keep in touch and share local news|社区群聊让朋友保持联系，也便于分享本地消息
a group member can alert everyone to a closure at short notice|群成员可以在临时得知关停消息时迅速通知所有人
friends planning to meet can learn that the entrance to their local station has closed|约好见面的朋友可以及时得知当地车站的入口已关闭
a change of meeting place before anyone sets out|在任何人动身前变更会面地点
a dependable circle of neighbours who look out for one another|形成一个彼此照应、值得信赖的邻里圈子
the value lies in news reaching the particular people who can act on it|其价值在于消息能到达那些可以据此行动的特定人群
b: forwarding an alert is useful if readers can check its source|只要读者能够核查来源，转发提醒就很有用
readers seeing a screenshot in a friendship group|在朋友群里看到截图的读者
a date and a link to the original notice|日期和原始通知的链接
tell whether a reported closure is still in force|判断所说的关闭措施是否仍在生效
parents might forward last winter’s school closure even after classes have resumed|即使已经复课，家长仍可能转发去年冬天停课的通知
knowing the person who shared a post does not establish whether its contents are current|认识转发帖子的人，并不能证明帖子内容仍然有效
checking the original notice takes little time compared with a wasted journey|和白跑一趟相比，核实原始通知几乎不费时间
z: the everyday gains from staying connected outweigh the risk of misinformation when friends check consequential claims before acting|如果朋友们对会左右行动的重要消息先行核实，日常保持联系的好处就超过了错误信息带来的风险
friends can change a meeting place in minutes|朋友能在几分钟内改定见面地点
checking the original notice can spare them a wasted journey|核对原始通知还能避免大家白跑一趟
v: a link to the original notice
在很短的提前通知时间内
essays.q: 许多人每天使用社交媒体与朋友保持联系并获取社会新闻。你认为这样做的好处大于坏处吗？
ask: 和朋友联络、获得社区消息这两种用途怎样在生活里结合起来？
转发为何会让过时的消息继续流传，发现和核实消息应如何权衡？
essays.t: the daily use of social media for friendship and local news|每天通过社交媒体联系朋友和了解本地消息
essays.s: the benefits outweigh the risks when friends verify important updates|只要朋友们会核实重要消息，社交媒体的好处就大于风险
essays.transfer: 写社交媒体新闻题时，明确区分谁先传来消息、谁能确认真假；写友谊题时还要说明收到消息后朋友怎样互动。
r: constant alerts can weaken friendships|频繁提醒可能损害友谊
they interrupt conversations at the table|它们会打断桌边的交谈
several group chats light up during dinner|吃饭时多个群聊不断弹出提醒
people control which alerts interrupt them|使用者可以选择哪些提醒允许打扰自己
friends mute routine notifications during meals|朋友们用餐时关闭普通消息提醒
divided attention at meals|用餐时注意力分散
daily contact and access to local news online|在线保持日常联系并获取本地新闻
essays.stanceSummary: 社交媒体便于联系朋友、获取消息，重要信息需追溯原始来源
essays.noun2: checking the original source|核查原始来源

essays.title: 罪犯再次犯罪
essays.prompt: Many offenders commit more crimes after serving the first punishment. Why is this happening, and what measures can be taken to tackle this problem?
essays.q: 许多违法者在第一次受罚后再次犯罪。为什么会出现这种情况？可以采取哪些措施来应对？
ask: 为什么第一次受罚后，有些人仍难以恢复稳定生活？
怎样在惩罚结束后帮助他们建立收入来源和规律生活？
essays.t: repeat offending after an initial punishment|初次受罚之后再度犯罪
essays.s: a criminal record limits lawful earnings, so employment support can reduce the pressure to reoffend|犯罪记录限制合法谋生的机会，因此就业支持能减轻再次犯罪的压力
a: after punishment, a regular income can ease the pressure to reoffend|受罚后有了稳定收入，靠再次犯罪谋生的压力就可能减轻
rent falls due even when a criminal record discourages employers|即使犯罪记录让雇主有顾虑，房租依然到期要付
paid work lets someone cover the rent with earnings they can rely on|有薪工作使人可以用可靠的收入来付房租
short-term financial security|短期经济保障
a stable routine built around lawful work|以合法就业为基础的稳定生活规律
when a conviction leaves few ways to earn a lawful living, punishment alone will not remove the financial pressure|如果犯罪记录使合法谋生的途径所剩无几，单靠惩罚就无法消除经济压力
b: local services can help people move directly from a sentence into supported training or employment|地方服务机构可以帮助人们在刑罚结束后直接进入有支持的培训或就业项目
people trying to re-enter the workforce|试图重返职场的人
a credible reference and a real opportunity to demonstrate their skills|一位可信的推荐人和一个真正展示技能的机会
secure a first interview|获得初步面试机会
a supervised work placement in a gardening team gives someone paid experience and a reference based on attendance|园艺队提供的带指导实习，可以为参与者带来有薪经验和一份以到岗表现为依据的推荐
a supervisor can speak to the applicant’s reliability, something a list of previous convictions cannot show|主管可以说明求职者做事是否可靠，而一份犯罪记录无法提供这一信息
paid placements can bridge the gap between release and permanent employment|有薪实习可以填补获释和获得长期工作之间的空档
z: exclusion from work can outlast a sentence, so employment support should begin as soon as someone is released|刑罚结束后，就业排斥仍可能持续，因此一个人获释时就应开始得到就业支持
an old conviction can cost someone an interview|一条旧的犯罪记录可能让求职者失去面试机会
a supervisor's reference can give an employer a reason to reconsider|实习主管的推荐则能让雇主有理由重新考虑
essays.transfer: 同一论证可用于「社区服务与监禁」，但要说明哪种安排具体提供了指导、履历或重新融入社会的机会。
essays.stanceSummary: 受罚后仍难就业会增加再犯压力，带指导的工作机会有助重建生活
r: employment support can miss the hardest cases|就业支持可能触及不到处境最困难的人
employers need a reliable way to contact applicants|雇主需要可靠的方式联系求职者
an applicant lacks a fixed address|求职者没有固定地址
a caseworker can act as a contact point|个案工作者可以充当联络人
advisers arrange interviews through a local support centre|顾问通过当地服务中心安排面试
missed appointments|错过预约
supported entry into lawful work|帮助人们进入合法就业岗位
essays.noun2: a credible work reference|可信的工作推荐

essays.title: 野生动物保护的资源投入
essays.prompt: Some people argue that too much attention and too many resources are given to protecting wild animals and birds. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，用于保护野生动物和鸟类的关注和资源过多。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 哪些保护工作连同当地居民也一起受益？
哪些项目可能吸引过多关注，应该怎样分配有限经费？
essays.t: the resources devoted to protecting wild animals and birds|用于保护野生动物和鸟类的资源
essays.s: wildlife protection generally deserves its resources, although popular species sometimes receive more attention than urgently threatened habitats|保护野生动物总体上值得获得这些资源，不过有时受欢迎的物种比亟须保护的栖息地更受关注
a: protecting a habitat can benefit people who live alongside the animals|保护栖息地也能使生活在动物附近的人受益
a wetland used by migratory birds can hold rainwater that would otherwise rush downstream|候鸟停留的湿地能蓄住原本会快速流向下游的雨水
keeping the wetland intact gives nearby households some protection during heavy rain|保留完整湿地能让附近家庭在暴雨中得到一定保护
safer use of low-lying land around the village|让村庄附近的低洼土地得到更安全的利用
lasting public support for protecting the birds' feeding grounds|公众长期支持保护鸟类觅食地
judging this spending only by the number of birds saved misses a local benefit|只凭获救鸟类的数量判断这笔支出，会漏掉一项当地收益
b: limited funds are most useful when their allocation reflects ecological urgency rather than publicity|有限资金按生态威胁的紧迫程度而非宣传效果来分配时最有用
conservation teams allocating a limited budget|分配有限预算的自然保护团队
clear information about which habitats are under immediate threat|关于哪些栖息地正面临迫切威胁的明确信息
direct funds to the places where they can make the greatest difference|把资金投向最能产生实际效果的地方
a campaign featuring a popular mammal might attract donations while an unprotected nesting site disappears|为一种受欢迎的哺乳动物宣传可能吸引捐款，与此同时一处无人保护的筑巢地却在消失
an appealing campaign can attract donations out of proportion to its conservation value|有吸引力的活动可能募集到与其保护价值不相称的捐款
a misplaced campaign is a reason to redirect funds within conservation|宣传方向失当说明应该调整保护经费的内部去向
z: wildlife conservation as a whole is not overfunded merely because some highly publicised projects deserve less|一些大受关注的项目或许不值得那么多资源，但不能仅据此判断野生动物保护整体投入过多
preserving a wetland can shelter nearby homes from floods|保留湿地有助于保护附近住宅免受洪水侵袭
a threatened nesting site deserves attention even if its birds attract little publicity|即使当地栖息的鸟类鲜有人关注，受威胁的筑巢地也值得保护
v: 未得到保护的筑巢地点
essays.transfer: 遇到「是否投入过多」要说明某项投入怎样花得值，也可以指出应该重新分配的那部分。
r: wildlife projects divert money from urgent human needs|野生动物保护项目可能挤占满足紧急民生需求的经费
safe drinking water must come first|安全饮用水应当优先
a village’s only water pump breaks|村里唯一的水泵坏了
a survey can be postponed without abandoning a habitat|推迟调查并不等于放弃栖息地
officials fund emergency repairs before rescheduling the survey|官员先拨款紧急维修，再重新安排调查
delayed repairs to essential services|必要公共设施维修延误
continued investment in threatened habitats|继续投资保护受威胁的栖息地
essays.stanceSummary: 有明确需要的保护投入值得保留，追求宣传效果的项目可削减
essays.noun2: the urgency of a habitat threat|栖息地面临威胁的紧迫程度

essays.title: 大学入学竞争加剧
essays.prompt: Competition for university study is becoming increasingly strong. Why are universities becoming more competitive? Is this a positive or negative development?
essays.q: 大学入学竞争正在加剧。为什么上大学的竞争会越来越激烈？你认为这是积极还是消极的发展？
ask: 为什么申请人数会在部分大学和专业里比名额增长得更快？
竞争加剧如何影响条件不同的申请者，总体上是好是坏？
essays.t: growing competition for university places|大学入学名额竞争加剧
essays.s: as more employers require degrees, limited places attract more applicants, and the pressure is largely harmful when access to coaching differs|要求学历的雇主增多，更多人争夺有限名额；当考生获得辅导的机会不均时，这种压力总体有害
a: a degree helps school leavers get past the first stage of recruitment|大学学位有助于离校学生通过招聘的第一轮筛选
an entry-level office job may require a degree before it mentions specific skills|一份初级办公室工作可能先要求大学学历，然后才列出具体技能
graduates can apply for posts closed to applicants without a degree|毕业生可以申请没有大学学位的人无法申请的职位
a chance to gain a foothold in a chosen occupation|在所选职业中初步站稳脚跟的机会
better prospects for promotion|更好的晋升前景
these incentives increase applications faster than teaching capacity can grow|这些好处使申请人数的增长快于大学教学容量的增长
b: fierce competition can reward interview coaching more than academic promise|激烈竞争可能让面试辅导比学业潜力更能左右录取
applicants who support their families after school|放学后需要贴补家用的申请者
free evenings or money for additional preparation|空闲的夜晚或用于额外备考的资金
match the preparation available to better-off classmates|获得与经济宽裕的同学相当的备考机会
a student working evening shifts may have excellent subject knowledge but less time to rehearse an interview than a privately coached classmate|晚上需要打工的学生也许专业知识扎实，却没有接受私人辅导的同学那么多时间演练面试
when tiny differences decide admission, preparation resources can outweigh differences in academic potential|当细微差异决定录取时，备考资源的差距可能盖过学术潜力的差距
fiercer competition is largely negative when family resources increasingly shape the result|当家庭资源越来越能左右结果时，更激烈的竞争总体上是消极的
z: demand for degrees has outgrown university places, and fiercer selection can amplify differences in applicants' means|学位需求增长快于大学名额，更激烈的选拔可能放大申请者经济条件的差距
even junior office jobs can require a degree|连初级办公室岗位也可能要求学位
private coaching can give applicants an edge in university interviews|私人辅导可能让考生在大学招生面试中占优
essays.transfer: 这里讨论的是获得大学学习机会的竞争，不能把教师之间争科研经费当成主要例子。
essays.stanceSummary: 学历门槛推高申请量，竞争加剧使有钱额外备考者占优
r: strong competition motivates applicants|激烈竞争能激励申请人
demanding selection rewards careful preparation|严格选拔能让认真准备的人获得回报
universities publish free sample questions|大学公布免费的示例题目
schools can reward preparation without competing for scarce places|学校也能在学生不用争抢稀缺名额的情况下奖励他们认真准备
teachers give credit for practice interviews|教师把模拟面试的表现计入课程成绩
weaker incentives to prepare|准备动力减弱
fairer access to university places|更公平地获得大学名额
essays.noun2: unequal preparation time|准备时间的不均等

essays.title: 城市无车日政策
essays.prompt: Some cities have vehicle-free days when private cars, trucks, and motorcycles are banned from the city center. Public transportation like buses, taxis, and metros are advised. To what extent do you think the advantages of this policy outweigh the disadvantages?

fewer turning vehicles cross pedestrians’ paths, while buses and taxis can still bring passengers close to their destinations|转弯车辆与行人路线交会的次数减少，而公交和出租车仍可把乘客送到目的地附近
families walking from the metro to the market spend less time waiting at side streets|从地铁站步行去市场的家庭在支路口等候的时间减少
a more comfortable trip for people pushing prams or walking slowly|让推婴儿车或走路较慢的人出行更舒适
more residents choosing to walk short distances within the centre|让更多居民选择步行完成市中心内的短途出行
a limited trial lets residents experience an alternative use of familiar streets|短期试行让居民亲身体验熟悉街道的另一种用途
b: a delivery window can protect shops from losses during the truck ban|设置送货时段可帮助商店避免货车禁行造成的损失
fruit sellers and other traders expecting morning deliveries|等候早晨到货的水果摊主和其他商户
advance notice and a delivery window outside the restriction|提前通知，以及限行时段以外的送货时间
arrange for perishable stock to reach their stalls on time|安排易腐货物准时送达摊位
a greengrocer can arrange for fresh produce to arrive before the closure|蔬果店主可以安排生鲜农产品在封路前到货
much of the commercial cost depends on the timetable and can be reduced|商业方面的许多代价都取决于时间安排，并且可以降低
the broad benefit for pedestrians justifies occasional restrictions when essential deliveries remain possible|在必需货物仍可运送的情况下，行人的广泛受益足以支持偶尔限制通行
z: occasional car-free days are worthwhile if deliveries continue and visitors with limited mobility retain access|只要送货不中断、行动不便的访客仍能抵达目的地，偶尔安排无车日就值得
fewer turning cars make crossings easier for families|转弯车辆减少后，一家人过街更容易
early loading slots let traders restock before shoppers arrive|清晨的装卸时段能让商家在顾客到来前补齐货物
essays.q: 有些城市设有无车日，其间市中心禁止私家车、卡车和摩托车通行，并建议人们使用公交、出租车和地铁等公共交通。你认为这项政策的好处在多大程度上超过坏处？
ask: 指定日期限制私家车、卡车和摩托车后，哪些人能更方便地使用中心街道？
被限制的送货和出行需求如何安排，什么条件决定利大于弊的程度？
essays.t: vehicle-free days in city centres|市中心的无车日
essays.s: occasional vehicle restrictions offer substantial benefits if alternative transport and deliveries are arranged|如果能安排替代交通和送货，偶尔限制车辆通行益处明显
essays.transfer: 讨论无车日要留意题干仍允许公交和出租车，并把货车禁行对商家造成的代价写进权衡。
r: occasional restrictions can still isolate some visitors|即使只是偶尔限行，也可能令部分访客寸步难行
not everyone can walk from a bus stop|不是人人都能从公交站步行到目的地
a patient needs door-to-door transport|病人需要门到门的接送
accessible taxis are permitted to enter|无障碍出租车获准驶入
cities offer affordable accessible taxis on restricted days|城市在限行日提供费用可负担的无障碍出租车
limited access to essential services|难以获得必要服务
occasional restrictions with suitable transport alternatives|配有合适替代交通的偶尔限行
essays.stanceSummary: 提前通知并安排公交与送货，无车日能让市中心更方便步行
essays.noun2: advance planning for deliveries|提前为送货做安排

essays.title: 数字时代的纸质书
essays.prompt: Some people think that printed books are not necessary in the digital era, as all writing can be stored electronically. Others believe that printed books still play an important role in our lives. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为，在所有文字都可以用电子方式保存的数字时代，纸质书已经没有必要；另一些人则认为纸质书在生活中仍然很重要。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 电子存储和传输解决了哪些阅读障碍？
即使文字已被存下来，哪些读者依然实际需要纸本？
essays.t: printed books in the digital era|数字时代的纸质书
essays.s: writing should circulate digitally, but print still matters when readers lack dependable devices|文字作品应以数字形式传播，但当读者没有可靠设备时，纸质书仍很重要
a: digital storage brings a large collection within one reader’s reach|数字存储使一位读者也能够访问大量作品
a file can be delivered immediately without printing or postage|数字文件不需要印刷或邮寄，可以即时送达
a student in a small town can obtain an assigned novel before the next lesson|住在小镇的学生能在下次上课前拿到指定小说
a class discussion in which everyone can refer to the assigned text|为全班同学都能引用指定文本参与讨论创造条件
broader access to writing beyond the stock of any one local bookshop|使读者获取文本的范围超出当地任何一家书店的库存
electronic editions meet demand at short notice|电子版本能满足临时出现的阅读需求
b: storing a text electronically does not ensure everyone can read it|电子保存文本并不能确保所有人都能阅读
families who share a single phone|共用一部手机的家庭成员
a second device or a printed copy|另一台设备或一份纸质书
read independently while someone else is using the phone for work|在有人用手机工作时各自阅读
a child who takes a library book home can finish a chapter while a parent answers work messages|孩子把图书馆的书借回家，即使家长正用手机回复工作消息，也可以读完一章
a paper copy gives that child control over when and for how long to read|纸质书让孩子自己决定何时阅读以及阅读多久
offering both formats serves more readers|提供两种版本可以服务更多读者
z: digital editions should expand the reach of a collection, while print should remain available to readers who cannot reliably use a device|馆藏应借助电子版扩大传播范围，同时对无法稳定使用设备的读者继续提供纸本
files travel quickly to distant readers|电子文件能迅速传递到远方读者手中
a paper book remains readable when a device is shared or out of power|即使设备要和别人共用或已经没电，纸质书仍然可以阅读
essays.transfer: 迁移到公共图书馆题时，区分「网上存有内容」与「特定读者有设备、时间和机会读到它」。
r: spending on print can exclude some readers|把经费投向纸本可能使部分读者无法阅读
fixed print sizes are difficult for them to see|固定的印刷字号对他们来说难以看清
a reader needs larger type|读者需要较大字号
a library can offer more than one format|图书馆可以提供不止一种格式
librarians supply adjustable digital text alongside print|图书馆员同时提供纸本和字号可调的电子文本
inaccessible print sizes|印刷字号不适合读者
keeping printed books available|继续提供纸质书
essays.stanceSummary: 电子版方便传播，仍应让受设备限制的读者能够借到纸质书
essays.noun2: access independent of a device|不依赖设备的阅读机会

essays.title: 高管与普通员工的薪酬差距
essays.prompt: Some people think it is a good thing for senior managers to have much higher salaries than the other workers in a company. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有些人认为，公司高管的工资比其他员工高很多是一件好事。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 说得通的薪酬差距怎样帮助企业留住技术骨干？
管理责任为何值得额外薪酬，差距应以什么为限？
essays.t: large pay differences between senior managers and other employees|高管与其他员工之间悬殊的薪酬差距
essays.s: managers often deserve a premium, but very large gaps are rarely good for a company|管理者往往值得获得更高薪酬，但过大的差距很少对公司有益
a: defensible pay differences help a company retain experienced staff|说得通的薪酬差距有助于企业留住有经验的员工
workers who train new recruits expect a fair share of the rewards|培训新员工的骨干也期待得到应得的一份报酬
experienced staff are more likely to stay and solve production problems|经验丰富的员工更有动力留下解决生产难题
faster training for apprentices on the factory floor|生产现场的学徒能够更快熟悉工作
a more skilled and stable workforce|一支技能更强、人员更稳定的队伍
excessive executive rewards can put those gains at risk|给高管的报酬过高会危及这些收益
b: a reasonable difference can reflect a genuine difference in responsibility|适度的薪酬差可以反映真实的责任差异
company boards|公司董事会
a competitive salary to offer experienced candidates|可以向有经验的候选人提供的有竞争力的薪水
recruit someone willing to take responsibility for difficult decisions|招到愿意为艰难决策负责的人
a manager who must decide whether to close a failing plant is accountable for hundreds of livelihoods|一位必须决定是否关闭亏损工厂的经理，其决定关系着数百人的生计
the burden of a role can justify higher pay when the reasons are transparent|在理由透明的前提下，职位所承担的压力可以成为提高薪酬的依据
pay should reflect responsibility across the workforce as well as at the top|薪酬既应反映高层的责任，也应反映其他岗位的责任
z: higher pay for senior managers is often reasonable, but a very large gap rarely benefits the company as a whole|高管薪酬较高常常合乎情理，但差距大到悬殊时，企业整体很少能因此受益
an unexplained pay gap can drive experienced workers away|解释不清的薪酬差距可能让经验丰富的员工离职
a reasonable premium helps recruit managers willing to take difficult decisions|合理的薪酬溢价有助于招到愿意作出艰难决定的管理者
v: a fair share of the rewards
essays.transfer: 把这条逻辑迁移到讨论医生和明星收入的题时，要重新解释各自的收入由谁支付以及依据是什么。
essays.stanceSummary: 额外责任值得较高薪酬，但难以解释的巨大差距不利于留人
r: an exceptional manager may deserve much higher pay|业绩出众的经理或许理应获得高得多的薪水
one contract can save a factory|一份合同可能挽救一家工厂
a manager wins a major order|经理赢得一份大订单
a permanent rise rewards that deal every year|永久加薪等于每年都奖励同一笔交易
boards award a one-off bonus for the contract|董事会为这份合同发放一次性奖金
under-rewarding exceptional work|杰出贡献得不到相应奖励
defensible differences in basic pay|合理的基本薪酬差距
essays.noun2: responsibility for difficult decisions|对艰难决策负有的责任

essays.title: 年轻人与老年人的沟通
essays.prompt: Nowadays in many countries young people don't communicate with older people as much as they used to. Why is this happening? How could this situation be improved?
essays.q: 如今，在许多国家，年轻人与年长者的交流比过去少。为什么会这样？怎样才能改善这种情况？
ask: 哪些社会或生活变化减少了两代人自然交谈的机会？

essays.t: less frequent contact between younger and older generations|年轻一代和年长一代交流频率下降
essays.s: separate daily routines leave fewer chances to talk, and shared practical activities can bring the generations together again|分开的日常生活减少了交谈机会，共同参与实际活动可以让两代人重新建立联系
a: younger adults often move away for work because the move offers secure employment|年轻人因工作而搬离家乡，往往是因为搬迁能带来稳定的就业机会
suitable vacancies may be concentrated far from the family home|合适的职位可能集中在离家很远的地方
a school leaver can accept a first job and earn a regular income|刚离校的年轻人可以接受第一份工作，获得稳定收入
financial independence from parents|在经济上独立于父母
a more secure livelihood in the new town|在新城镇建立更稳定的生活
the same move removes the casual conversations once shared over family meals|同一次搬迁也让原本发生在家庭餐桌上的闲聊消失
b: community centres can create recurring opportunities for the generations to work together|社区中心可以为两代人创造定期合作的机会
younger volunteers and older residents|年轻志愿者和年长居民
a shared task and several chances to meet|一项共同任务以及多次见面的机会
get beyond polite introductions|从客套的介绍进入进一步的交流
teenagers could record older shopkeepers’ memories for a neighbourhood map and return with a draft for corrections|青少年可以记录年长店主的回忆制作社区地图，再带着初稿回来请他们校正
working towards a common result gives people a reason to listen and to meet again|共同完成一个成果会给双方认真倾听和再次见面的理由
regular cooperation is more likely to build communication than a single formal visit|长期合作比一次正式探访更有可能推动交流
z: separate routines have removed everyday conversations, but recurring shared tasks can give the generations a reason to talk again|分开的生活作息减少了日常交谈，定期共同完成任务能让两代人再次有话可说
moving for work can end the chats once shared over meals|因工作搬离后，原本饭桌上的闲聊可能随之消失
compiling local stories gives young and old a reason to meet again|一起整理社区故事能给两代人下次见面的理由

essays.stanceSummary: 作息和居所分开减少闲聊，共同完成持续的社区项目能增加交流
r: local projects cannot reunite relatives living far apart|社区项目不能让相隔很远的亲人团聚
work shifts leave little time for visits|轮班工作使人很少有时间探访亲人
families live in different towns|家人分居不同城镇
shared interests can also sustain a conversation by phone|共同兴趣也能使家人在电话中有话可谈
families schedule a weekly call around a shared activity|家人围绕一项共同活动安排每周一次的通话
distance between relatives|亲人之间的距离
recurring activities that bring generations together|让两代人定期交流的共同活动
essays.noun2: a reason to meet again|再次见面的理由

essays.title: 艺术创作与特殊天赋
essays.prompt: Some people believe that every human can create art. Other people think that art can only be created by people with special talents. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为每个人都能创作艺术；另一些人则认为只有具备特殊天赋的人才能创作。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 普通人的哪一种作品也可以算艺术，判断依据是什么？
特殊天赋在哪类创作中很重要，为什么这不等于它是所有创作的门槛？
essays.t: the role of special talent in making art|特殊天赋在艺术创作中的作用
essays.s: everyone can make expressive art, although demanding professional work may require exceptional talent|每个人都能创作有表达意味的艺术，但高难度专业作品可能需要非凡才能
a: making art can begin with an ordinary person's wish to express a feeling or memory|艺术创作可以始于普通人想表达一种感受或记录一段回忆的愿望
choosing a colour directs another person’s attention towards a particular detail|选择某种颜色会把别人注意力引向一个特定细节
a child can draw a grandparent's kitchen and make the familiar yellow lamp the focus|孩子可以画祖辈家的厨房，让熟悉的黄色台灯成为画面的中心
a conversation about why that small detail matters so much to the artist|引出对这一细节为何让创作者如此在意的讨论
confidence in using a creative medium to communicate personal experience|建立借助创作媒介传达个人经历的信心

b: people who stress special talent often have unusually accomplished work in mind|强调特殊天赋的人所想到的作品往往具有格外高的造诣
musicians composing for a full orchestra|为整支管弦乐团作曲的音乐人
a sensitive ear and considerable practice with different instruments|敏锐的听觉以及运用不同乐器的大量练习
anticipate how several musical lines will sound together|预想几条旋律同时演奏时的听觉效果
a composer may notice during rehearsal that a lovely flute melody disappears beneath the brass|作曲家可能在排练时注意到，原本动听的长笛旋律被铜管乐盖住了
noticing that imbalance allows a composer to revise a score until the intended melody can be heard|察觉声部失衡后，作曲家便能修改乐谱，让原本想突出的旋律被听见

z: the ability to express an idea through art is widespread, while mastery of complex works is rarer|通过艺术表达想法的能力很普遍，而驾驭复杂作品的能力更为少见
a child's choice of colour can convey a memory|孩子选择的颜色也能传达一段回忆
an orchestral score calls for control over many sounds at once|管弦乐总谱的创作则需要同时掌控多种声音

a town commissions a public sculpture|城镇委托创作公共雕塑

ordinary people’s capacity for artistic expression|普通人的艺术表达能力

children waiting at busy school gates breathe exhaust from idling cars|在繁忙校门口等候的孩子会吸入怠速车辆的尾气

less repeated exposure to traffic fumes throughout the school year|减少整个学年内反复接触交通废气的情况

a clinic has a long waiting list|一家诊所有很长的候诊名单
vaccination cannot remove traffic fumes|疫苗接种无法消除交通废气
authorities protect clinic budgets alongside housing grants|主管部门在拨付住房补助时也保障诊所经费
delayed preventive care|预防性服务延误
greater investment in cleaner neighbourhoods and sound housing|增加对清洁社区环境和良好住房的投入
essays.noun2: timely housing repairs|及时的房屋维修

essays.title: 城镇大型户外公共空间
essays.prompt: All towns and cities need to have large outdoor public spaces such as parks or squares. Do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 所有城镇都需要公园、广场等大型户外公共空间。你同意还是不同意？
ask: 大型公共空间能满足什么具体需求？
为什么不能要求每个城镇都建设同样大的场地？
essays.t: the size of urban parks and squares|城镇公园与广场的规模
essays.s: every town needs free outdoor space, although the right size varies|每座城镇都需要免费户外空间，但合适的面积因地而异
a: large parks give city residents space for activities they cannot do at home|大型公园为城市居民提供开展在家无法进行的活动的空间
a small flat has little room for children to play catch or for several families to meet|小公寓里几乎没有空间让孩子玩接球或让几户人家聚一聚
neighbours can spend an afternoon together without booking a room or paying for a meal|邻居们可以一起度过一个下午，无须订房间或花钱聚餐
regular contact between families who otherwise only pass on the stairs|原本只在楼梯上擦肩而过的家庭经常来往
closer ties among neighbours in crowded districts|拥挤城区的邻里关系更加紧密
densely populated areas need somewhere for many households to gather|人口稠密地区需要让许多家庭都能聚会的地方
b: a park is useful only if people can reach it|公园要方便到达才能发挥作用
families who travel on foot|主要靠步行出行的家庭
a safe route from home|一条从家出发的安全路线
use even a beautiful park on a regular basis|经常使用哪怕是十分漂亮的公园
in a small town divided by a busy road, two neighbourhood squares could serve children better than one distant park|在被繁忙道路隔开的小镇上，两个社区广场可能比一个远处的公园更方便儿童使用
several small spaces can put outdoor play within walking distance of more homes|多个小场地能让更多家庭步行就能到达户外活动地点
size should follow local patterns of use and the layout of the town|场地大小应根据当地的使用需求和城镇布局决定
z: every town needs accessible outdoor space, but only some need a large park or square to meet local demand|每个城镇都需要方便到达的户外公共空间，但只有部分城镇需要大型公园或广场来满足当地需求
large parks give families in flats room to play|大型公园给住公寓的家庭提供游玩的空间
a small square near home spares children a difficult journey|家附近的小广场能让儿童免去一段难走的路
essays.transfer: 碰到城市公共设施题，可以把“人人受益”拆成谁住在附近、谁能安全到达、能做什么活动。
essays.stanceSummary: 城镇都需要户外公共空间，场地大小应按居民需要决定
r: even small towns need large gathering places|即使是小镇也需要宽阔的集会场地
crowds need room to move safely|人群需要安全活动的空间
a town holds its annual fair|小镇举办一年一度的集市
a school playing field could host occasional events|学校操场也可以承接偶尔举办的活动
councils arrange temporary access to school grounds|地方政府协商临时使用学校场地
limited space at fairs|集市空间不足
smaller public spaces in towns they suit|在适合的城镇设置规模较小的公共空间
essays.noun2: access on foot|步行可达性

essays.title: 国际快餐与传统饮食
essays.prompt: In many countries traditional foods are being replaced by international fast foods. This is having a negative effect on both families and societies. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 在许多国家，传统食物正逐渐被国际快餐取代。这对家庭和社会都有负面影响。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 家人一起做传统菜有什么价值，频繁以快餐代替会失去什么？
这种变化如何从家庭餐桌传递到社区食品商户？
essays.t: the replacement of traditional meals by international fast food|国际快餐逐渐取代传统饮食的现象
essays.s: replacing traditional meals with international fast food usually harms both family life and local food traditions|用国际快餐取代传统饮食，通常会同时损害家庭生活和地方饮食传统
a: cooking together lets grandparents pass on family recipes|共同下厨使祖父母得以传授家传菜谱
a child can learn to fold a dumpling by copying a grandparent’s hands|孩子可以模仿祖父母的手势来学包饺子
the child can help make a shared meal|孩子可以帮忙准备全家人的一顿饭
preserving a family recipe through regular practice|通过经常练习保留家传食谱
a tradition children can teach their own families|孩子将来也能传授给自己家人的传统
routine fast-food purchases remove these opportunities to learn together|经常购买快餐会消除这些共同学习的机会
b: traditional dishes also sustain specialist food businesses|传统菜肴也维系着特色食品商户
small food producers|小型食品生产者
a steady stream of customers|稳定的客源
keep making an ingredient that takes time and skill to prepare|持续制作一种需要时间和技艺的食材
a noodle maker who loses most weekday orders to a fast-food chain may stop training an apprentice|一家面铺的工作日订单大多被连锁快餐店抢走后，店主可能不再带徒弟
changes in household purchases can weaken the businesses that keep a regional food tradition alive|家庭购买习惯的改变会削弱维系地方饮食传统的小商户
the social cost extends beyond the taste of any individual meal|其社会代价超越了某一顿饭口味的改变
z: the routine replacement of traditional meals by international fast food harms families and communities, even though an occasional takeaway can help|经常用国际快餐取代传统餐食会损害家庭和社区，尽管偶尔买份外卖可以帮上忙
children lose chances to learn family recipes|孩子学做家传菜的机会会减少
neighbourhood food makers lose the orders that let them train apprentices|社区食品作坊会流失原本可以支撑其培养学徒的订单
essays.transfer: 这题同时问家庭和社会，写完亲子互动后，可以顺着“谁因此失去订单”自然转到社区。
essays.stanceSummary: 快餐大规模取代传统饮食，会削弱家庭共同烹饪和社区生意
r: fast food can save the family dinner|快餐有时反而能让一家人吃上团圆饭
a takeaway leaves time to eat together|买来的外卖留出了同桌吃饭的时间
parents get home just before bedtime|家长到家时离孩子就寝时间已经很近
occasional takeaways need not replace an entire food tradition|偶尔吃外卖不必意味着取代整套饮食传统
families prepare traditional dishes on a free afternoon|家庭利用有空的下午准备传统菜肴
cooking under time pressure|在时间紧迫时做饭
keeping traditional meals in the family routine|在家庭日常生活中保留传统餐食
essays.noun2: the continuity of local food businesses|本地食品商户的延续

essays.title: 贫富差距与社会幸福
essays.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to produce a happier society is to ensure that there are only small differences between its richest and poorest members. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，创造一个更幸福的社会，最好的办法是确保最富者和最贫困者之间的差距很小。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 缩小差距在什么情况下能改善生活？
为什么差距较小并不一定是让人更幸福的最佳办法？
essays.t: income inequality and social happiness|收入不平等与社会幸福
essays.s: narrowing large income gaps can help, but providing basic services is often a more direct route to a happier society|缩小过大的收入差距会有帮助，但提供基本服务往往是增进社会幸福更直接的途径
a: a smaller gap can matter when it gives poorer families more money for everyday needs|如果缩小差距能让低收入家庭有更多钱应付日常需要，它就很有意义
a modest rise in take-home pay can cover a week's bus fares or replace a broken heater|实得工资的小幅提高就可能付清一周的车费，或换掉坏掉的取暖器
parents can deal with an unexpected bill without having to borrow from a relative|父母可以应付突如其来的账单，而不必找亲戚借钱
more predictable household spending during a difficult month|家庭即使遇到困难月份也更有把握安排开支
greater peace of mind for people who used to worry about every bill|过去为每笔账单担忧的人能得到更多安心
narrowing the gap improves wellbeing most clearly when it also makes poorer households more secure|缩小差距若同时提高了低收入家庭的生活保障，它增进福祉的作用就最清楚
b: income figures alone reveal little about whether people can obtain a service they need|收入数字本身很难体现人们能否获得所需的服务
residents of isolated villages|偏远村庄的居民
a reliable local bus service|可靠的本地公交服务
reach a college or a workplace without owning a car|在没有私家车时前往学校或工作地点
two villages may have similar incomes, yet only one has a bus that takes residents to work|两个村庄的收入水平可能相近，但只有一个有公交可供村民上班
better services can expand people's choices without changing relative incomes|即使相对收入不变，更好的服务也能拓宽人们的选择
households still need services that income comparisons cannot capture|家庭仍然需要那些光比较收入无法体现其价值的服务
z: reducing extreme inequality can make society happier, but it is not always the best route when basic services are missing|缩小极端的贫富差距可以提升社会幸福感，但在基本服务缺失的地方，这并不总是最好的办法
higher wages can cover a family's weekly bus fares|工资提高可以让一家人付得起每周的车费
pay alone cannot get villagers to work if no bus runs|如果村里没有公交，仅仅加薪并不能让村民顺利去上班
v: a modest rise in take-home pay
essays.transfer: 遇到“最佳办法”，保留原办法能起效的条件，再用一个能解决不同困难的方案作比较。
r: narrower wealth gaps matter more than services|较小的贫富差距比公共服务更重要
relative wealth affects who feels included|相对财富影响人们是否感到自己被接纳
most pupils can afford a school trip|大部分学生都能承担学校旅行费用
a school can remove the particular barrier directly|学校能够直接消除这项具体障碍
schools cover travel fees for poorer pupils|学校为较贫困的学生承担旅行费用
exclusion from school trips|因无力付费而不能参加学校旅行
priority for accessible public services|优先提供容易获得的公共服务
essays.stanceSummary: 缩小过大贫富差距有帮助，保障基本服务往往更能改善生活
essays.noun2: access to essential services|基本服务的可及性

essays.title: 饮食锻炼与健康长寿
essays.prompt: Some people think that a good diet and exercise are not necessary for a healthy and long life. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，健康饮食和锻炼并非健康长寿所必需。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 日常饮食怎样影响长期保持健康的机会？
日常活动能带来什么可观察的能力，为什么仍然不能保证寿命？
essays.t: diet, exercise and a long, healthy life|饮食、运动与健康长寿的关系
essays.s: diet and exercise both improve the chances of a healthy old age, although neither guarantees longevity|良好的饮食和运动都有助于健康地步入老年，尽管两者都无法保证长寿
a: balanced meals help people meet the physical demands of daily life|均衡饮食帮助人们满足日常生活的体力需求
a varied lunch can supply both the energy for an afternoon shift and nutrients missing from a sugary drink|一顿多样化的午餐既能提供下午上班所需的能量，也能提供含糖饮料所缺乏的营养
a worker who eats a proper lunch is better prepared for a physically demanding afternoon|好好吃午饭的人更能应付下午繁重的体力工作
steady energy throughout a shift|在整个工作班次中保持较稳定的精力
better health as people's needs change with age|随着年龄增长、身体需求变化，人们更容易保持健康
a useful diet is one people can sustain day after day|有用的饮食方式应当能让人日复一日坚持
b: regular exercise helps people retain the strength needed for everyday tasks|经常运动有助于保有完成日常事务所需的力量
people who spend most of the day sitting|一天中大部分时间都坐着的人
regular opportunities to use their muscles|经常使用肌肉的机会
maintain the strength they need to climb stairs or carry shopping|保持爬楼梯或拎购物袋所需的力量
someone who starts walking to the local shops can gradually become comfortable with a route that once felt tiring|开始步行去附近商店的人，可能慢慢就能轻松走完过去令人疲惫的路程
being active can improve how independently a person manages everyday life|保持活动有助于人们更独立地处理日常生活
the possibility of illness does not make physical activity dispensable|疾病仍有可能出现，并不意味着运动可有可无
z: a good diet and regular exercise deserve a central place in a long, healthy life even though individual outcomes vary|尽管个体情况有差异，良好饮食和经常运动在追求健康长寿的生活中仍应占有重要位置
a balanced lunch helps a worker through a demanding shift|均衡的午餐让劳动者更有体力完成繁重的班次
regular walking helps an older person manage the trip to the shops|经常步行有助于老人独自走到商店购物
essays.transfer: 健康题要区分“提高保持健康的可能性”和“保证长寿”，同时给出一个能观察到的日常例子。
essays.stanceSummary: 饮食和锻炼能提高健康长寿的机会，即使二者不能保证寿命
r: healthy routines are impractical for some workers|对一些工人而言，健康生活规律并不现实
long shifts disrupt meals and exercise|长时间轮班会打乱用餐和运动安排
a work roster changes every week|排班表每周都变
neither habit requires a rigid timetable|这两种习惯都不要求机械地照着时间表执行
workers prepare portable meals and walk part of their commute|上班族准备方便携带的餐食，并步行完成部分通勤
irregular working hours|工作时间不规律
regular activity and a balanced diet|经常活动与均衡饮食
essays.noun2: physical independence in later life|晚年的生活自理能力

essays.title: 本地历史与世界历史
essays.prompt: It's more important for school children to learn about their local history than world history. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 对中小学生而言，学习本地历史比学习世界历史更重要。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 本地历史怎样帮助儿童入门？
为什么世界历史同样能帮助学生解释本地发生的事？
essays.t: local and world history in schools|学校里的本地历史和世界历史教育
essays.s: local history is a useful starting point, but world history deserves comparable attention|本地历史适合入门，但世界历史同样值得重视
a: local history gives children a familiar starting point for investigating the past|本地历史给孩子提供了一个探究过往的熟悉起点
they can compare an old street photograph with the buildings they pass on the way to school|他们可以把老街照片与上学路上经过的建筑进行比较
a pupil can spot a vanished market and ask former stallholders what changed|学生能发现消失的集市，并问以前的摊主发生了什么变化
classroom discussions based on children's own evidence|以孩子亲自搜集的证据为基础的课堂讨论
a lasting habit of checking historical claims against surviving evidence|养成用留存证据核查历史说法的长期习惯
nearby places can make historical inquiry accessible even to beginners|身边的地点也能让初学者进入历史探究
b: world history can explain why changes occurred in a child's own town|世界历史可以说明孩子所在城镇为何发生变化
pupils studying an old port|研究一座老港口的学生
some knowledge of trade between different regions of the world|对世界不同地区之间贸易的基本了解
explain why their town once had warehouses full of imported goods|说明自己所在的城镇过去为何有堆满进口商品的仓库
an old map of spice routes can show how ships arriving from distant ports created work for local dockworkers|一张香料贸易航线旧地图能说明来自远方港口的船只如何给当地码头工人带来工作
a lesson about a single street may require students to look well beyond their own country|一堂有关一条街道的课也可能要求学生把目光投向国境之外
both scales of history deserve space in the school timetable|本地和世界两个尺度的历史都应在课表中占有一席之地
z: children need both local evidence and world history to understand the places where they live|孩子既需要本地证据也需要世界历史，才能理解自己居住的地方
an old photograph invites children to investigate a vanished market|一张老照片能引导孩子去探究一座已消失的集市
world trade explains the warehouses beside a local port|国际贸易史能说明本地港口旁为什么曾建有仓库
essays.transfer: 这道比较题可以选同一座港口做例子，分别展示“本地找证据”和“全球找原因”的作用。
essays.stanceSummary: 本地历史适合儿童入门，世界历史同样值得重视
r: local history deserves priority before memories disappear|在地方记忆消失前，本地历史值得优先学习
oral accounts can preserve unwritten details|口述记录能够保留未被写下的细节
the last workers at a mill are growing old|某座工厂仅存的老工人正在老去
one short project can capture their memories|一个短期项目就能记录他们的回忆
pupils record interviews and deposit copies in a local archive|学生录下访谈并将副本存入地方档案馆
the loss of first-hand testimony|第一手口述证言的流失
balanced teaching of local and world history|兼顾本地历史与世界历史的教学
essays.noun2: the wider context of local change|地方变化背后的更大背景

essays.title: 传统课堂的未来
essays.prompt: The teaching situation of teachers and students in a classroom will no longer exist by the year 2050. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 到了 2050 年，教师与学生同在教室里上课的教学形式将不复存在。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 线上学习最可能取代课堂里的哪类活动？
哪些活动仍需要师生同处一室，从而检验“完全消失”的预测？
essays.t: the future of teaching in physical classrooms|实体课堂教学的未来
essays.s: online teaching will replace some classroom sessions by 2050, but teachers and students will still meet in person|到 2050 年线上教学会取代部分课堂，但老师和学生仍会见面
a: recorded lessons offer a practical alternative when many learners need the same explanation|许多学习者都需要同一种讲解时，录播课是可行的替代方案
students can replay a difficult passage at home without making the whole class wait|学生可以在家反复听一段难点，而不必让全班其他人等候
a quiet pupil can revisit a worked example until each step makes sense|性格安静的学生可以反复看一道例题，直到弄懂每一步
class time spent applying the method rather than repeating the demonstration|把课堂时间用来实际运用方法，而不必重复演示
a timetable that reserves more face-to-face time for practical work|一种留出更多当面时间开展实践活动的课程安排
ordinary lectures may go online while practical classes continue|普通讲授课可以迁至线上，而实践课堂仍会继续
b: a teacher watching students work can spot difficulties that a learner does not know how to describe|现场观察的教师能够发现学习者自己都描述不出来的困难
beginners learning a practical skill|正在学实践技能的初学者
direct feedback while they practise|练习时得到的直接反馈
correct a small mistake they cannot see for themselves|纠正自己无法察觉的小错误
a pottery teacher can see why a pupil’s bowl collapses and demonstrate the hand movement on the same wheel|陶艺老师能看见学生做的碗为何塌下，并在同一陶轮上演示手部动作
sharing a workspace can give the teacher information that a completed assignment leaves out|共用工作场地能让教师获得只看成品作业无法得到的信息
such lessons give schools a reason to keep physical classrooms even as technology improves|即使技术进步，这类课程仍让学校有理由保留实体课堂
z: by 2050 many lectures may be online, but teachers and pupils will still work together in classrooms|到2050年许多讲授课可能已转为线上，但师生仍会在课堂里一起学习
a recording lets each pupil replay a difficult step|录播课让每位学生都可以回看困难步骤
a teacher in the room can spot a mistake the pupil misses|在场的老师能够发现学生自己没有察觉的错误
v: 一份有解题过程的例题
essays.transfer: 论证未来预测时，抓住“完全消失”的范围，只要解释一种值得保留的课堂用途，就能有力回应题目。
r: some schools could move entirely online|一些学校或许可以完全转成线上教学
specialist teachers are hard to recruit|专业教师很难招到
a small school cannot fill a language vacancy|一所小学校招不到语言课教师
remote specialists can work alongside local classroom teachers|远程专业教师可以与本地的实体课堂教师合作
small schools share a specialist through video lessons|规模小的学校通过视频课共用一位专业教师
unfilled teaching posts|空缺的教师岗位
retaining physical classrooms alongside online lessons|在线上课之外保留实体课堂
essays.stanceSummary: 到2050年部分课程会转到网上，现场课堂仍有存在价值
essays.noun2: immediate hands-on guidance|及时的现场操作指导

essays.title: 大学鼓励学生学习专业之外的科目
essays.prompt: Some people think that universities should encourage students to learn about subjects outside of their major field of study. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，大学应鼓励学生学习主修专业以外的科目。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 跨专业课程能帮助学生解决主修课里的什么问题？
为什么应当鼓励选修，同时给专业训练留出足够时间？
essays.t: university study outside a student's main field|大学生学习主修领域以外的科目
essays.s: universities should encourage exploration outside the major while protecting time for specialist study|大学应鼓励学生探索专业以外的领域，同时保障专业学习时间
a: an outside subject can help students understand their major|主修之外的学科能帮助学生更好地理解自己的专业
a nursing student who studies statistics can distinguish patient numbers from the proportion affected|学过统计的护理学生能分清患者总数与受影响的患者比例
the student can read a hospital report more carefully before drawing a conclusion|学生能在得出结论前更谨慎地阅读医院报告
better questions about the evidence discussed in practical classes|在实践课上针对证据提出更恰当的问题
graduates who can explain the reasoning behind a professional decision|毕业生能够解释一项专业决定背后的推理过程
a well-chosen elective can strengthen the main degree itself|一门选择恰当的选修课能够加强主修学习
b: trying an unfamiliar subject also helps students explore career options|试学一门陌生科目也有助于学生探索职业选择
students considering a different line of work|正在考虑另一种职业方向的学生
an opportunity to try it for a short period|短期试学的机会
judge whether the daily work would actually suit them|判断这项工作的日常内容是否真的适合自己
an engineering student might enjoy sketching but discover in a design class that she prefers testing materials to designing products|一名工科学生可能喜欢画草图，却通过设计课发现自己比起设计产品更喜欢测试材料
one elective can inform a career decision without forcing someone to change degree programmes|一门选修课就能为职业选择提供信息，而不必迫使学生转专业
universities can reserve an elective slot without lengthening a degree|大学可以在不延长学制的情况下预留选修时段
z: universities should encourage students to take electives beyond their main field, provided the choices leave room for essential specialist training|大学应鼓励学生选修主修领域以外的课程，前提是仍为必要的专业训练留出时间
studying statistics helps nursing students interpret a hospital report|学习统计能帮助护理学生读懂医院报告
a design elective lets engineering students try unfamiliar work before choosing a career|设计选修课让工科学生在选定职业前先尝试不熟悉的工作内容
v: 一门选择恰当的选修课
essays.transfer: 若用于“通识教育还是专业教育”，先说明一门选修课怎样改变主专业里一个具体判断，再讨论学习时间的分配。
essays.stanceSummary: 大学应鼓励适量跨专业选修，同时为主修训练留足时间
r: outside courses may delay graduation|选修专业外课程可能使毕业延期
a timetable clash can cost a whole term|排课冲突可能耽误整个学期
a required laboratory class runs once a year|必修实验课每年只开一次
some electives already count towards the degree|一些选修课本来就计入学位学分
advisers identify electives that fit around core classes|学业顾问找出不与核心课程冲突的选修课
timetable clashes|课表冲突
encouraging study beyond the major|鼓励学生跨专业学习
essays.noun2: first-hand experience of another profession|对另一种职业的亲身体验

essays.title: 大学教育权利及不论经济背景的免费教育
essays.prompt: Some people believe that people have the right to university education, and the government should make it free no matter what their financial background. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，人人都有接受大学教育的权利，政府应当让所有人免费上大学，无论其经济背景如何。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 经济条件为什么不该决定合格申请人是否能入学？
为什么有权入学并不一定要求政府为富裕家庭也付全额学费？
essays.t: the right to university education and the funding of tuition|大学教育权利与学费的承担方式
essays.s: qualified applicants deserve a place regardless of financial background, with grants prioritising those who cannot pay|符合条件的申请人不论经济背景都应有入学机会，助学金应优先给无力负担者
a: tuition support matters most to students whose families have no savings|学费资助对家中没有积蓄的学生最为重要
an offer means little if the first fee is due before the student can earn anything|如果学生还来不及挣钱就要交第一笔学费，录取通知书便没有多少实际意义
a grant paid directly to the university lets an admitted student register on time|直接支付给大学的助学金让获录取的学生得以按时报到
attendance in the opening weeks when important courses begin|学生在重要课程开始的前几周能正常出勤
more graduates from households that could never finance a degree alone|更多来自无力独自负担大学学费家庭的学生顺利毕业
a right to apply has value when an admitted student can afford to enrol|被录取的人负担得起入学费用时，申请权才有实际价值
b: paying wealthy students' fees leaves less for costs that still exclude poorer students|为富裕学生付学费会挤占资金，使阻碍较贫困学生就读的其他费用仍难以解决
students who live far from campus|住处离学校很远的学生
enough money for accommodation or daily travel|足够的住宿或日常交通费用
attend courses offered tuition-free|到校参加免学费的课程
two applicants may attend the same free course, but only one can afford the rent near the university|两名申请人或许都能上同一门免费课程，但只有一人负担得起大学附近的房租
identical fee arrangements can leave students with very different opportunities|相同的学费政策仍可能使学生实际拥有十分不同的机会
payments from wealthier families free up grants for students facing living costs|有能力家庭所缴的费用可以腾出资助，帮助其他学生应付生活费
z: access to university should be a right for qualified applicants, but government-funded tuition should be concentrated on those unable to pay|符合入学条件的人应享有接受大学教育的权利，但政府承担的学费应集中用于无力支付的人
a tuition grant lets an admitted student enrol|学费资助让已获录取的学生能够报到
targeted support can cover rent that a universal fee waiver leaves untouched|针对性补助还能承担普遍免学费没有顾及的房租
essays.transfer: 学费题尤其要区分“有入学机会”和“人人免学费”，可用房租说明同样免学费不代表入学条件相同。
r: universal free tuition is simpler to administer|普遍免学费更容易管理
checking income can delay a grant|核查收入可能推迟发放资助
household earnings vary from month to month|家庭收入每月波动
students can enrol while an assessment is pending|学生可以在资助资格仍待审核时先注册
universities allow provisional enrolment|大学允许学生暂时注册入学
delays in assessing financial need|审核资助资格时的延误
tuition support targeted at financial need|按经济需要提供学费资助
essays.stanceSummary: 应保障合格学生入学，学费资助应优先给有经济困难者
essays.noun2: the cost of attending university|实际到校就读的费用

essays.title: 儿童从小独立行动和自行决策
essays.prompt: It is important to give children the chance to act independently and make their own decisions from an early age. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this idea?
essays.q: 从小给孩子独立行动和自行作决定的机会很重要。你在多大程度上同意这种观点？
ask: 可控的小决定怎样帮助儿童学习判断？
成人应怎样划定可以独立尝试的范围？
essays.t: children's independence in everyday decisions|儿童在日常决策中的独立性
essays.s: children should make manageable decisions early, within limits appropriate to their age|孩子应尽早在与其年龄相称的范围内做力所能及的决定
a: small decisions let children see the connection between a choice and its consequences|一些小决定能让孩子看到选择与结果之间的联系
a child who packs a drawing bag must think ahead about which materials a task requires|自己整理画画用的袋子时，孩子必须提前考虑活动需要哪些材料
after forgetting a pencil, the child checks the bag before the next activity|忘带一次铅笔之后，孩子会在下次活动前检查袋子
planning the next activity with fewer reminders from an adult|在成人更少提醒的情况下安排下一次活动
more confident decisions about tasks with several steps|更有信心安排包含多个步骤的任务
ordinary mistakes with small consequences are useful opportunities for early practice|后果轻微的日常失误是尽早练习判断的好机会
b: adult supervision can make early independence safer|成人看护可以让孩子更安全地尝试独立
young children|年幼的孩子
a small set of safe options they can understand|几个自己能理解的安全选项
practise choosing without feeling overwhelmed by unfamiliar risks|在不会被陌生风险压倒的情况下练习做选择
a parent selects a safe playground but lets the child choose the game|家长选好安全的游乐场，再让孩子自己决定玩什么
parents can set the boundaries without deciding every detail|父母可以划定边界，而无须决定每个细节
the amount of freedom should grow as children show that they can use it responsibly|当孩子表现出能负责任地行使自由时，自主空间应随之扩大
z: children gain from making small decisions early if adults limit the risks|如果成人控制好风险，孩子从小做些小决定便能有所收获
a forgotten pencil can teach a child to plan ahead|一次忘带铅笔的经历就能让孩子学会提前准备
a safe playground lets the child choose a game independently|在安全的游乐场里，孩子可以自主决定玩什么游戏
essays.transfer: 遇到“儿童自由是否过多”，可以把自由具体化为谁先设边界、孩子在边界内决定什么。
essays.stanceSummary: 儿童应从小练习自己决定，成人按年龄和经验划定范围
r: independent choices can upset other children|孩子各自作决定可能会打扰其他孩子
bedtime music may keep a younger sibling awake|睡前听音乐可能让年幼的弟妹睡不着
siblings share a bedroom|兄弟姐妹共用一间卧室
children can learn to negotiate decisions that affect others|孩子可以学习就影响他人的决定进行协商
parents help them agree on quiet hours|父母帮助他们商定安静时段
conflicting bedtime routines|相互冲突的睡前习惯
early practice in making everyday decisions|从小练习日常决策
essays.noun2: adult guidance on safe choices|成人对安全选择的引导

essays.title: 父母参加育儿培训
essays.prompt: Caring for children is probably the most important thing of the society. It is suggested that all mothers and fathers should be required to take childcare training courses. To what extent do you agree or disagree with the statement?
essays.q: 照顾孩子可能是社会上最重要的事情。有人建议，应要求所有父母都参加育儿培训课程。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 课程能给需要支持的父母带来哪些具体帮助？
为什么照护很重要，也不能推出所有父母都必须上课？
essays.t: compulsory childcare courses for all parents|所有父母是否必须上育儿课
essays.s: childcare training should be available to every parent, but attendance should generally be voluntary|应让每一位父母都能获得育儿培训，不过参加培训通常应出于自愿
a: a short practical course can give a new parent useful ways to manage difficult routines|短期实践课可以给新手家长提供应对棘手日常问题的方法
a parent can describe a specific difficulty and hear how other families have addressed it|家长可以描述具体困难，并了解其他家庭如何应对
parents can lay out clothes the night before school with their child|家长可以在上学前一晚和孩子一起摆好第二天要穿的衣服
calmer mornings in which the child knows what to do next|孩子清楚下一步要做什么、家人也更从容的早晨
a family habit that reduces an avoidable source of conflict|形成减少一类可避免冲突的家庭习惯
practical training can reduce recurring arguments at home|实用的培训能减少家中反复出现的争执
b: a compulsory timetable can burden parents who already lack support|强制课表会给本来就缺乏支持的家长增添负担
parents working irregular shifts|上班时间不固定的家长
affordable childcare and a class that fits their shifts|负担得起的看护服务和不与轮班冲突的课程
attend a course without losing pay|在不损失工资的情况下上课
a single father working late might watch a recording after his child goes to bed|一位下班晚的单亲父亲可以在孩子睡下后看录课
enforcing attendance could penalise the very parents who would benefit from flexible support|强制出席可能惩罚的恰好是最需要灵活支持的父母
voluntary courses can fit around different working hours|自愿参加的课程能够适应不同的工作时间
z: governments should offer childcare training to all parents while allowing them to decide whether to attend|政府应向所有父母提供育儿培训，同时让他们自己决定是否参加
a practical tip can ease daily arguments before school|一条实用建议能减少孩子每天上学前的家庭争执
a fixed course timetable can cost a shift worker a day's pay|固定的上课时间却可能让轮班工作的家长损失一天工资
v: 负担得起的儿童照护服务
essays.transfer: 题干的核心限制词是 all；可以肯定育儿课的价值，再用轮班家长说明为何普遍强制不合适。
essays.stanceSummary: 育儿课程应广泛提供，让家长按需要和时间自愿参加
r: compulsory courses would reach reluctant parents|强制课程能覆盖那些本不愿参加的家长
some families interpret a personal invitation as criticism|有些家庭会把单独邀请理解为批评
only struggling parents receive invitations|只有遇到困难的家长收到邀请
a routine invitation to everyone carries no such stigma|给所有人发出常规邀请，并不会带来这种被贴标签的感觉
clinics offer every family a confidential first session|诊所向每家提供一次保密的首次培训
fear of judgement|担心受到评判
voluntary training open to all parents|面向所有家长的自愿培训
essays.noun2: flexible access to training|灵活参加培训的机会

essays.title: 学校的行为教育责任
essays.prompt: It is the responsibility of school to teach good behaviors in addition to providing formal education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 除了教授正式课程，学校还有责任教学生良好的行为规范。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 学校的日常场景能教会学生哪些行为？
教师怎样在完成学科教学时承担这项责任？
essays.t: the responsibility of schools for children's behaviour|学校在儿童行为教育中承担的责任
essays.s: schools should teach good behaviour alongside academic subjects, sharing this responsibility with families|学校应在教授学科知识的同时教良好行为，与家庭共同承担这项责任
a: shared lessons give pupils repeated opportunities to practise fairness|共同上课能给学生反复练习公平待人的机会
groups using one set of science equipment must take turns|共用一套实验器材的小组必须轮流使用
pupils notice when an extra turn leaves someone else without time to finish|学生会留意到，自己多用一轮就会让别人来不及完成任务
fairer arrangements that allow everyone in the group to contribute|让小组每个人都能参与的更公平安排
greater awareness of how one pupil's choices affect the rest of the class|更能意识到一个学生的选择如何影响全班其他人
a teacher has sound reasons to address unfair behaviour when it affects everyone's learning|不公平行为影响大家的学习时，教师有充分理由加以处理
b: ordinary lessons can teach good conduct without a separate examination|普通课程也能教会学生良好行为，无须另外设考试
students learning to give feedback|正在学习提供反馈的学生
clear examples of respectful disagreement|对如何礼貌表达不同意见的清楚示范
tell a classmate that an argument needs more evidence without sounding dismissive|指出同学的论点需要更多证据，同时不显得轻视对方
a history teacher can ask pupils to challenge a date rather than insult the speaker|历史老师可以要求学生质疑某个日期，而非侮辱发言者
academic discussion itself can teach students how to challenge an idea courteously|学科讨论本身就可以教学生如何礼貌地质疑一个观点
behavioural guidance belongs in the classroom even when parents are also involved|即使父母也参与，课堂中仍应包含行为指导
z: schools should teach considerate behaviour alongside academic subjects, with families reinforcing it at home|学校应在教授学科知识的同时培养体谅他人的行为，家长也可在家加以巩固
sharing lab equipment teaches pupils to take turns|共用实验器材能让学生学会轮流使用
discussing a historical source lets them practise challenging an idea respectfully|讨论一份史料让他们练习如何礼貌地质疑观点
v: 有礼貌地表达不同意见
essays.transfer: “学校责任”可以用一节具体的学科课来写，说明如何同时完成知识学习和行为教育。
essays.stanceSummary: 学校应与家庭分担行为教育，利用日常课堂教孩子与人相处
r: schools may misjudge harmless differences in manners|学校可能误判无伤大雅的礼仪差异
families follow different rules for addressing adults|不同家庭对如何称呼成人有不同习惯
a new pupil uses an unfamiliar greeting|新来的学生采用了不常见的问候方式
asking pupils to share equipment protects everyone's opportunity to learn|要求学生共用器材是为了保障每个人的学习机会
teachers explain which classroom rules protect others|教师说明哪些课堂规则是为了保护他人
misunderstanding cultural differences|误解文化差异
teaching considerate conduct in school|在学校教授体谅他人的行为
essays.noun2: guidance on conduct in class|对课堂行为的指导

essays.title: 增加职业技能培训投入
essays.prompt: Some people contend that countries should spend more money on skills training and vocational training rather than university education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人主张，国家应将更多资金投入技能和职业培训，而非大学教育。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 什么情况下增加职业培训经费能直接改善就业？
为什么不能从某种技能短缺直接推出应普遍削减大学投入？
essays.t: public spending on vocational training and university education|职业培训和大学教育的公共支出
essays.s: extra funding should address trade shortages without weakening necessary university courses|应增加资金填补技术工种人员短缺，同时保留必要的大学课程
a: vocational courses shorten the route into jobs that demand practical experience|职业课程缩短了进入需要实践经验的岗位所需的时间
a funded placement lets trainees work with equipment under the supervision of an experienced employee|有经费支持的实习让学员能够在有经验的员工指导下使用设备
an apprentice can show an employer work completed during the placement|学徒可以向雇主展示实习期间完成的工作
quicker recruitment of qualified local workers|更快地从本地招到合格人员
a dependable supply of skilled local workers|稳定的本地技术工人供应
public training places are justified where employers cannot fill vacancies|在企业无法填补职位空缺的地方，公费培训名额有其必要性
b: some jobs require the extended theoretical study that universities provide|有些岗位需要大学所提供的长期理论学习
future civil engineers|未来的土木工程师
a solid grounding in mathematics and materials science|扎实的数学和材料科学基础
assess a design when conditions differ from cases they have seen before|在条件与过去见过的案例不同时评估设计
a building project needs trained builders and an engineer to check design changes|一个建筑项目既需要受过训练的建筑工人，也需要工程师核查设计变更
funding only one route can leave the same project short of expertise|只资助其中一种教育路线，可能让同一个项目缺少专门人才
countries should use evidence of local needs when dividing funds between the two routes|国家在两类教育之间分配经费时，应参考当地需求的证据
z: training deserves extra funding where tradespeople are scarce, but universities still need support|技术工人不足时培训应获得更多资金，但大学仍然需要支持
placements prepare builders for work on site|实习让建筑工人为现场工作做好准备
universities train engineers to assess changes to the same building's design|大学则培养工程师评估同一栋建筑的设计变更
essays.transfer: 比较公共预算时，可以用同一个住宅项目说明两种人才各负责哪项任务，避免只说“两者都重要”。
essays.stanceSummary: 技能短缺时应扩大职训，同时保障有实际需求的大学课程
r: businesses should pay for their own training|企业应该为自身的培训付费
public grants can cover costs a firm would otherwise bear|公共补助可能替企业承担本该自付的费用
instruction applies only to one company's equipment|培训只涉及一家公司的设备
a recognised trade qualification also benefits other employers|受认可的职业资格也会让其他雇主受益
grants require a qualification recognised across the industry|补助的条件是课程能带来全行业认可的资格
subsidising company-specific training|补贴只对一家企业有用的培训
expanding vocational places where skilled workers are scarce|在技术工人稀缺的地方增加职业培训名额
essays.noun2: university study for technical professions|技术型专业所需的大学学习

essays.title: 暴力犯罪新闻的社会影响
essays.prompt: The news about violent crimes may frighten people or, on the contrary, encourage them to commit a crime. Therefore, some believe that these types of news should not be reported in newspapers or on TV. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有关暴力犯罪的新闻可能使人恐惧，也可能反过来鼓励人犯罪。因此，有人认为报纸或电视不应报道此类新闻。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 哪些报道方式可能放大恐惧或带来模仿风险？
为何仍要保留克制、经核实的公共利益报道？
essays.t: newspaper and television coverage of violent crime|报纸和电视对暴力犯罪的报道
essays.s: editors should limit sensational coverage, but a total ban would leave rumours unchallenged|编辑应限制耸动报道，而完全禁报会让谣传无人澄清
a: careful editing can spare residents unnecessary fear after a violent incident|暴力事件发生后，谨慎编辑报道可以避免居民产生不必要的恐惧
dated updates distinguish a single incident from several separate events|标明日期的更新可以帮助人们分清是同一事件还是多起不同事件
viewers can put repeated images in context|观众可以结合事件背景理解反复出现的画面
a more accurate assessment of local risk|更准确地判断当地风险
greater confidence in using public spaces again|让人们恢复使用公共场所的信心
restraint can inform the public without making one case seem like a wave of crime|克制的报道可以告知公众，同时避免把个案写得像新一轮犯罪潮
b: careful local reporting also helps communities understand what has happened|谨慎的地方报道也帮助社区了解发生的事情
residents hearing conflicting rumours|听到相互矛盾传言的居民
a trustworthy account of what has been confirmed|一份对已核实事实的可信说明
distinguish a genuine local concern from an old story circulating again|区分真正的本地问题和重新流传的旧闻
a newspaper can correct an old rumour and publish verified information about support for victims|报纸可以澄清旧谣言，并发布经过核实的受害者援助信息
newspapers and television can provide useful context while protecting the people involved|报纸和电视能在保护当事人的同时提供有用背景
reliable reporting serves the public better than silence|可靠的报道比沉默更能服务公众
z: newspapers and television should report violent crime selectively to limit the risk of fear or imitation while keeping the public informed|报纸和电视应审慎选择暴力犯罪的报道内容，既限制引发恐惧或模仿的风险，也让公众掌握情况
dated updates stop repeated images being mistaken for separate events|标明日期的更新有助于避免人们将重复出现的画面错当作多起事件
a verified local report can settle rumours without naming a victim|经核实的地方报道能够在不透露受害者姓名的情况下澄清传言
v: 结合背景理解重复出现的画面
essays.transfer: 新闻管制题可以区分“是否报道”和“怎样报道”，用核实日期、保护身份等编辑决定来说明界限。
essays.stanceSummary: 避免渲染暴力犯罪，同时保留经核实、有公共价值的报道
r: reports can give an offender unwanted influence|报道可能使作案者获得不应有的影响力
notoriety can attract imitation|恶名也可能引来模仿
coverage repeatedly highlights an offender's image|报道反复突出作案者的形象
newspapers can report consequences without making offenders famous|报纸可以报道事件后果，同时避免把作案者变成名人
editors omit personal publicity and focus on verified outcomes|编辑删去对个人的渲染，只聚焦于经过核实的结果
unnecessary publicity for offenders|对作案者的不必要宣传
responsible reporting of violent crime|对暴力犯罪负责任的报道
essays.noun2: verification of local news|对本地新闻的核实

essays.title: 公共场所的手机使用
essays.prompt: Some people think that mobile phones should be banned in public places such as libraries, shops, and public transport. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，图书馆、商店和公共交通工具等公共场所应禁止使用手机。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 哪些手机使用行为在公共场所确实会妨碍他人？
为什么规则应区分安静用途和造成干扰的用途？
essays.t: restrictions on mobile phones in public places|公共场所的手机使用限制
essays.s: public venues should restrict disruptive phone use, but a general ban on devices would inconvenience people unnecessarily|公共场所应限制造成干扰的手机使用方式，但全面禁用会给人带来不必要的不便
a: limiting audible phone use can protect a shared activity that depends on quiet|限制会发出声音的手机使用方式，可以维护依赖安静环境的公共活动
nearby readers cannot tune out a loud call or a video played through speakers|附近的读者无法自行屏蔽吵闹的电话声或外放视频声
a quiet-carriage rule allows passengers to read or rest throughout their journey|安静车厢规则使乘客在旅途中能够阅读或休息
more considerate use of shared space|让人们能更体谅他人地使用公共空间
clear expectations about conduct in quiet public areas|对安静公共场所的行为规范形成清晰预期
a restriction on sound has a clear purpose in libraries and designated train carriages|在图书馆和指定的火车车厢中，限制声音有明确目的
b: silent phone use allows people to complete useful tasks|静音使用手机能让人们完成有用的任务
travellers carrying a digital ticket|持电子票出行的旅客
access to the ticket on their phone|在手机上调出票券的机会
show proof of payment during a journey|在途中出示已付款凭证
a shopper can check a label with a translation app without interrupting a conversation|购物者可以用翻译软件查看商品标签，又不打断别人的交谈
the relevant test is whether a particular use interferes with the activity the space is meant for|应判断某种用法是否妨碍这个场所原本要开展的活动
rules should target disruption in each setting|规定应该针对各个场所的具体干扰
z: libraries, shops and public transport should limit disruptive uses while permitting silent ones|在图书馆、商店和公共交通工具上，应限制扰人的用法，同时允许静音使用
a quiet carriage lets passengers rest|安静车厢能让乘客休息
they can still show a ticket on a silent phone|乘客仍可用静音的手机出示电子车票
v: 更体谅他人的使用方式
essays.transfer: 讨论公共禁令时，需要明确受影响的是哪一种行为，以及同一设备还有哪些不会干扰他人的用法。
r: a total ban would be easier to enforce|全面禁令会更容易执行
staff have little time to settle disputes|工作人员没有多少时间处理争议
several passengers play videos in a quiet carriage|几名乘客在静音车厢中外放视频
a rule about audible sound gives staff a simple test|规定是否能发出旁人听得到的声音，就能给工作人员一个简单的判断标准
operators display clear rules about speakers and calls|运营人员明确展示有关外放和通话的规定
inconsistent enforcement|执行标准不统一
permitting quiet, useful phone activities|允许安静且有实际用途的手机使用
essays.stanceSummary: 应限制干扰他人的手机用法，保留安静且实用的功能
essays.noun2: silent phone use for practical tasks|为了实际需要而静音使用手机

essays.title: 广告感受与购买决定
essays.prompt: Some people find advertisements amusing or annoying and they are not influenced by this when they shop. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有些人觉得广告有趣或令人厌烦，并认为自己购物时不会受到这种感受的影响。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 对广告的情绪反应可能怎样在购买时发挥作用？
哪些购买条件会限制这种影响？
essays.t: the influence of amusing or irritating advertisements on shopping decisions|令人愉快或烦躁的广告对购物决定的影响
essays.s: shoppers do not always act on their feelings about adverts, but those feelings can influence purchases|消费者不一定按自己对广告的感受行事，但这些感受能够影响购买
a: a memorable advert can help a shopper identify a familiar product|令人印象深刻的广告可以帮助购物者认出熟悉的产品
a tune can keep a brand name in mind even when the music is annoying|即使音乐让人厌烦，旋律也可能让品牌名留在脑海中
a shopper choosing between two packets of biscuits recognises the name of one she enjoyed|在两包饼干间挑选时，购物者认出了自己喜欢的那一款的名字
a quicker choice between otherwise similar products|在其他方面相近的产品之间更快作出选择
repeat purchases of a brand that meets the shopper's needs|对符合自身需要的品牌形成重复购买
an irritating jingle can therefore influence a purchase without being liked|所以，即使不喜欢某段广告歌曲，购物者仍可能受它影响
b: advertising has less influence when a purchase depends on a precise requirement|购买取决于明确要求时，广告的影响较小
shoppers replacing a household appliance|正在更换家电的购物者
reliable information about dimensions and running costs|有关尺寸和运行成本的可靠信息
judge whether it will fit their kitchen and their budget|判断它是否适合自家厨房和预算
a family may enjoy a fridge advert yet reject a model too wide for its kitchen|一家人可能很喜欢冰箱广告，却因型号对厨房而言太宽而放弃购买
practical limits can outweigh a positive response when the differences between products really matter|商品之间的差异确实重要时，实际限制能够盖过对广告的好感
the influence of an advert varies with the purchase|广告的影响会随购买情境而变化
z: reactions to advertising can influence purchases, even though practical requirements sometimes take priority|对广告的感受可以影响购买，不过实际要求有时会优先
a jingle can steer a shopper towards a familiar biscuit brand|广告曲可能使购物者倾向选择熟悉的饼干品牌
no catchy advert makes an oversized fridge fit a kitchen|再吸引人的广告也不能让一台过宽的冰箱放进厨房
essays.transfer: 广告题可以分清“喜欢广告”“记住品牌”和“实际购买”，并说明这三步何时相连、何时会断开。
essays.stanceSummary: 广告激起的情绪会影响品牌记忆，但具体购买要求也起作用
r: amusing adverts may entertain without influencing a sale|逗趣的广告也许只能娱乐观众，无法影响销售
viewers sometimes remember the joke alone|观众有时只记得笑点
the product appears only briefly|产品只短暂出现
humour aids recognition if the joke includes the brand name|如果笑点中有品牌名，幽默就有助于识别产品
advertisers make the product central to the joke|广告制作方把产品放在笑点的中心
poor brand recall|对品牌记忆不清
an occasional link between emotional reactions and purchases|广告引发的感受与购买有时相关这一观点
essays.noun2: practical limits on a purchase|实际条件对购买的限制

essays.title: 科技与面对面交流
essays.prompt: Today more and more people are using mobile phones and computers. Thus, people are losing the ability to communicate face to face. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 如今越来越多人使用手机和电脑。因此，人们正在失去面对面交流的能力。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 哪一种使用习惯会减少练习当面交流的机会？
为什么设备用得多不必然意味着当面交流能力变差？
essays.t: digital communication and the ability to talk face to face|数字通信与面对面交谈能力的关系
essays.s: digital habits can weaken conversational skills when they replace practice, but device use alone need not do so|数字习惯取代练习时可能削弱交谈能力，但单纯使用设备不必然如此
a: regular face-to-face practice helps students respond to other people more sensitively|经常当面沟通能帮助学生更敏锐地回应他人
speakers can notice pauses and facial expressions that a written message leaves out|交谈者可以注意到文字信息没有呈现的停顿和面部表情
a student who notices a classmate's puzzled expression can rephrase a confusing point|学生如果看到同学露出疑惑的表情，可以换一种说法讲清楚
a quick check that both speakers understand each other|迅速确认双方已经相互理解
greater confidence in handling disagreements in person|更有信心当面处理分歧
relying entirely on editable messages would leave students fewer chances to develop these skills|如果完全依赖可编辑的消息，学生练习这些能力的机会就会减少
b: devices can also help people meet in person|电子设备也能帮助人们当面相聚
members of a club who live far apart|住得相距很远的社团成员
an easy way to agree on a meeting time|一种方便商定见面时间的方式
bring the whole group together regularly|经常把全体成员召集在一起
a walking group can arrange a Sunday outing online and then talk for hours on the trail|徒步小组可以在线安排周日出游，再在路途中聊上好几个小时
online planning can increase the time people spend talking in person|在线安排可能增加人们当面交谈的时间
what matters is the kind of contact the device replaces or makes possible|关键在于设备取代或促成了哪一种交流
z: device use weakens conversation when it displaces practice, yet it can also bring speakers together|电子设备占去练习时间时会削弱交谈能力，但也能促成人们相聚
editable messages give people little practice reading facial expressions|可以修改的文字消息很少让人练习解读面部表情
a group chat can bring walkers together for face-to-face contact|群聊却可以把徒步者约到一起，让他们有机会面对面交流
v: 换种说法解释难懂之处
essays.transfer: 回应“技术导致能力退化”时，找出减少练习的具体使用方式，再给出一种反过来增加练习的用法。
essays.stanceSummary: 设备挤占对话练习时能力可能下降，设备也能促成见面
r: phones can interrupt a conversation even when friends meet|即使朋友当面相聚，手机也可能打断交谈
notifications repeatedly draw attention away from the speaker|通知会反复使注意力离开发言者
everyone leaves the phone screen visible|所有人都让手机屏幕处于可见状态
a distraction during one meeting need not signal lost ability|一次聚会中的分心并不一定表明能力已经衰退
friends put devices away while telling a story|朋友们在讲故事时收起设备
divided attention|注意力分散
using digital tools to arrange face-to-face contact|用数字工具促成面对面接触
essays.noun2: the purpose served by a device|设备所发挥的具体作用

essays.title: 名人财富与青少年榜样
essays.prompt: Nowadays celebrities are more famous for their glamour and wealth than for their achievements, and this sets a bad example to young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 如今，名人因光鲜的生活和财富而出名的程度超过了因成就而出名的程度，这给年轻人作出了不好的示范。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 如果媒体只呈现财富，青少年会怎样理解成功？
是否所有名人和所有报道都更重视财富而非成就？
essays.t: celebrity wealth and the examples celebrities set for young people|名人财富和名人给年轻人树立的榜样
essays.s: coverage of celebrity wealth can mislead teenagers, although many stars are still known for their achievements|报道名人财富可能误导青少年，但许多名人仍以成就闻名
a: knowing how celebrities acquire expensive clothes can protect teenagers from unfair comparisons|了解明星如何得到昂贵服装，有助于保护青少年免受失当攀比的影响
luxury photographs often show a designer coat without revealing who paid for it|展示奢华生活的照片常常只拍到名牌大衣，不交代是谁付的钱
a reader who spots a sponsorship label can recognise a sales pitch|看到赞助标识的读者便能认出这是一番推销
a fairer comparison with what ordinary families can afford|更合理地对照普通家庭的负担能力
greater confidence in judging success by achievements rather than possessions|更有信心根据成就而非财物判断成功
unexplained displays of wealth leave young viewers without this context|不加说明地炫示财富，会让年轻观众丢失这些背景信息
b: public figures can also show young people how worthwhile achievements are built|公众人物也能让年轻人看到有价值的成就是如何取得的
young fans|年轻粉丝
an account of the practice behind a performance|了解演出背后训练过程的叙述
understand what an admired performer actually did to improve|理解所仰慕的表演者究竟怎样取得进步
a film of a pianist repeating a difficult passage offers a teenager an idea for the next rehearsal|记录钢琴家反复练习难段的影像能为青少年的下一次排练提供一个思路
a documentary can make persistence visible|纪录片可以让坚持变得可见
young fans need to see the practice as well as the prizes|年轻粉丝既需要看到奖项，也需要看到练习
z: celebrities set a poor example when luxury eclipses achievement, though their work can still inspire teenagers|当奢华的生活掩盖成就时，名人会树立不好的榜样，不过他们的工作也能激励青少年
luxury photographs invite teenagers to compare possessions|奢华生活照容易让青少年攀比物品
a rehearsal film shows them a technique they can practise|排练录像则能让他们看到自己可以练习的技巧
essays.transfer: 把同一位名人的消费照和练习纪录片放在一起，可分别验证题干中“因何出名”和“怎样影响年轻人”两个判断。
essays.stanceSummary: 炫富报道会误导青少年，突出成就的名人仍能起示范作用
r: teenagers can enjoy fashion without imitating a celebrity|青少年可以欣赏时尚而不去模仿名人
some viewers know that photographs are advertisements|部分观众知道这些照片其实是广告
the sponsor is clearly identified|赞助方被明确标注
undisclosed gifts are harder for inexperienced viewers to recognise|年轻观众经验不足，更难识别没有说明的赠品
publishers label sponsored clothing and explain the artist's work|发布者标注赞助服装并解释艺术家的工作
treating possessions as proof of achievement|把物质占有当成成就的证明
greater attention to what celebrities actually accomplish|更多关注名人的实际成就
essays.noun2: accounts of the work behind fame|对成名背后付出的呈现

essays.title: 网络信息与图书馆的价值
essays.prompt: Students today can easily access information online, so libraries are no longer necessary. Do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 如今学生可以在网上轻松获取信息，因此图书馆已没有存在的必要。你同意还是不同意？
ask: 能搜到材料后，学生还需要图书馆提供什么帮助？
哪些学习条件无法仅凭拥有网络连接得到？
essays.t: libraries in an age of online information|网络信息时代的图书馆
essays.s: online searches are convenient, but students still need libraries for informed guidance and an accessible place to study|网上搜索很方便，但学生仍然需要图书馆提供专业指导和容易获得的学习空间
a: librarians can help students assess the quality of online evidence|图书馆员能帮助学生判断网上证据的质量
a librarian can help a student trace a quotation back to its author and check the context|图书馆员能帮学生把引文追溯到作者，并核对原文语境
a pupil can distinguish an original account from websites repeating the same error|学生可以分清原始叙述与重复相同错误的网站
better choices of evidence for an assignment|为作业更妥当地选择证据
more independent evaluation of online claims|更独立地判断网上的说法
guidance in evaluating evidence retains its value when information is plentiful|信息充足时，指导学生评估证据仍有价值
b: libraries also provide study space regardless of conditions at home|无论家庭条件如何，图书馆也能提供学习空间
students who share a noisy bedroom|需要在嘈杂卧室里与他人共处的学生
a quiet desk and a reliable connection|一张安静的书桌和稳定的网络连接
finish an extended piece of reading without repeated interruptions|在不被反复打断的情况下读完一篇较长的材料
a student who finds an article on her phone can use a library computer to compare sources|学生用手机找到文章后，可以用图书馆的电脑对照不同来源
access to a link does not guarantee the conditions for study|获得链接不等于已经有了学习条件
libraries make online material usable beyond the classroom|图书馆让学生在课堂外也能利用网上资料
z: students still need library guidance and study space when much of their reading is online|即使许多阅读转到网上，学生依然需要图书馆的指导和学习场所
a librarian can trace a doubtful quotation|图书馆员能帮忙查清一句可疑引文的出处
a quiet desk gives a student time to check the original|安静的座位让学生有时间核对原文
v: trace a quotation back to its author
essays.transfer: 把这条思路迁移到“网络能否取代教师”时，先区分获取信息、判断信息和应用信息这三个环节。
r: library spending may seem excessive|图书馆支出可能显得过高
digital texts can leave reading rooms nearly empty|电子文本可能让阅览室几乎空无一人
all course materials are available online|课程材料都能在线获得
students still need a place to seek individual advice|学生依然需要能单独求教的地方
colleges share reading rooms and book librarians for group sessions|院校共用阅览室，并预约图书馆员开展小组指导
the cost of underused space|利用不足的空间所产生的成本
maintaining a library service for students|为学生保留图书馆服务
essays.stanceSummary: 网络方便搜索，图书馆仍提供资料指导和公平的学习空间
essays.noun2: access to shared study facilities|使用公共学习设施的机会

essays.title: 城市植树与住房建设
essays.prompt: Some people think that it is more important to plant more trees in open areas in towns and cities than provide more housing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，相较于提供更多住房，在城镇的空地上种更多树更重要。你在多大程度上同意？
ask: 什么样的空地优先种树会直接改善居民生活？
在住房紧缺时，为什么不可把每片城市空地都用来植树？
essays.t: trees and housing on open urban land|城市空地上的植树与住房建设

easier access to the stop throughout the day|让人们在一天中各时段都能更舒适地使用公交站
a street that pedestrians can use comfortably during the hottest months|让行人在最热的月份也能舒适使用的街道
heavily used public routes deserve priority for planting|人流量大的公共通行路线值得优先植树

low-income households|低收入家庭
a supply of affordable homes within reach of local jobs|位于本地工作岗位可达范围内的平价住房供应
avoid long commutes that consume both time and wages|避免耗费时间和工资的长途通勤
