some sites can help meet housing demand while still contributing to the city's tree cover|某些地块既能满足住房需求，也能为城市的树木覆盖作贡献
the more pressing local shortage should guide the choice|应当根据当地哪项需求更迫切来作选择
z: busy, exposed public routes need more trees, while suitable brownfield sites can provide affordable homes|缺少遮蔽的繁忙道路需要更多树木，而合适的已开发闲置土地可以用于建设可负担住房
shade makes a bus stop usable in summer|树荫让乘客在夏天也能安心候车
flats near the station spare working families a lengthy commute|车站附近的住房能让工薪家庭免于漫长通勤
v: 因价格太高而负担不起住房
从住处可到达本地工作地点
essays.transfer: 城市用地题可以比较两块用途不同的地，一块解决遮阴问题，一块解决通勤距离问题，给出清楚的优先条件。
essays.stanceSummary: 无树荫的通道应优先植树，住房紧缺的地块则可建房
r: building on open land may destroy wildlife corridors|在空地上建房可能破坏野生动物通道
birds use continuous tree cover to move between feeding sites|鸟类需要利用连片的树木遮蔽在觅食地之间移动
a wooded strip links two parks|一条林带连接着两个公园
an abandoned car park does not serve the same purpose|废弃停车场并不具有同样的作用
planners protect wooded strips and identify previously developed sites|规划者保护林带，并找出曾经开发过的地块
habitat fragmentation|栖息地破碎化
building homes on suitable urban plots|在合适的城市用地上建房
essays.noun2: affordable housing near workplaces|工作地点附近的可负担住房

essays.title: 适应与阻止气候变化
essays.prompt: Some people think that instead of preventing climate change, we need to find a way to live with it. Do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 有人认为，我们应当想办法适应气候变化，而不再设法阻止它。你同意还是不同意？
ask: 适应办法能怎样减轻已经出现的影响？
为什么只靠适应不足以取代限制未来变暖的行动？
essays.t: climate adaptation and efforts to limit warming|气候适应与减缓变暖的努力
essays.s: communities must adapt to changes already under way and continue working to limit warming|社区必须适应已经发生的变化，并继续努力限制变暖
a: adapting public facilities can protect residents from heat they already experience|调整公共设施能更好地应对居民已经遭遇的高温
an exposed school playground becomes difficult to use during the hottest hours|没有遮蔽的学校操场在最热的时段很难使用
shade and rescheduled outdoor sessions let pupils take breaks in cooler areas|增设遮阳处并调整户外活动时段后，学生可以在较凉爽的区域休息
continued use of school grounds during hot weather|在炎热天气下继续使用校园场地
facilities that remain usable as local conditions change|当地气候条件变化时仍可使用的设施
communities can protect pupils before wider measures affect temperatures|无需等待更大规模的措施影响气温，社区现在就能保护学生
b: adaptation alone cannot limit the emissions driving further warming|单凭适应无法控制推动气候进一步变暖的排放
communities trying to limit future risks|努力限制未来风险的社区
ways to cut emissions from everyday energy use|减少日常能源使用所产生排放的办法
influence the scale of the changes they will need to cope with|影响未来所需应对变化的规模
one school can shade its yard and replace a fossil-fuel boiler with low-carbon heating|同一所学校既能给操场增设遮阳，也能以低碳供暖替换燃烧化石燃料的锅炉
one renovation can meet an immediate need and lower future emissions|一次改造既能满足眼前需要，也能减少今后的排放
both uses of public money have a clear purpose|公共资金的这两种用途各有明确目的
z: adaptation to existing change should accompany continued efforts to limit warming|在适应现有变化的同时，仍应继续努力限制升温
shade in schoolyards can go hand in hand with cleaner heating|校园遮阳可以与改用清洁供暖同步进行
one renovation can address both today's heat and tomorrow's emissions|同一次改造可以兼顾当下的高温和今后的排放
essays.transfer: 用同一所学校的遮阴与供热方案，分别说明“应对已经出现的后果”和“减缓未来变化”。
essays.stanceSummary: 既要应对已经出现的高温，也应限制未来进一步变暖
r: local budgets should focus entirely on immediate adaptation|地方预算应该全部用于眼前的适应工作
flooded homes need repairs before families can return|遭洪水侵袭的住房必须修复后居民才能返家
a storm damages a whole neighbourhood|一场风暴损毁整个街区
repairs also create opportunities to reduce energy use|修复工作也能提供降低能耗的机会
councils choose efficient equipment when replacing flood-damaged systems|地方政府在替换受洪水破坏的系统时选用高效设备
energy waste during reconstruction|重建中延续的能源浪费
combining adaptation with emissions cuts|把适应措施与减排结合起来
essays.noun2: emissions reductions alongside adaptation|在适应变化的同时减少排放

essays.title: 居家办公对员工和雇主的影响
essays.prompt: Many employees can now do their work from home by using modern technology. However, this change may only benefit workers, not the employers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 许多员工如今可以借助现代科技居家办公。然而，这一变化可能只给员工带来好处，雇主并未受益。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 雇主可以通过怎样的办公安排真正节省开支？
结合员工的收益，说明企业在什么情况下也能留住人才。
essays.t: the effects of working from home on employees and employers|居家办公对员工和雇主的影响
essays.s: employees gain flexibility, but employers can also save money and retain experienced staff|员工获得了灵活性，雇主也能节省开支并留住有经验的员工
a: home working can lower an employer's demand for office space|居家办公可以减少雇主对办公面积的需求
teams that meet on different days can share desks and meeting rooms|在不同日子到办公室的团队可以共用工位和会议室
a firm approaching the end of its lease can move into smaller premises|租约快到期的企业可以搬进面积更小的办公场所
lower monthly spending on rent, heating and cleaning|降低每月的租金、供暖和清洁开支
more money for equipment or training that the business previously postponed|为企业原先推迟的设备采购或培训腾出更多资金
reduced overheads are a measurable benefit to employers|管理运营开支的下降是雇主可以量化的一项收益
b: flexible arrangements can help employers keep people with valuable knowledge|灵活安排能帮助雇主留住掌握重要知识的员工
employees with long commutes and family commitments|通勤时间长且需要照顾家庭的员工
some control over where they work during the week|在一周中对工作地点的一定选择权
combine a full working day with collecting a child from school|在完成全天工作的同时接孩子放学
a senior designer might stay if two days at home make school collection possible|如果两天居家办公能让她按时接孩子，资深设计师可能会选择留下
flexibility can save the business the cost of recruiting a replacement|灵活安排可以为企业省下招聘替代人选的费用
both parties can gain where the job suits remote work|在适合远程工作的岗位上，双方都能受益
z: flexible work can benefit employers through lower costs as well as offering workers greater control|灵活办公既能通过降低成本惠及雇主，也能让员工更自主地安排工作
sharing desks saves rent|共用工位可以节省租金
keeping an experienced designer saves the time needed to train a replacement|留住有经验的设计师可节省培训接替者所需的时间
v: 迁入面积较小的办公场所
essays.transfer: 题干里的 only 要用一个清楚的雇主收益来回应，例如节省租金；单写员工少通勤还不够。
essays.stanceSummary: 居家办公既给员工弹性，也让雇主节省场地支出、留住人才
r: new employees learn less easily at a distance|新员工在远程条件下可能更难学习
quick questions are harder to ask|临时遇到问题时不太方便提问
the entire team works from home|整个团队都居家办公
some tasks can still be scheduled on site|有些任务仍可以安排在现场完成

limited access to mentoring|获得导师指导的机会不足
flexible work for suitable roles|为适合的岗位提供灵活办公
essays.noun2: staff retention|员工留任

essays.title: 企业盈利与社会责任
essays.prompt: As well as making money, businesses also have social responsibilities. Do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 除了赚钱，企业还要承担社会责任。你同意还是不同意？
ask: 企业的哪些经营决定会影响顾客以外的人？

essays.s: businesses should earn a return while taking responsibility for the effects of their operations on others|企业在获得回报的同时，应对其经营活动给他人带来的影响负责

new employees learning to use unfamiliar equipment|学习使用陌生设备的新员工
supervised practice during paid working hours|在带薪工作时间里接受指导并练习的机会
carry out their tasks safely and independently|安全、独立地完成工作
a warehouse can assign a supervisor to new recruits before their first full shift|仓库可以在新人第一次上完整班次前为他们安排主管指导

z: companies should pursue profit while protecting workers and neighbours from harm their operations can prevent|企业应追求利润，同时保护员工和邻里免受其经营活动中可以预防的损害

essays.stanceSummary: 企业除盈利外，还应保护员工并减少对周边居民的伤害
r: small firms cannot meet every social demand|小企业没有能力满足每项社会要求

essays.title: 所有父亲在孩子出生时获休假权

regular free evenings or weekends|规律可支配的晚上或周末

essays.noun2: immediate public protection|对公众的即时保护

essays.title: 青少年与成年罪犯的处置
essays.prompt: Young people who commit crimes should be treated in the same way as adults. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 青少年犯罪后应该与成年人受到同样的处理。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

essays.title: 非必要长途飞行的限制

ask: 哪些非必要飞行最容易由其他方式取代？
为什么减少不必要飞行仍不能代替处理日常汽车使用？
essays.t: policies to discourage non-essential flights and limit car use|抑制非必要飞行与限制汽车使用的政策
essays.s: discouraging avoidable flights is sensible, but cities should also tackle car journeys with practical alternatives|抑制可避免的飞行是合理的，但城市也应处理那些有可行替代方式的驾车行程

commuters living beside a busy suburban route|住在繁忙郊区线路沿线的通勤者
a frequent bus service at the times they work|一条运营时段配合工作时间且班次密集的公交线路
leave their cars at home on ordinary working days|在普通工作日把车留在家中

essays.noun2: alternatives to routine car journeys|日常驾车出行的替代方案

essays.title: 本国援助与国际援助

funding participation puts a public resource within reach of many more families|资助实际参与，能让更多家庭用上公共资源

children excited by an international tournament|因国际赛事而兴奋的孩子们
a nearby team willing to welcome beginners|一支愿意接纳初学者的本地队伍
turn a wish to copy their heroes into a weekly activity|把模仿偶像的愿望转化为每周的活动
after watching a final, a child may want to play but find a full waiting list at the local club|孩子看完决赛也想上场，却可能发现附近俱乐部的候补名单已满
a local coach and an available place turn inspiration into practice|附近有教练又有名额，孩子才能把受到的鼓舞变成实际练习
public funding should connect watching a sport with playing it|公共经费应帮助孩子把观看比赛的兴致变成亲身参与
z: grassroots programmes deserve the larger share while selected elite teams retain support|基层体育项目应获得更多经费，同时继续支持部分精英运动队
shared kit removes the cost of trying a sport|公用器材免去了试学运动时购买装备的费用
an available club place lets an inspired child keep playing|俱乐部有名额，受偶像激励的孩子才能继续练下去
v: 取得国际赛事参赛资格
essays.transfer: 题目比较两笔投入，例子要把「看偶像比赛」和「得到每周训练的名额」之间缺少的条件写出来。
essays.stanceSummary: 体育经费应更多惠及儿童，同时保留能发挥示范作用的精英训练
r: cutting elite funding now could waste years of preparation|现在削减精英运动经费可能浪费多年的备战
athletes depend on uninterrupted coaching before competition|运动员在参赛前依赖连续的教练指导
a team has already qualified for an international event|一支队伍已取得国际赛事的参赛资格
future grants can favour beginners without cancelling existing commitments|未来拨款可以优先照顾初学者，同时履行已经作出的承诺
authorities honour existing training grants until the event ends|主管部门在赛事结束前继续兑现已有训练经费
an abrupt withdrawal of funding|突然撤回经费
greater investment in children's sport|增加儿童体育投入
essays.noun2: access to beginner coaching|接受入门指导的机会

essays.title: 旧建筑修复与新住房道路建设的公共支出
essays.prompt: The restoration of old buildings in major cities in the world costs numerous governments’ expenditures. This money should be used in new housing and road development. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 在世界各地的大城市，许多政府修复旧建筑花费甚多。有人认为，这些钱应投入新住房和道路建设。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 修复怎样的建筑既能满足今天的用途又能保留历史？
何时住房或道路的紧迫需求应该优先？
essays.t: restoration budgets and the need for new housing and roads|建筑修复预算与新建住房、道路的需求
essays.s: cities should preserve old buildings that can still serve residents and give new housing or roads priority where shortages are acute|城市应保留仍能服务居民的旧建筑，在住房或道路严重不足时则优先新建
a: restoring a sound building can retain part of a city's history and meet a current need|修复结构完好的建筑，既能保存城市的一段历史，也能满足当下需要
an old market hall may already stand close to homes and public transport|一座老市场大厅可能原本就靠近居民点和公共交通站点
repairing the roof and fitting accessible entrances can reopen the hall as a neighbourhood library|修复屋顶并加设无障碍入口，就能把这座大厅重新开放为社区图书馆
daily use of an existing site by people living nearby|让周边居民得以日常使用现有场地
a public facility with a distinctive character and an established place in local life|形成一处特色鲜明且融入当地生活的公共设施
restoration merits funding when a building still serves the neighbourhood|一幢建筑仍能服务社区时，修复它就值得投入
b: housing and transport projects should take precedence when restoration offers little usable space|当修复工程几乎不能增加可用空间时，住房和交通项目应当优先
families living in overcrowded temporary rooms|住在拥挤临时房间里的家庭
affordable homes connected to schools and workplaces|与学校及工作场所有交通连接的可负担住房
establish a stable routine for work and study|建立稳定的工作和学习作息
a council could fund flats and an access road before restoring the decorative front of a vacant office|地方政府可以先建公寓和连接道路，再修复空置办公楼的装饰性外立面
public use and local shortages help distinguish essential projects from decorative ones|公众用途和当地实际短缺能够帮助区分必需工程与装饰性工程
urgent housing needs may outweigh the appeal of restoring a façade|迫切的住房需求可能比修复外立面更重要
z: a useful building deserves repair, while acute housing shortages justify new construction|有用途的建筑值得维修，而严重住房短缺也构成新建的充分理由
a repaired market hall can serve as a library|修复的市场大厅可以用作图书馆
families in crowded rooms may need flats and access roads first|挤在狭小房间里的家庭可能更急需住房及其连接道路
v: retain part of a city's history
保留一座城市的部分历史
当地短缺的设施或服务
essays.transfer: 新用途越具体，越好判断修复一个建筑是否比把同一预算投给住房和道路更合适。
essays.stanceSummary: 住房或道路需求紧迫时应新建，有公共用途的旧建筑值得修复
r: restoration can swallow funds needed for housing|修复工程可能耗尽住房所需的资金

an attractive building has unstable foundations|一幢外观漂亮的楼房地基不稳
a structural survey can distinguish a viable conversion from an unsafe one|结构勘察能够辨别改造方案是否可行、安全
councils obtain an independent survey before allocating funds|地方政府在分配资金前请独立机构做勘察
committing money to unsound buildings|把经费投给结构不安全的建筑
selective restoration alongside new construction|在新建项目之外有选择地修复旧建筑
essays.noun2: the shortage of usable homes|可用住房的短缺

essays.title: 政府提供免费住房
essays.prompt: As housing is a basic need for people, the government should provide free housing for everyone who cannot afford it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 住房是人的基本需要，因此政府应该向每一个买不起或负担不起住房的人提供免费住房。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 哪些人需要马上获得免租的稳定住所？
对付不起市价但仍有稳定收入的人，哪种支持更合适？
essays.t: the provision of free housing to people who cannot afford a home|向无力负担住房的人提供免费住所
essays.s: everyone should have access to safe housing, with free accommodation reserved for those unable to contribute towards rent|人人都应有安全住所，免租住房应留给无力承担任何租金的人
a: immediate free accommodation can interrupt the cycle that keeps a homeless family in crisis|及时提供免费住所，可以打断让无家可归家庭一直陷于危机的循环
searching for a bed each night leaves little time to deal with school or employment|每天晚上都要找地方睡觉，会让家庭没有多少时间处理上学或求职的事情
a stable address gives parents a place to receive letters and arrange appointments|稳定的住址让父母有地方收信，也能够安排面谈
regular school attendance and a more organised search for work|让孩子能规律上学，也让家长能更有条理地找工作
a family's ability to meet at least part of its housing costs again|让家庭重新有能力承担至少一部分住房费用
charging rent immediately would put emergency support beyond the reach of homeless families|立即收租会让无家可归的家庭无法获得紧急援助
b: people unable to pay market rent have different levels of need|付不起市场租金的人，其实际困难程度并不相同
local housing departments deciding whom to assist|决定援助对象的地方住房部门
information about household income and local rents|有关家庭收入和当地租金的信息
offer the right level of support from a limited budget|在有限预算下提供与需要相称的支持
a shop worker may manage a reduced rent while a family with no income needs the entire cost covered|商店雇员也许付得起较低的租金，而没有收入的家庭需要全额补助
affordable rent contributions help the same budget support more households|收取各家负担得起的部分租金，能让同一笔预算支持更多家庭
a housing guarantee can accommodate different abilities to pay|住房保障可以兼顾不同的支付能力
z: governments should guarantee safe housing and waive rent entirely for households that cannot afford any contribution|政府应保障安全住所，并为完全无力付租的家庭免除全部租金
a stable address lets parents apply for work|固定住址方便家长求职
affordable contributions leave funds for other families waiting for help|量力缴付的租金能为其他等待援助的家庭留出资金
essays.transfer: 回应 everyone 时，先区分完全没有收入和收入不足以付市价两种情况，再解释支持力度为何不同。
essays.stanceSummary: 应保障安全住所，无力付租的家庭免租，其他家庭按能力缴费
r: checking who can pay may delay emergency help|核查申请人的支付能力可能耽搁紧急援助
families in crisis may have lost their documents|陷入危机的家庭可能已遗失证件
tenants are evicted at short notice|租户突然被要求搬离
temporary accommodation can be offered before an income assessment|可以先提供临时住所，再核查收入
councils arrange an immediate placement and assess income later|地方政府先立即安置，随后再核查收入
waiting for proof of income|等待提供收入证明
housing assistance based on need|按需提供住房援助
essays.noun2: rent contributions within people's means|负担得起的租金分摊

essays.title: 博物馆文物归还原属国
essays.prompt: Historical objects in museums all over the world should be returned to their country of origin. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 世界各地博物馆中的历史文物应该归还其原属国。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 什么样的取得历史使返还文物尤其有理由？
自愿出借等情形为什么需要分别判断？
essays.t: the return of historical museum objects to their countries of origin|博物馆历史文物是否应归还原属国
essays.s: objects taken without genuine consent should normally be returned, while voluntary exchanges deserve separate consideration|未经真正同意被取走的文物通常应归还，而自愿交换的物品则应区别处理

a distant museum may keep historical objects out of reach of the communities they represent|远方的博物馆会让相关社群难以接触代表自身历史的物件
local curators can display a returned ceremonial object alongside testimony from elders|当地策展人可以将归还的礼仪用品与长者口述一并展出
lessons in which children can connect a familiar story to a physical object|让孩子能在课堂上把熟悉的故事与真实物品联系起来
stronger local control over how that heritage is understood and passed on|让当地人更能决定如何理解并传承这份遗产
lack of genuine consent makes the case for return especially strong|如果当初没有获得真正同意，归还就更有充分理由
b: the country of origin alone cannot settle every museum claim|仅靠原属国并不能裁定每一项博物馆文物索还要求
museums examining an ownership claim|研究归属主张的博物馆
records of how an object was acquired and the terms of any agreement|关于物件取得方式和各项协议条款的记录
decide together whether a return, a loan or a shared exhibition is appropriate|共同决定应当返还、出借，还是联合展出

respecting a donor's instructions preserves the choice they actually made|尊重捐赠人的指示能维护其真实选择
consent matters alongside geographical origin|归属地以外，当初是否同意也很重要
z: museums should return objects taken without permission and honour freely agreed terms|博物馆应归还未经允许带走的物品，并遵守当事人自愿认可的条款

v: records of how an object was acquired
有关藏品取得过程的记录

returning objects taken without consent|归还未经同意带走的藏品
essays.stanceSummary: 未经同意取得的文物通常应归还，自愿交换则应另行判断
essays.noun2: the circumstances of acquisition|取得藏品时的具体情形

essays.title: 负责任旅游的可行性
essays.prompt: In recent years, responsible tourists' have paid attention to preserving both culture and environment of the places they visit. However, some people say that it is impossible to be a responsible tourist. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 近年来，负责任的游客开始重视保护目的地的文化和环境。然而，有人认为，成为一名负责任的游客是不可能的。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 游客如何在文化活动中把决定权留给当地居民？
哪些可观察的行为能减少对目的地环境的干扰？
essays.t: the possibility of responsible tourism|负责任旅游的可行性
essays.s: responsible tourism is possible when visitors respect local decisions and actively reduce the damage their trips may cause|只要游客尊重当地人的决定并主动减少旅行带来的损害，就有可能做到负责任旅游
a: visitors can support a community's control over how its traditions are presented|游客可以支持一个社群自己决定如何展示其传统
residents may welcome people at a public festival while wanting a family ceremony to remain private|居民可能欢迎大家参加公共节日，同时希望家庭仪式保持私密
a group that asks before entering or taking photographs gives its hosts a real choice|旅行团在进入场地或拍照之前先询问，就给了主人真正的选择权
visits that residents can welcome on their own terms|让居民能按自己认可的条件接待来访者
continued local confidence in sharing selected traditions with outsiders|让当地人长久保持向外来者分享部分传统的信心
asking permission turns cultural respect into a choice that hosts can actually exercise|先征得同意，才能让主人真正行使自己的选择权，从而体现文化尊重
b: visitors can also change the pressure they place on a fragile landscape|游客也可以改变自己给脆弱自然环境带来的压力
walkers entering a protected coastal area|进入海岸保护区的徒步游客
clear information about marked paths and seasonal closures|有关指定步道与季节性封闭区域的明确信息
choose a route that avoids disturbing nesting birds|选择一条不会惊扰筑巢鸟类的路线
a group can use a boardwalk overlooking the beach even when a shorter route crosses the nesting ground|即使穿过筑巢地的路线更短，旅行团仍可选择俯瞰海滩的木栈道
visitors to the same beach can make informed choices with very different effects on wildlife|去同一片海滩的游客也能作出知情选择，而不同选择对野生动物的影响大不相同
visitors remain responsible for harm they can reasonably prevent|游客仍应对自己能够合理预防的伤害负责
z: responsible tourists can respect local customs and reduce avoidable damage to the landscape|负责任的游客能够尊重当地习俗，减少对自然景观可避免的破坏
asking first lets hosts decide who attends a ceremony|先征得同意让主人决定谁可以参加仪式
taking the marked path leaves nesting birds undisturbed|沿指定步道行走，有助于让筑巢的鸟免受打扰
v: 按他们自己认可的条件
essays.transfer: 这题里的 impossible 是绝对判断，给出一个游客真正能选择、且两种选择后果不同的场景就有回应力。
essays.stanceSummary: 尊重当地文化决定并主动减轻环境损害，游客可以做到负责任
r: all tourism causes some environmental damage|所有旅游都会产生一定环境损害
even a considerate visitor must travel|即便体贴周到的游客也要出行
a destination can be reached only by air|某目的地只能乘机到达
responsibility involves reducing harm that a traveller can reasonably avoid|负责任意味着减少游客力所能及、可以避免的损害
travellers replace repeated short trips with one longer stay|游客把反复短途往返改为一次较长的停留
unnecessary journeys|不必要的行程
responsible travel|负责任的旅行方式
essays.noun2: respect for seasonal closures|遵守季节性封闭规定

essays.title: 现场演出与电视观看
essays.prompt: There is no need to attend a live performance (for example, a play or concert) because seeing it at home on television is better. To what extent do you agree or disagree??
essays.q: 有人认为，没有必要去现场看戏剧或音乐会等演出，因为在家通过电视观看更好。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
ask: 现场表演有哪些参与方式很难经由电视获得？
对哪些观众来说，在家看演出反而更好？
essays.t: the relative merits of live and televised performances|现场演出与电视转播各自的价值
essays.s: television makes performances more accessible, but it cannot make attending in person unnecessary|电视让更多人看得到演出，却不能使现场观看变得毫无必要
a: a live audience can influence the timing and atmosphere of a performance|现场观众能够影响演出的节奏和气氛
performers hear the laughter, silence or applause in the room and can respond to it immediately|演员能听到场内的笑声、寂静或掌声，并立即作出回应
an actor may pause until laughter dies down so the next line can be heard|演员可能等笑声落下后再继续，让下一句台词不被盖过
an exchange between audience and performers that varies with each show|使演员与观众形成每场都略有不同的交流
a lasting attachment to a venue where each performance feels slightly different|让人对每场体验都略有不同的演出场馆产生长久的感情
a recording cannot recreate that shared timing|录像无法重现这种共同掌握节奏的体验
b: home viewing opens performances to people who cannot make the journey to a theatre|在家观看让无法前往剧院的人也能欣赏演出
audience members who live far from a major theatre|住处远离大型剧院的观众
affordable travel and enough time for the return journey|负担得起的交通以及足够的往返时间
see a short production on a weekday evening|在工作日晚上观看一场不长的演出
a family can enjoy a televised opera that would otherwise require an overnight trip|一户家庭可以在家观看转播的歌剧；到现场本来需要在外过夜
broadcasting can bring a performance to people who would have had no access to it|转播可以把演出带给那些原本没有机会看到它的人
convenience alone cannot decide which format is better|不能只凭便利程度判断哪种观看方式更好
z: home viewing expands access but cannot replace the exchange that live performance allows|在家观看能扩大观众范围，但不能取代现场演出中的互动
laughter in the room can change an actor's timing|现场笑声能改变演员说台词的时机
a broadcast brings the play to families far from a theatre|转播则让远离剧院的家庭也能看到这部戏
essays.transfer: 比较看电视和看现场时，把「气氛好」写成演员听到笑声后停顿、观众因此听清下一句台词。
essays.stanceSummary: 电视方便无法到场者，现场观众参与形成的体验仍有价值
r: television offers a clearer view than a theatre seat|电视比坐在剧场里看得更清楚
cameras can show subtle facial expressions|镜头能呈现细微的面部表情
a viewer would otherwise sit behind a pillar|观众在现场只能坐在柱子后面
visibility varies between seats and venues|观看视野好坏因座位和场地而异
theatres identify restricted-view seats when selling tickets|剧场售票时明确标出视野受限的座位
poor sightlines|观演视线不佳
attending selected performances in person|有选择地到场观看演出
essays.noun2: access for distant audiences|远方观众的观看机会

essays.title: 移居海外与当地习俗
essays.prompt: If people go to live in another country, they should follow the local customs and traditions. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essays.q: 如果人们移居别国生活，就应该遵循当地的习俗和传统。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

the trust that makes it easier to share information or offer help|建立有助于分享信息和互相帮助的信任

children growing up between two cultures|在两种文化之间长大的儿童
opportunities to practise their family's language and traditions at home|在家使用家庭语言和参与传统活动的机会
maintain a meaningful connection with older relatives|与年长亲属维系有意义的联系
children can join the local winter festival and still prepare a traditional meal with their grandparents on another holiday|孩子们可以参加当地的冬日节庆，也可以在另一个节日与祖父母一起准备传统餐食

integration allows room for private traditions|融入本地生活也能为私人传统留下空间
z: newcomers should respect customs affecting neighbours without giving up private traditions|新来者应尊重影响邻里的习俗，同时保留自己的私人传统

family celebrations keep children connected to older relatives|家庭节庆让孩子与长辈保持联系
essays.transfer: 写文化融入时，区分会影响共同空间的行为与家中自行决定的习惯，再界定同意的程度。
r: departing from traditional greetings may seem impolite|不按传统方式问候可能被视作不礼貌
people may mistake unfamiliar behaviour for disrespect|人们可能误把陌生的行为看成不尊重

misunderstandings over greetings|因问候方式不同而产生的误解
selective adaptation to local customs|有选择地适应当地习俗
essays.stanceSummary: 移居者应尊重影响共同生活的习惯，也能保留无害的家庭传统
essays.noun2: the continuity of family traditions|家庭传统的延续

essays.title: 城市功能区域的分离
essays.prompt: In many cities, planners build shops, schools, offices, and homes in specific areas which may be separated from each other. Do you think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?

shoppers who need to compare several models can walk between stores on the same street|需要比较几种型号的顾客可以沿着同一条街走访几家店铺
a family buying a washing machine can collect quotations from three shops in one afternoon|要买洗衣机的家庭可以在一个下午拿到三家店铺的报价
a better-informed purchase without several separate journeys|无需分几趟出门就能作出更明智的购买决定
the survival of specialist shops that benefit from the same stream of customers|依靠同一批路过顾客的专卖店能够维持经营

b: strictly separating different uses makes far more ordinary journeys unnecessarily long|严格隔开不同功能区会让更多日常行程无谓地变长
parents travelling with small children|带幼儿出门的家长
a school or food shop within walking distance of home|从家中步行就能到达的学校或食品店

z: everyday services belong in residential districts, while some specialist uses can reasonably cluster elsewhere|日常服务应设在住宅区，某些专业服务则可在别处合理集中

a nearby school or grocer can save a family a trip every day|就近的学校或食品店能让家庭每天都少跑一趟
essays.q: 在许多城市，规划者把商店、学校、办公室和住宅分别建在特定区域，这些区域可能彼此分隔。你认为这样做的好处大于坏处吗？
ask: 将同类设施集中在一起，能为哪些出行节省时间？
为什么完全分区给居民造成的日常代价更大？
essays.t: the separation of shops, schools, offices and homes into different urban districts|把商店、学校、办公室和住宅安排在不同的城区
essays.s: keeping everyday services apart generally costs residents more time than grouping specialist shops saves|把日常服务设施分开通常会使居民损失更多时间，超过集中专卖店所节省的时间
essays.transfer: 权衡时比较两种出行的发生频率，同样是节省时间，每天接孩子和偶尔买家电的分量不同。
essays.stanceSummary: 彻底分隔住宅、学校和商店会拉长日常路程，超过集中布置的便利
r: putting homes close to shops may disturb residents' sleep|商店紧邻住宅可能扰民、影响睡眠
unloading heavy goods makes noise|卸载重货会产生噪声
lorry deliveries arrive before dawn|货车在黎明前到货
only particular activities need separating from homes|只有特定活动才需要与住家隔开
planners provide separate loading areas and daytime delivery hours|规划人员单设装卸区，并规定在白天送货
early-morning deliveries|清晨送货
mixed neighbourhoods for everyday services|兼有日常服务设施的混合街区
essays.noun2: the frequency of essential trips|必要行程发生的频率

essays.title: 国家差异减少：共享影视时尚广告的弊利权衡
essays.prompt: Differences between countries are becoming less evident each year. Nowadays all over the world, people share the same films, fashion, brands, advertising and TV channels. To what extent do the disadvantages outweigh the advantages?
a: familiar films and television programmes can give strangers from different countries something to discuss|熟悉的电影和电视节目能让来自不同国家的陌生人有话可聊

new classmates on an exchange programme have an easy way to start their first conversation|交换项目的新同学很容易由此展开第一次交谈
further conversations about how audiences in their home countries interpreted the film|继续讨论各自国家的观众怎样理解这部影片
friendships sustained after the exchange ends|使交流结束后友谊仍能延续
a common reference helps newcomers find common ground|共同熟悉的事物能帮初识的人找到共同点
b: global brands and films compete with local work for limited shelf and screen space|全球品牌和影片与本土作品争夺有限的货架和银幕空间
independent directors working in a regional language|使用当地语言拍片的独立导演
a regular place on local cinema schedules|本地影院排片表中的稳定位置
earn enough from one production to finance the next|从一部作品获得足够收入来资助下一部
a town's only cinema may give every evening slot to heavily advertised imports|小镇唯一的影院可能把所有夜间档期都留给大力宣传的进口影片
residents can lose access to films in their own language despite wanting to see them|即使居民想看用自己语言拍摄的电影，也可能失去观看机会
the loss of local production is harder to reverse than a conversational barrier|地方生产能力消失，比沟通上的隔阂更难挽回
z: cultural uniformity brings greater losses wherever local creators lose access to their audience|在本土创作者无法触达观众的地方，文化趋同带来的损失更大

essays.q: 各国之间的差异正逐年变得不那么明显。如今世界各地的人接触相同的电影、时尚、品牌、广告和电视频道。你认为这种现象的坏处在多大程度上超过好处？

essays.t: increasingly similar films, fashions and brands around the world|世界各地越来越相似的电影、时尚和品牌
essays.s: shared popular culture eases communication, but its disadvantages are considerably greater where local producers have few outlets|共同的流行文化有助于交流，但在本地创作者缺少发行渠道的地方，其弊端大得多
essays.transfer: 写本地服饰或广告时，也可以追问谁控制货架或投放位置，以及本地商家失去渠道后会怎样。
essays.stanceSummary: 全球流行文化方便交流，但本土作品缺少发行渠道时损失更大
r: international distribution can support regional films|国际发行也能支持地方电影
overseas ticket sales may finance a director's next production|海外票房可能资助导演的下一部作品

losing access to screens at home|失去在本国上映的机会
protecting local outlets within an international market|在国际市场中保护本土传播渠道
essays.noun2: space for regional filmmaking|为地方电影保留的空间

essays.title: 青年无偿社区服务
essays.prompt: It has been suggested that all young adults should be required to undertake a period of unpaid work helping people in the community. Would the drawbacks of such a requirement be greater than the benefits to the community and the individual young adults?

a more dependable weekly delivery round|更可靠的每周配送安排
lasting ties between volunteers and housebound neighbours|促进志愿者与难以外出的邻里建立持久联系

paid leave or enough savings to replace lost wages|带薪假期或足以弥补工资损失的存款
afford a month away from their regular job|负担得起离开原有岗位一个月的代价
a charity shift might cost a shop assistant the wages needed for electricity|一次慈善值班可能使店员损失原本用于交电费的工资
compulsion takes spare time from some participants and essential income from others|强制要求占用一些人的空余时间，却夺走另一些人的生活费

z: the extra help secured by compulsion rarely justifies depriving young workers of essential earnings|强制安排带来的额外帮助，通常不足以抵偿年轻劳动者损失的必要收入

essays.q: 有人建议，所有青年都应被要求拿出一段时间，无偿工作以帮助社区居民。这样的要求给社区和青年本人带来的好处，会小于其弊端吗？

essays.transfer: 题干同时写了社区和青年，例子中要能指出居民获得了哪项服务、青年练到了哪种能力。
essays.stanceSummary: 强制无偿服务尤其加重低收入青年的负担，灵活并报销费用更好
r: compulsory service could fill gaps in community care|强制服务可以弥补社区照护缺口
voluntary rotas do not always cover every weekday|志愿者轮值无法保证每个工作日都有人

unpaid recruits losing wages may also miss shifts|因无薪服务蒙受工资损失的人也可能缺勤
organisers pay part-time staff to cover essential calls|组织者聘用兼职人员负责不可中断的电话服务
gaps in essential services|基本服务出现空档
flexible voluntary placements|灵活的自愿服务岗位
essays.noun2: differences in the cost of taking part|参与者所承担成本的差异

essays.title: 全球与跨季食品供应
essays.prompt: In the past, people ate local food in season. Nowadays, people buy a variety of food from all over the world and any season. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?

school kitchens can buy dried beans brought in by sea after a local crop fails|本地作物歉收后，学校食堂可以买到海运而来的干豆
uninterrupted meals for pupils throughout the winter|保障学生整个冬季用餐不断
a more dependable supply of affordable food in cold regions|使寒冷地区的平价食品供应更加可靠

keep distant suppliers' berries fresh until sale|令来自远方供应商的浆果保鲜到售出时
a shop may pay to keep berries cold only to discard bruised fruit on arrival|商家可能承担了浆果的冷藏费用，收货时却仍得丢弃压伤的果子
the cost of fragile luxuries can exceed the value of adding variety to winter shelves|为了让冬季货架更多样而供应易损奢侈食品，成本可能超出收益

z: the reliability that food trade offers during shortages is worth more than year-round access to every delicacy|短缺时食品贸易提供的稳定保障，比一年四季都能吃到每种美味更有价值

essays.q: 过去人们吃本地的当季食物。如今，人们一年四季都能购买来自世界各地的多种食物。你认为好处大于坏处吗？

excluding local growers|将本地种植户排除在外
year-round access to staple foods|全年都能购买主食
essays.noun2: the transport costs of delicate fruit|运输易损水果的成本

essays.title: 同龄人压力：弊是否大于利
essays.prompt: Young people are often influenced in their behaviours by others in the same age group. Some argue that peer pressure is important while others feel it has distinct disadvantages. Do the disadvantages of peer pressure outweigh the advantages?

pupils are asked to share an embarrassing photograph|有人请学生转发令人难堪的照片
preventing a specific harm differs from demanding conformity over ordinary choices|制止特定伤害不同于要求人在日常选择上盲目从众
friends openly accept a refusal to spend money|朋友们公开表示接受不花钱参加的决定
pressure to pay for acceptance|为了获得接纳而被迫花钱
protecting freedom of choice|保护选择自由
essays.noun2: the price of social acceptance|为获得群体接纳所付的代价

essays.title: 国家间学费承担方式不同与政府支付的利弊
essays.prompt: In some countries, students pay their college or university fees, while in some others, the government pays for them. Do you think the advantages that the government pays the money outweigh the disadvantages?
a: public funding lets a qualified applicant accept a place even when the family cannot pay at enrolment|政府资助使符合条件的申请人即使家里交不起入学费用也能够接受录取
an applicant can qualify academically and still lack the first term's fees|申请人可以达到学术要求却仍交不起第一学期的费用
funded applicants can take up places they would otherwise decline|获得资助的申请人能够接受原本只得拒绝的入学名额
access to training for capable students from families with little cash to spare|让家境拮据且有能力的学生获得培训机会
a wider pool of qualified applicants for jobs such as nursing and teaching|护理、教学等岗位有更多合格人选
the benefit extends to the people those graduates will eventually serve|毕业生日后服务的人群也会因此受益
b: public payment has an opportunity cost when government education budgets are already tight|当政府教育预算已经吃紧时，由财政承担学费会挤占其他教育机会
education authorities|教育主管部门
a budget that protects primary schools as well as universities|一份同时保障小学和大学经费的预算
expand higher education while keeping classrooms properly staffed|在扩大高等教育的同时维持足够的中小学师资
diverting a ministry's entire budget increase to tuition may delay hiring rural teachers|若教育部门把全部新增预算转用于大学学费，就可能推迟招聘乡村教师
the cost may fall on children years away from university|费用可能由离上大学还早的儿童承担
protecting elementary education makes the remaining cost defensible|保障基础教育后，余下的成本就较有理由承担
z: government-paid tuition brings greater benefits if basic schooling still receives adequate funding|只要基础教育仍得到足够经费，政府支付大学学费就利大于弊
waiving fees lets qualified applicants enrol|免除学费能让符合条件的申请人入学
protecting school budgets allows rural schools to hire the teachers they need|保障基础教育预算，则能让乡村学校聘到所需的教师
essays.q: 在有些国家，学生自己支付专科或大学学费；在另一些国家，学费由政府承担。你认为由政府支付学费的好处大于坏处吗？
ask: 政府直接承担学费会怎样改变学生能否入学的决定？
学费支出会挤占哪些公共经费，政府付费为什么仍然值得？
essays.t: government payment of college and university tuition fees|由政府承担专科和大学学费
essays.s: paying tuition from public funds generally brings greater benefits, provided that earlier stages of education retain adequate funding|只要基础教育仍有充足经费，用公共资金支付学费总体上利大于弊
essays.transfer: 题干比较谁支付学费，最能扣题的环节是合格学生收到录取后是否交得起第一学期费用。
r: universal fee subsidies also benefit wealthy households|普惠学费补贴也会惠及富裕家庭
some places would have been filled without assistance|即使没有资助，有些学生原本也能来读书
affluent students occupy a large share of university places|富裕学生占据了很大比例的大学名额
graduates can contribute later once their earnings are known|毕业生可以在收入水平明确后再分担费用
higher-earning graduates contribute through progressive taxation|收入较高的毕业生通过累进税制分担费用
subsidising households that can pay|补贴有能力付费的家庭
public funding at entry|入学时由公共资金付费
essays.stanceSummary: 基础教育经费有保障时，由政府付大学学费更能扩大入学机会
essays.noun2: the claim of basic schooling on public funds|基础教育对公共资金的需求

essays.title: 家庭教育与学校教育
essays.prompt: In some countries, there has been an increase in the number of parents who educate their children themselves at home instead of sending them to school. Do you think the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
a: a parent can adjust the timetable as soon as a child encounters difficulty|家长可以在孩子遇到困难时立即调整学习安排
there is no class of other pupils waiting to start the next chapter|没有一整班其他学生等着开始下一章
a child struggling with fractions can practise cutting objects into equal parts for another morning|不理解分数的孩子可以再花一个早晨练习把物体分成相等的几份
a firmer understanding of division before written exercises begin|在开始书面练习前更扎实地理解除法
the confidence to tackle later mathematics that builds on fractions|应对以分数知识为基础的后续数学内容的信心
this flexibility is especially valuable after a specific gap has been identified|在已经找到某个具体知识漏洞时，这种灵活性尤其宝贵
b: some errors lie outside a parent's expertise, however much time is available|有些错误超出家长的知识范围，即使家长时间充足也如此
parents teaching several advanced subjects|同时教授多门高阶课程的家长
access to specialist teachers or suitable laboratory equipment|获得学科教师帮助或合适实验设备的条件
give useful feedback on practical science work|就科学实验给予有价值的反馈
a teenager testing a chemical sample may need help separating a measurement error from a genuine finding|青少年检测化学样品时，可能需要帮助才能区别测量误差和真实发现
extra practice cannot by itself reveal what caused an unexpected result|单是增加练习并不能揭示异常结果是怎样产生的
schools usually offer specialist teaching that few individual families can match|很少有单个家庭能匹配学校提供的专业教学
z: access to several trained teachers usually outweighs the flexibility of learning at home|能接受多位受训教师的指导，通常比在家学习的灵活性更有价值
a lesson can move at the child's own pace|教学进度可以配合孩子自己的节奏
a science teacher can spot errors that extra practice alone would leave untouched|科学教师却能发现只靠额外练习无法纠正的错误
v: 有机会接受专业教师指导
essays.q: 在有些国家，越来越多的家长选择自己在家教育孩子，而不送他们去学校。你认为这样做的好处大于坏处吗？
ask: 在家授课可以怎样适应一个孩子的学习进度？
家长独自负责课程会漏掉什么，为什么这项困难更难弥补？
essays.t: the growing number of parents choosing to educate their children at home|越来越多家长选择在家教育孩子
essays.s: individual pacing is a genuine benefit, but for most families it is outweighed by limited access to specialist teaching|按个人节奏学习确实有好处，但对大多数家庭而言，难以获得专业学科教学的弊端更大
essays.transfer: 若题目换成小班教学，可以沿用及时发现错误的例子，比较对象要改成教师同时照顾多少学生。
essays.stanceSummary: 在家教学能配合孩子的进度，但多数家庭难以覆盖专业课程
r: families can sometimes match the expertise available at school|有些家庭有时也能提供堪比学校的专业指导
parents can share specialist teaching|家长们可以分担专业科目的教学
a chemist and a language teacher join the same cooperative|一名化学工作者和一名语言教师加入同一个家长合作组
such arrangements depend on skills and schedules that few groups can coordinate|这种安排要求协调不同技能和时间表，很少有团体能长期做到
home educators arrange regular lessons with qualified specialists|在家授课的家长定期安排有资质的专科教师上课
gaps in subject knowledge|学科知识的缺口
school attendance for most children|大多数儿童到校学习
essays.noun2: specialist feedback|专业反馈

essays.title: 机器人承担家务与工作
essays.prompt: Today, there are many tasks at home or work that are done by robots. Is this a positive or negative development?
a: robots are useful for tasks involving the same physical movement repeatedly|机器人适合需要反复做同一身体动作的工作
repeating that movement may take time at home or place a worker under physical strain|重复动作在家中会占用时间，在工作中则可能造成身体负担
a floor-cleaning robot can cover the hallway while a parent prepares an evening meal|当家长准备晚餐时，扫地机器人可以清洁走廊
more time to help a child with homework after dinner|腾出更多饭后时间辅导孩子作业
more manageable household responsibilities for working parents|让在职家长更从容地承担家庭责任
a warehouse worker similarly avoids repeated heavy lifts when a machine transfers cartons between stations|同样，机器在工位之间运送纸箱时，仓库员工就无须反复搬举重物
b: the gains are less evenly shared when a machine takes over most of a worker's former duties|当机器接管员工原先的大部分职责时，好处的分配就不那么均衡了
warehouse workers moving into new roles|转入新岗位的仓库员工
paid time to learn how the new equipment operates|带薪学习新设备操作方法的时间
qualify for the jobs created alongside the machines|达到与机器配套的新岗位的要求
a packer offered supervised practice can learn to check damaged parcels at a sorting station|得到有指导练习的包装工，可以学会在分拣工位检查破损包裹
workers can remain at the site even as their previous duties disappear|即便原有任务消失，劳动者仍能保住在这里的工作
retraining makes the transition worthwhile for employers and workers|再培训能使这场转型对雇主和劳动者都有益
z: automation brings benefits overall when workers gain a credible route into new roles|只要劳动者有切实途径走上新岗位，自动化整体上就有益
robots spare warehouse staff repeated heavy lifts|机器人让仓库员工免于反复搬举重物
supervised practice can prepare those same workers for inspection roles|有人指导的实操练习能帮助这些员工胜任检查岗位
v: 帮助受影响的劳动者接受再培训
essays.q: 如今，家庭和工作场所里的许多任务都由机器人完成。你认为这是一种积极还是消极的发展？
ask: 机器人在家里和工作场所分别替人做了什么，为什么有益？
自动化会怎样影响依赖原有岗位的人，这会改变总体评价吗？
essays.t: the growing use of robots for tasks in the home and workplace|机器人越来越多地承担家务和工作任务
essays.s: robots save household labour and reduce physical strain at work, provided employers help displaced workers retrain|机器人能节省家务劳动、减轻工作的身体负担，前提是雇主帮助受影响的劳动者再培训
essays.transfer: 工作场所的论证可以落在员工转岗上，但这道题还提到家庭，最好也写出一个实际的家务场景。
essays.stanceSummary: 机器人能分担重复劳动，雇主还应帮助受影响的员工转做其他工作
r: robots can create extra supervision work|机器人可能增加监督工作
owners sometimes spend longer freeing machines than cleaning|主人有时花在解救被困机器上的时间比清扫还多
a cleaning robot repeatedly catches on loose rugs|清扫机器人反复被松动的地毯绊住
predictable routes allow robots to work with little intervention|可预期的路线使机器人几乎无须干预就能工作
users clear obstacles and assign robots suitable tasks|使用者移开障碍物，并把合适的任务交给机器人
repeated interruptions|反复中断
automation of routine tasks|将例行任务自动化
essays.noun2: retraining opportunities|再培训机会

essays.title: 网络社交与面对面交往
essays.prompt: Nowadays, more people are choosing to socialize online rather than face to face. Is this a positive or negative development?
a: an online conversation can preserve a friendship when travelling is genuinely impractical|在确实不便出行时，在线交流可以维系一段友谊
old friends may now live in different time zones and rarely have the same evening free|老朋友如今可能住在不同时区，很少能在同一个晚上有空
a nurse coming off a late shift can leave a voice message for a friend overseas|刚下晚班的护士可以给海外的朋友留一条语音
a reply the next morning without either person losing sleep|第二天上午就能收到回复，而且两人都不用熬夜
continued involvement in each other's lives despite the distance|尽管相隔两地，双方仍能持续参与彼此的生活
online contact can preserve a conversation that distance would otherwise prevent|网络可以让原本因相隔遥远而难以发生的交谈得以继续
b: nearby friends can lose opportunities to notice when someone needs support|住得近的朋友可能失去察觉对方需要支持的机会
friends supporting a student through a difficult week|陪伴学生度过艰难一周的朋友
a chance to spend unhurried time together|从容相处一段时间的机会
notice changes that the person has not put into words|察觉对方没有用语言表达出来的变化
over a shared meal, a student might notice a usually talkative friend falling silent and offer quiet company|大家同桌吃饭时，一个学生可能注意到平常健谈的朋友沉默下来，于是安静地陪伴对方
a reassuring message can hide a need that would be apparent in person|一条报平安的消息可能掩盖当面交谈时能察觉的需要
the convenience of messaging rarely replaces that local support|即时消息的方便通常不能弥补这种近距离支持
z: online convenience is a poor trade when it displaces meaningful local contact|如果上网的便利挤占了有意义的本地交往，这种交换就不划算
a voice message can cross time zones|一条语音消息可以跨越时区传递
a shared meal may reveal when a friend needs company|一起吃顿饭，可能让人察觉朋友什么时候需要陪伴
v: 不耽误任何一方的睡眠
essays.q: 如今，越来越多人选择在线社交，而不选择面对面交往。你认为这是一种积极还是消极的发展？
ask: 在线交往在哪些情况下能维系原本很难维持的关系？
如果线上来往取代了本来能实现的见面，具体会失去哪种支持？
essays.t: the choice to socialise online in place of meeting face to face|以在线社交取代面对面交往的选择
essays.s: online contact preserves distant friendships, but replacing possible local meetings is generally a loss|网络让远方的友谊得以维持，但用它取代原本能实现的本地见面通常得不偿失
essays.transfer: 比较对象决定立场：住在国外的朋友原本不能见面，住在附近的朋友却可能因线上聊天而少了一次实际陪伴。
essays.stanceSummary: 线上联络适合异地朋友，但用消息取代能实现的见面会削弱支持
r: online conversation can include friends who struggle in person|在线交流可以让面对面交谈有困难的朋友参与
written messages are easier for some people to follow|对部分人而言，文字消息更容易跟上
several friends speak over one another in a noisy café|几位朋友在嘈杂的咖啡馆里抢着说话
access needs need not determine every meeting between neighbours|照顾参与需求不代表邻居之间每次见面都必须改在线上
friends agree on a suitable format before arranging the next meeting|朋友们在安排下次相聚前先商定合适的交流方式
inaccessible social arrangements|使部分人无法参与的社交安排
face-to-face contact where practicable|条件允许时面对面来往
essays.noun2: opportunities to offer quiet company|给予安静陪伴的机会

essays.title: 网上办理日常事务的隐私
essays.prompt: Today, more people put personal and private information online to do everyday activities such as banking, shopping, and socializing. Is this a positive or negative development?
a: supplying only essential details can make everyday transactions easier|只提交必需资料可以使日常交易更方便
a bank can verify an existing customer's identity before allowing an ordinary bill payment|银行可以先核实已有客户的身份，再允许其缴纳一笔日常账单
a worker on a late shift can pay the electricity bill without visiting a branch during opening hours|上晚班的员工不必在营业时间前往银行网点，也能缴纳电费
more control over routine errands that once had to fit a rigid timetable|更灵活地安排过去必须迁就固定时间的日常事务
continued access to everyday services for people who live far from shops or branches|让远离商店或银行网点的人能够持续获得日常服务
a limited disclosure can solve a concrete problem of access|有限度地提供资料可以解决具体的服务获取难题
b: personal information may outlast the transaction or conversation for which it was shared|个人信息留存的时间可能远远超过原本的交易或交谈
users deciding whether to post a personal photograph|决定是否发布私人照片的用户
control over who may copy or forward it|控制谁可以复制或转发照片的能力
withdraw information later if their circumstances change|在个人情况变化时收回已经公开的信息
deleting a birthday photograph showing a front door cannot recall copies already held by friends|删除一张拍到了家门的生日照片，无法收回朋友已经保存的副本
restricting further access is harder than deleting the original post|阻止他人继续获取资料比删除原帖更困难
lasting loss of control can outweigh a brief convenience|长期失去掌控，可能比短暂便利的影响更大
z: the lasting loss of control generally outweighs the convenience of an individual transaction|信息长期脱离掌控的代价，整体上大于单次交易带来的便利
an online payment saves a trip to the bank|在线支付让人少跑一次银行
a copied photograph may circulate long after its owner removes it|照片一旦被复制，在原主人删帖很久后仍可能继续流传
essays.q: 如今，越来越多的人把私人和个人信息放到网上，以办理银行业务、购物、社交等日常事务。你认为这是一种积极还是消极的发展？
ask: 上传个人信息怎样省去办理日常事务的具体步骤？
完成当次事务后，为什么仍有一部分隐私代价留了下来？
essays.t: sharing personal information online for routine banking, shopping and social activities|为办理日常银行业务、购物和社交而在网上分享个人信息
essays.s: although limited disclosure can make everyday transactions easier, I regard the growing accumulation of private information online as negative overall|虽然有限披露能使日常事务更方便，但总体而言，我认为越来越多私人信息积存在网上是一种负面发展
essays.transfer: 这道题问的是提交个人资料的代价，购物省时只是起点，必须再写使用者实际交出了哪项信息。
essays.stanceSummary: 网上办理事务方便，披露超出所需的资料却会带来持续隐私风险
r: online disclosure gives some customers essential independence|在线提供信息让一些客户能够独立办事
a branch visit may require someone else's assistance|到访网点可能必须请他人帮忙
a customer lives far from accessible transport|一位客户住得离无障碍交通设施很远
one necessary disclosure need not justify indefinite storage|一次必要的信息提供并不足以说明应永久保存这些信息
providers delete details once the transaction is complete|服务方在交易完成后删除有关资料
unnecessary data retention|不必要的数据保留
limits on routine online disclosure|限制日常在线信息披露
essays.noun2: the persistence of shared information|已分享信息持续存在的特点

essays.title: 带家人出国工作对家庭发展的利弊权衡
essays.prompt: These days many people leave their country to work abroad and take their family with them. Do you think benefits of this outweigh disadvantages in terms of family development?
a: moving together lets both parents share daily decisions about their children|一起迁居使父母双方都能参与和孩子有关的日常决定
a parent who is present can share school runs, evening meals and unexpected appointments|共同生活的家长可以分担接送上学、准备晚餐以及临时就诊等事务
one parent can cover a work shift while the other meets a child's teacher|一位家长上班，另一位就能去见孩子的老师
a fairer division of care than a long-distance phone call can provide|比远距离电话联系更均衡的照顾分工
children's trust in parents who are both available day to day|增强孩子对两位日常均能陪伴自己的家长的信任
living together changes how the family works, beyond simply increasing contact|生活在一起不仅增加联系，也改变了家庭的日常分工
b: a move can disrupt a partner's career and a child's schooling|迁居可能打乱伴侣的事业和孩子的学习
families preparing for a move|为迁居做准备的家庭
reliable information about local schools and employment opportunities|关于当地学校和就业机会的可靠信息
plan for everyone's needs before the job begins|在新工作开始前照顾到每个人的需求
a teenager joining school midyear may need language support to follow a science lesson|青少年在学年中途转学，可能需要语言支持才能跟上科学课
sharing an address cannot by itself restore a job or a school friendship|住在同一地址并不会自动找回工作或校园友谊
longer postings give the family time to rebuild disrupted routines|长期派驻让家庭有时间重新建立被打乱的日常安排
z: sharing everyday care can outweigh disruption when each family member has a workable plan|只要每位家人都有可行计划，共同承担日常照护的好处就可能超过迁居的冲击
parents living together can share the school run|共同生活的父母可以分担接送孩子上下学
children taught in an unfamiliar language may need months of extra support|面对不熟悉的授课语言，孩子可能需要好几个月的额外帮助
essays.q: 如今许多人离开本国，到国外工作并带家人同行。从家庭发展的角度看，你认为这样做的好处大于坏处吗？
ask: 家人同行具体保留了哪些共同生活和照顾孩子的机会？
换国家怎样打断孩子和配偶原有的生活，何时仍值得全家搬迁？

essays.title: 商店和餐馆的食物浪费

a teacher could ask every pupil to show the first step of a maths problem on a small board|教师可以让每名学生在小白板上展示一道数学题的第一步
individual answers reveal gaps that neat exercise books can hide|每个人的作答能暴露整齐的练习本可能掩盖的漏洞
the missed step can be retaught before the class moves on|教师可以在全班进入下一步之前重新讲解遗漏的环节
z: breaking lengthy explanations into manageable steps can restore attention when pupils begin to lose the thread|学生开始跟不上时，把冗长讲解分成可应对的小步骤，有助于恢复注意力
a copied answer can conceal a gap in understanding|抄出的答案可能掩盖理解上的缺口
showing the first step makes that gap visible|展示第一步的做法能让这个缺口显现出来
essays.transfer: 若把原因改成睡眠不足，相应措施也要转向作息；分步讲解主要针对的是跟不上课堂。
essays.stanceSummary: 漏听一步容易逐渐走神，分段讲解并及时检查能让学生跟上
r: shorter explanations alone cannot overcome classroom noise|只缩短讲解时间无法克服教室里的噪音
the original instruction may never reach the pupil|孩子可能根本就没听见原来的指令
several groups speak at once|好几个小组同时说话
a written cue remains available after the room falls silent|教室安静后，书面提示依然可以查看
teachers write the first instruction where everyone can see it|教师把第一条指令写在所有人都能看见的位置
missed instructions|错过课堂指令
brief checks on understanding|用简短检查确认理解程度
essays.noun2: immediate classroom feedback|课堂上的即时反馈

essays.title: 老年人使用手机和网络
essays.prompt: Mobile phones and the Internet could have many benefits for old people. However, this age group uses technology the least. What are the benefits for old people of using mobile phones and the Internet? How can we encourage them to use this new technology?
essays.q: 手机和互联网可以为老年人带来许多好处，但这个年龄群体对这些技术的使用最少。老年人使用手机和互联网会有哪些好处？我们怎样鼓励他们使用这些技术？
ask: 能独立完成哪些以前必须出门或委托别人的事？
怎样让初次使用者敢于尝试，并能在别人离开后独立操作？
essays.t: encouraging older adults to use mobile phones and the internet|鼓励老年人使用手机和互联网
essays.s: phones can support independent travel and family contact when beginners practise a task they personally value|如果初学者能练习自己重视的操作，手机就可以帮助他们独立出行并联系家人
a: mobile services give older residents more control over everyday plans|移动服务让老年居民更能自主安排日常活动
a phone can display a revised bus timetable or connect a distant relative|手机可以展示变更后的公交时刻表，也能让人联系远方的亲属
someone can check for a cancellation before making a difficult walk to the bus stop|行动不便的人可以在费力走到车站之前先查看班次是否取消
independent travel without an unnecessary journey|独立安排出行并避免白跑一趟
greater confidence in planning visits without relying on relatives|不依赖亲属就能安排探访的信心
a timetable check can remove a practical obstacle to meeting friends|查看时刻表就可能消除和朋友见面的现实障碍
b: practice on a familiar device makes a first attempt less intimidating|在熟悉的设备上练习能减轻初次尝试的畏难感
older beginners learning to use an app|初次学习使用应用的老年人
repeated practice on their own phone|在自己手机上反复练习的机会
make a call later without somebody guiding each tap|之后自己拨打电话，而不必有人逐步指导如何点按
a library volunteer could help a learner place two video calls and leave an illustrated guide beside the phone|图书馆志愿者可以帮学习者打两次视频电话，并留下一份图文指南
repeating a valued task gives learners a reason to use the device again|重复一项自己重视的任务，会让学习者愿意再次使用设备
learners should control the phone throughout the lesson|学习者应在整个教学过程中亲手操作手机
z: digital tools offer practical independence, and patient instruction can make those benefits attainable|数字工具能提供切实的独立性，而耐心指导能让这些好处真正实现
checking the bus timetable can save a walk|查公交时刻表能省去一趟白跑
an illustrated guide can help someone make the next call unaided|一份图解说明能帮助老人下次自己拨通电话
v: repeated practice on their own phone
在自己的手机上反复练习
essays.transfer: 题目问的是「鼓励使用」，具体写明谁拿着手机实际操作，比只说「多培训」更能解释成效。
essays.stanceSummary: 手机方便出行与联系亲友，让老人用自己的设备反复练习更易上手
r: demonstration alone may not make a phone usable|仅靠演示可能仍不能让手机变得易用
small labels can prevent independent use|过小的标签会妨碍独立操作
a learner cannot read the call button|学习者看不清通话按钮
screen settings can be adjusted on the learner’s own device|可以直接调整学习者本人所用设备的显示设置
volunteers enlarge the text before learners place their own calls|志愿者先将文字放大，再让学习者自己拨号
unreadable phone controls|手机控件难以辨识
personalised digital instruction|提供个性化的数字技能指导
essays.noun2: hands-on practice with a personal device|使用本人设备亲手练习

essays.title: 丢弃旧物与维修再用
essays.prompt: Nowadays, people always throw the old things away when they buy new things, whereas in the past, old things were repaired and used again. What factors cause this phenomenon? What effects does this lead to?
essays.q: 如今人们买新物品时常常把旧物丢掉，而过去旧物会被修理并继续使用。哪些因素造成了这一现象？它会产生什么影响？
ask: 相较于过去，为什么更换坏掉的物品往往比修理容易？
人们不断以换代修怎样影响废物和当地维修能力？
essays.t: replacing household goods instead of repairing them|家庭物品损坏时直接更换而不维修
essays.s: cheap replacements and delays in finding spare parts favour disposal, which wastes materials and weakens repair services|便宜的替代品和寻找零件的耽搁使人倾向于丢弃旧物，从而浪费材料、削弱维修服务
a: a quick replacement can restore an essential household service immediately|迅速更换设备可以马上恢复家庭必需功能
a new kettle may cost little more than a call-out fee, while a matching switch takes days to arrive|新水壶可能只比上门维修费贵一点，而相配的开关却要好几天才能到货
a household can buy another kettle and make breakfast the next morning|一家人可以买另一个水壶，第二天早晨照常做早餐
a normal morning routine without waiting for a technician|无需等待维修人员就能照常安排早晨的生活
greater certainty about the cost and timing of household repairs or replacements|更能预估家电维修或更换的花费与所需时间
saving time and money makes replacement attractive even after a minor fault|即便只是小故障，节省时间和费用也会让换新显得诱人
b: frequent disposal wastes usable parts and undermines local repair workshops|频繁丢弃物品会浪费可用零件，还会削弱本地维修作坊
independent repair workshops|独立维修店
enough regular customers to cover their costs|足够多能帮助覆盖经营成本的常客
pay for staff and spare parts|负担员工和备用零件的开支
if most customers replace faulty lamps, a workshop may stop stocking switches or training apprentices|如果多数顾客遇到台灯故障就换新，维修店可能不再储备开关或培训学徒
losing repair orders reduces the skills available to the whole neighbourhood|维修订单减少，会使整个社区可获得的维修技能减少
disposal has costs even for neighbours who would still prefer repair|即使是仍偏好维修的邻居，也得承担别人频繁丢弃物品带来的代价
z: cheap, quick replacements bring immediate convenience but leave both material waste and fewer repair options|物美价廉、到手快捷的替代品带来眼前便利，却留下材料浪费和更少的维修选择
one faulty switch can send a whole kettle to the bin|一个开关损坏就可能让整台水壶被丢掉
fewer repair orders make the next switch harder to find|维修订单越少，下次再找替换开关就越困难
essays.transfer: 解释长期影响时，可从一盏灯的废弃继续追问：许多家庭都这么做，本地维修店还开得下去吗？
essays.stanceSummary: 替换便宜、零件难找，导致更多整件废弃，也削弱社区维修能力
r: replacement is sometimes the sensible option|更换有时是合理选择
repeated faults make further work uneconomic|故障反复出现时，继续维修并不划算
several expensive components fail together|多个昂贵部件同时失效
one failed switch need not condemn an otherwise working appliance|单个开关损坏并不意味着整台仍可工作的家电都应报废
sellers stock common spare parts and quote repair costs upfront|商家储备常用零件，并提前报出维修费用
unnecessary disposal|不必要的丢弃
keeping repair available for minor faults|让轻微故障仍有维修选择
essays.noun2: the local supply of repair skills|本地维修技能的供给

essays.title: 食品长距离运输
essays.prompt: Today, foods travel thousands of miles from the farm to the consumers. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative trend?
essays.q: 如今，食物从农场到消费者手中往往要运输数千英里。为什么会这样？你认为这是一种积极还是消极的趋势？
ask: 气候、消费者需求和运输条件如何促成长距离供货？
长距离供应带来的保障与运输代价相比，总体如何？
essays.t: long-distance transport of food from farms to consumers|从农田到消费者的长距离食品运输
essays.s: year-round demand and chilled transport encourage trade that is beneficial when it gives communities a reliable food supply|全年消费需求和冷藏运输推动贸易，而在保障社区可靠食品供应时，这种贸易总体有益
a: consumers often expect familiar foods outside the local growing season|消费者在本地产季以外也往往希望买到熟悉的食物
crops ripen at different times, and chilled transport connects distant harvests to shops|各地作物成熟时间不同，冷藏运输使远方收获的农产品能进入商店
retailers can order from another region after nearby farms finish harvesting|附近农场收获结束后，零售商可以向其他地区订货
a steadier supply of basic ingredients throughout the year|全年更稳定的基本食材供应
dependable links between farming regions and urban markets|农业产区与城市市场之间可靠的联系
better transport has made seasonal gaps commercially manageable|更好的运输条件让商家能够应对季节性供应缺口
b: several supply regions can protect a community after a poor harvest|在本地歉收后，多个供应产区可以保障社区粮食供应
communities affected by a failed harvest|遭遇歉收的社区
an alternative source of staple foods|主食的替代供应来源
maintain a steady food supply|维持稳定的食物供应
a town that loses its potato crop after heavy rain could obtain potatoes by rail from an unaffected region|一座城镇若因暴雨损失马铃薯收成，可以通过铁路从未受影响的地区调入马铃薯
a second supplier keeps a staple available when the local crop fails|本地作物歉收时，第二个供应商能让主食继续有货
this protection can justify the transport involved|这种保障足以说明相关运输有其合理性
z: seasonal gaps explain the demand for distant supplies, whose greatest benefit is security during shortages|季节性缺口解释了对外地供应的需求，其最大益处是在短缺时保障供应
a shipment of potatoes can replace a lost harvest|一批外运来的马铃薯能填补本地歉收的缺口
airfreighting food already grown locally offers little comparable benefit|把当地已经出产的食物空运进来则很难带来同等价值
v: an alternative source of staple foods
essays.transfer: 「有更多选择」是较弱的好处；若要作正面判断，可用主食歉收的场景说明运输在什么条件下值得。
essays.stanceSummary: 季节差异和全年需求推动远运，能补足当地食物缺口时总体有益
r: transporting food can impose substantial environmental costs|运输食物可能带来相当大的环境代价
flying perishable goods uses additional fuel|空运易腐货物会额外消耗燃油
comparable produce is already available locally|当地已有同类农产品供应
rail shipments after a failed harvest serve a different need|歉收后通过铁路调运作物，满足的是另一种需求
retailers buy locally in season and reserve imports for shortages|零售商在本地当季采购，出现短缺时再进口
avoidable food transport|可以避免的食品运输
trading food across regions when stocks are scarce|供应不足时在地区之间调运食品
essays.noun2: a dependable alternative food supply|可靠的替代食品供应

essays.title: 大学毕业生失业问题与措施
essays.prompt: A large number of young people cannot find a job when they leave university. What problems will youth unemployment cause for individuals and for society? Give some measures to help reduce unemployment.
essays.q: 大量年轻人大学毕业后找不到工作。青年失业会给个人和社会造成哪些问题？有哪些措施可以帮助降低失业率？
ask: 缺少第一份工作会如何影响毕业生本人，也会怎样波及社会？
什么措施能帮助毕业生跨过「没有经验就进不去」这道门槛？
essays.t: unemployment among recent university graduates|刚毕业的大学生失业
essays.s: losing a first job opportunity delays independence and wastes skills, while paid placements can open a route into work|失去第一份工作的机会会延缓经济独立并浪费技能，而有薪实习能打开就业通道
a: a first job gives a graduate both income and evidence of ability|第一份工作既能给毕业生收入，也能提供能力证明
later vacancies often require a reference describing work that cannot be demonstrated in an examination|日后的岗位常要求提供能说明实际工作的推荐信，而这些工作能力难以通过考试证明
a graduate who completes a real assignment can show an employer what was delivered|完成实际任务的毕业生能向雇主展示自己的交付成果
a fairer assessment at the next interview|在下次面试时获得更公平的评价
financial independence and a better return on society’s investment in training|实现经济独立，并让社会的教育投入获得更好的回报
without a first opportunity, graduates depend on families and employers lose access to trained talent|没有首次就业机会，毕业生仍得依靠家庭，雇主也无法用上受过训练的人才
b: paid entry placements can break this cycle if they offer genuine supervision|只要确有指导，有薪入门岗位就能打破这种循环
graduates from households that cannot subsidise unpaid work|家庭无法负担无薪实习的毕业生
paid opportunities to practise under a supervisor|在指导下获得实践经验的有薪机会
build a record of their work|积累自己的工作履历
a small firm could assign a named mentor and provide a reference listing the tasks a graduate completed|小企业可以指定一名导师，并在推荐信中列出毕业生完成的任务
the next employer can assess actual work alongside academic results|下一位雇主可以把真实工作表现和学业成绩结合起来评估
public support should buy practical experience that leads somewhere|公共资金应支持能够通向后续机会的实践经验
z: graduate unemployment delays earnings and wastes training, so supported placements should lead towards sustained work|毕业生失业会延迟收入、浪费教育投入，因此受资助的岗位应当能通向持续就业
a mentor can document what a graduate has done|导师可以记录毕业生具体完成了哪些工作
a prospective employer then has more to assess than a degree|这样，未来的雇主除了学历之外还有实际成果可供评估
essays.transfer: 第一问点名个人与社会，先写一个人失去工作经验，再解释大量人才闲置如何影响社会。
essays.stanceSummary: 失业损害个人履历并浪费社会人才，有导师的带薪岗位可打破僵局
r: subsidised placements may displace permanent jobs|受补贴的实习可能挤占长期岗位
an employer can replace one trainee with another|雇主可能用下一位实习生替换上一位
successive trainees do exactly the same work|一批接一批的实习生承担完全相同的工作
published hiring outcomes expose firms that offer no progression|公开招聘结果能揭示哪些企业没有后续发展机会
funders require evidence of continuing contracts before renewing support|出资方在续拨经费前要求提供转为长期合同的证据
repeated short-term placements|反复以短期实习轮换用工
supervised routes into paid employment|有指导的有薪就业通道
essays.noun2: paid and supervised entry routes|有薪且有指导的入行途径

essays.title: 年轻人频繁换工作
essays.prompt: More young people in the workforce change their jobs every few years. What are the reasons for this? Do advantages outweigh disadvantages?
essays.q: 越来越多进入职场的年轻人每隔几年就换一份工作。原因是什么？这样做的好处是否大于坏处？
ask: 什么会让年轻员工认为换公司比留任更有发展机会？
新技能和机会是否足以抵消频繁适应、难以深入的代价？
essays.t: young workers changing jobs every few years|年轻劳动者每隔几年换工作
essays.s: limited promotion prospects encourage moves, whose benefits outweigh disruption when each role builds on earlier experience|有限的晋升前景促使人们换工作；当新岗位能延续原有经验时，收益会超过适应新工作的代价
a: moving can give a capable assistant responsibilities unavailable in a small department|换工作能让有能力的助理获得在小部门里得不到的职责
there may be no intermediate role between an assistant and the current manager|助理与现任经理之间可能没有中间职级
a junior employee can accept an offer to manage a small project|初级员工可以接受一个负责小项目的机会
practical experience of setting deadlines and allocating resources|获得设定期限、分配资源的实践经验
a broader career path than the original team can offer|获得比原团队能提供的更宽广的职业路径
a change of employer can fill a gap in the career ladder|更换雇主有时能填补晋升阶梯上的空档
b: a purposeful move can deliver learning that outweighs the adjustment cost|有明确目的的跳槽能够带来超过适应成本的学习收益
young professionals comparing job offers|正在比较工作机会的年轻职场人
a clear idea of the skill they want to develop|对希望培养哪项技能的清楚认识
assess the learning opportunities in a new role|评估新岗位能提供的学习机会
a designer might join a team where she tests her layouts with customers before revising them|设计师可以加入一个让她先邀请顾客测试版式、再进行修改的团队
customer feedback adds a skill that producing layouts alone cannot develop|顾客反馈能帮助培养单靠制图无法获得的能力
a move pays off when the worker can see the new task through|只有员工能把新任务做完，换工作才能真正带来回报
z: moving between employers can advance a young worker’s career when it adds a responsibility worth staying to master|如果跳槽能带来值得留下来学透的新职责，更换雇主便可促进年轻人的职业发展
a designer can learn from testing a layout with customers|设计师可以通过请顾客测试版面来学习
leaving before their feedback arrives cuts that lesson short|在顾客给出反馈之前离开，会让这次学习半途而止
essays.transfer: 利弊权衡要说明衡量标准，这里比较的是一次性的适应成本与能带去下一份工作的长期技能。
essays.stanceSummary: 年轻人换岗争取成长机会，能积累技能时长远收益超过适应成本
r: staying can teach lessons that a new job cannot immediately offer|留在原岗位有时能学到新工作无法马上提供的东西
early departure can hide the outcome of a worker’s own decisions|过早离开可能让员工无从得知自己决策的结果
a project takes several years to mature|项目需要数年才见成效
a worker can plan the move around a meaningful milestone|员工可以围绕有意义的项目节点安排跳槽
employees finish one substantial project before switching roles|员工在转换岗位前完成一个有分量的项目
leaving a project unfinished|项目未完成便离职
purposeful job changes|有明确发展目的的跳槽
essays.noun2: the learning value of a new post|新岗位的学习价值

essays.title: 公共交通费用上涨
essays.prompt: Nowadays the cost of public transport is rising rapidly. Why do you think it is happening? How can this problem be solved?
essays.q: 如今，公共交通费用正在迅速上涨。你认为为什么会发生这种情况？如何解决这个问题？
ask: 运营成本为何会上升，又怎样传导到乘客支付的票价？
怎样控制每趟运营成本，同时维持可负担的票价？
essays.t: rising public transport fares|公共交通票价上涨
essays.s: congestion and energy costs push up fares, so cities should cut delays and make affordable tickets a condition of support|拥堵和能源成本会推高票价，因此城市应减少延误，并把票价可负担设为提供支持的条件
a: paying for an extra bus can preserve a route’s frequency during heavy congestion|在严重拥堵时，加钱投入一辆公交车可以维持线路班次
drivers are paid for time spent in traffic, and each vehicle completes fewer trips per shift|堵在路上的时间仍须支付司机工资，而且每辆车每班能完成的车次变少
an additional driver can cover a departure that would otherwise be cancelled|增加一名司机就能开出一班本来可能取消的车
fewer gaps in the morning timetable|减少早班时刻表中的空档
a more dependable journey to work for regular passengers|使固定乘客的上班行程更可靠
maintaining that service costs money, which explains why operators raise fares|维持这些班次需要额外开支，这也解释了运营商为何提高票价
b: bus priority can reduce the cost of running a reliable service|公交优先通行能降低提供可靠服务的成本
bus operators on congested routes|拥堵线路上的公交运营方
a reliable way through the worst bottlenecks|可靠通过最拥堵路段的办法
maintain an affordable and frequent service|维持票价合理且班次密集的服务
a council could reserve a bus lane at a crowded junction and agree a fare cap in the operating contract|市政部门可以在繁忙路口设置公交专用道，并在运营合同里约定票价上限
a faster trip saves driver time, and the fare agreement passes savings to passengers|行程更快能节约司机工时，票价协议则把节省的开支转为乘客的实惠
priority and pricing should be planned together|应把公交优先与票价安排结合起来
z: reducing avoidable operating costs and protecting affordable tickets addresses both the cause and the burden of fare rises|压缩可避免的运营成本并保障平价车票，能兼顾涨价原因和乘客负担
bus priority helps drivers keep to the published timetable|公交优先有助于司机按公布的时刻表行驶
a fare cap tells passengers the most they can be charged|票价上限让乘客知道一趟车最多会收多少钱
v: 价格可负担且班次密集的服务
essays.transfer: 如果只写「改善公共交通」就会偏离价格；应明确减少了哪一项成本，以及节省怎样传递到票价。
essays.stanceSummary: 堵车抬高运营成本并推涨票价，公交优先和票价约定应配合实施
r: priority lanes cannot solve every cost increase|公交专用道无法解决所有成本上升问题
fuel is still required even on an uncongested route|即使线路畅通，车辆仍需要燃料
energy prices rise across the network|整个公交网络的能源成本都在上升
targeted support can cover a temporary shock without making passengers bear it all|定向支持可以应对暂时的冲击，避免让乘客承担全部代价
councils tie temporary subsidies to a published fare ceiling|市政部门把临时补贴与公开票价上限挂钩
sudden fuel price rises|燃料价格突然上涨
reducing delays and protecting affordable fares|减少延误并保障票价可负担
essays.noun2: affordable fares in operating contracts|在运营合同中保障票价可负担

essays.title: 博物馆吸引本地居民
essays.prompt: Many museums and historical sites are mainly visited by tourists but not local people. Why is this case? What can be done to attract local people.
essays.q: 许多博物馆和历史遗址主要接待的是游客，本地人却很少参观。为什么会这样？可以怎样吸引本地居民？
ask: 为什么同一处展馆或遗址对外地游客有吸引力，本地人却少去？
怎样给去过一次的居民一个具体的重访理由？
essays.t: low local attendance at museums and historical sites|本地居民参观博物馆和历史遗址的比例偏低
essays.s: tourists face a deadline while residents expect familiar exhibits, so changing displays and inviting local contributions can encourage return visits|游客受行程期限限制，而居民预期展品老面孔居多；因此，更新陈列并邀请居民参与能促进重访
a: a first museum visit helps tourists understand an unfamiliar place in limited time|首次参观博物馆能帮游客在有限时间里认识陌生地方
the main exhibits bring objects and local stories together in one building|主要展区把实物和地方故事集中在一座建筑里
travellers can relate a market exhibit to streets they have just visited|游客能够把一项集市展览与自己刚走过的街道联系起来
a better understanding of the town during a short stay|在短暂停留期间更好地理解这座城镇
lasting interest in the history of places seen on holiday|对旅行中见过的地方的历史产生持久兴趣
residents who know the same displays from school trips have less reason to hurry back|居民在学生时代的参观中就熟悉了同一批展品，并没有同样急着重返的理由
b: local contributions can give a familiar venue something new to offer|居民提供的素材可以让熟悉的场馆有新内容可看
residents who have seen the permanent collection|已经看过常设展的居民
something new to discover|值得重新发现的内容
justify spending another afternoon there|觉得值得再花一个下午去参观
a museum could exhibit residents’ photographs of an old market and lead a guided walk to its surviving buildings|博物馆可以展出居民提供的旧集市照片，再带大家步行参观保留下来的建筑
recognising a stall gives someone a reason to invite a neighbour who remembers its owner|认出一个摊位，就有理由邀请还记得摊主的邻居一起参观
a changing display can turn an old building into a regular destination|轮换展览能把老建筑变成值得经常到访的地点
z: tourist deadlines and local familiarity explain the gap, while changing exhibitions can give residents a reason to return|游客的行程期限和居民的熟悉感解释了差异，更新展览则能给居民重返的理由
a familiar market hall may hold little novelty|对居民来说，熟悉的市场大厅也许已缺乏新鲜感
a neighbour's photograph can draw residents back to see it differently|一张邻居拍摄的旧照片却能吸引居民回来，从新的角度看待这里
essays.transfer: 问「吸引本地人」时，一次性的门票优惠还要解释能否促成重访；更新地方展览提供了另一条路径。
essays.stanceSummary: 熟悉常设展使居民缺少重访动机，可邀请居民参与更新本地展览
r: an appealing exhibition can still exclude local workers|即使展览很有吸引力，本地上班族也可能无法参加
the doors may close before their shift ends|场馆可能在他们下班前关门
opening hours suit daytime tourists alone|开放时段只方便白天参观的游客
extending hours on one evening need not alter the whole timetable|固定一个晚上延时开放并不需要改变整套时刻表
museums advertise one regular evening opening|博物馆公布一个固定的晚间开放时段
inconvenient opening times|开放时间不便
inviting local people into heritage venues|吸引当地居民走进文博场馆
essays.noun2: residents’ contributions to temporary exhibitions|居民对临时展览的贡献

essays.title: 西式服装与传统服饰
essays.prompt: In many countries, people now wear western-style dresses such as suits and jeans rather than traditional clothing. Why is this? Is this a positive or negative development?
essays.q: 如今，许多国家的人穿西式服装，例如西装和牛仔裤，取代了传统服饰。原因是什么？你认为这是一种积极还是消极的发展？
ask: 什么工作和购物条件让西式服装成为日常默认选择？
便利性怎样与传统服饰逐渐退出日常生活的代价权衡？
essays.t: the preference for Western-style clothing over traditional dress|比起传统服饰更偏好西式着装
essays.s: widely available suits and jeans meet familiar dress codes, but losing everyday occasions for local dress is harmful|随处可购的西装和牛仔裤符合常见着装规范，但日常穿本地服饰的场合减少总体有害
a: standard clothing makes it easier to meet expectations at work or college|通行款式更容易符合职场或学校的着装期待
a new employee can find a suitable suit in several shops before an interview|新员工可以在面试前从多家店里找到合适的西装
a buyer can wear the same item on several formal occasions|购买者可以在多个正式场合穿同一件衣服
less uncertainty over appropriate dress and lower initial costs|减少对着装是否得体的疑虑，并降低购置开支
a wardrobe that remains useful across different workplaces|置备一套换到不同单位后仍然适用的服装
the trend can therefore reflect practicality rather than a dislike of local styles|因此，这一趋势可能出于实际需要，而不是人们不喜欢本地款式
b: traditional skills become harder to pass on when local dress is rarely worn|传统服饰很少被穿着时，相关技艺就更难传承
craft workers who make traditional garments|制作传统服装的手工艺人
regular orders and opportunities to train apprentices|持续的订单和培养学徒的机会
pass their skills to new workers|将技艺传给新入行的人
a tailor making embroidered waistcoats for weekly gatherings might now receive only one festival order a year|一位曾为每周聚会制作刺绣马甲的裁缝，现在可能每年只接到一笔节庆订单
a surviving costume in a photograph cannot teach an apprentice how to stitch it|照片里留存的服饰无法教会学徒怎样缝制它
losing that craft matters more than wearing jeans on any particular day|比起哪天穿了牛仔裤，相关手艺的消失才是更重要的损失
z: convenience explains the shift, but allowing a living craft to survive only as a festival display is a loss|便利性解释了这种转变，但让仍在实践的手艺只剩节庆展示是一种损失
one suit can be worn to several interviews|一套西装可以穿着参加好几场面试
one festival order a year gives a tailor few opportunities to train apprentices|一年只有一笔节庆订单，裁缝几乎没有机会培养学徒
essays.transfer: 讨论文化流失时，把抽象的「传统消失」落到裁缝订单减少、学徒失去练习机会这两步。
essays.stanceSummary: 西装与牛仔裤易购且合乎职场惯例，完全取代传统穿着会损害手艺
r: standard suits can reduce the cost of changing workplaces|通行的西装能降低转换工作单位的着装成本
workers need not buy a second formal outfit|员工不必再买一套正装
several employers accept the same dress code|多家单位接受相同的着装规范
accepting local formalwear alongside suits preserves that saving|在接纳西装的同时接纳本地正装，仍能保留这项节省
employers recognise either style at interviews and official events|雇主允许在面试和正式活动中选择任一种款式
narrow workplace dress codes|过于单一的职场着装规范
making room for traditional clothing in everyday life|为传统服饰在日常生活中保留空间
essays.noun2: regular demand for locally made clothes|对本地制作服饰的持续需求

essays.title: 城市高层建设与横向扩张
essays.prompt: Some people believe that it is better to live and work in vertical cities. Others, however, think that horizontal cities are better for living and working. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为，居住和工作在以高楼为主、向上发展的城市更好；另一些人则认为，低层建筑为主、向外延展的城市更适合生活和工作。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 高楼集中的街区怎样改变住家与工作地之间的距离？
哪些工作或生活需要地面空间，你会怎样选？
essays.t: the choice between building cities upwards and allowing them to spread out|城市向上建设与向外扩展之间的选择
essays.s: compact cities suit most commuters, while some homes and businesses need ground-level space|紧凑城市适合多数通勤者，有些住宅和商户则需要地面空间
a: putting flats and offices on different floors of the same block can shorten daily journeys|在同一街区的不同楼层设置住宅和办公室，可以缩短日常路程
housing more people near workplaces and childcare can bring several daily stops within one neighbourhood|将更多住宅设在工作地点和托育设施附近，可以让日常出行的几个目的地集中在同一街区
a parent can leave the office and collect a child from a nearby nursery on foot|家长下班后可以步行到附近的托儿所接孩子
evenings less disrupted by long journeys|晚间安排更少受漫长通勤打乱
less dependence on a second family car|家庭对第二辆车的依赖减轻
tall buildings are useful around busy transport stops|繁忙公交站周边适合建设高楼
b: a low-rise district can suit people whose work needs direct access to the street|工作时需要直接通向街道的人更适合低层街区
furniture makers who handle bulky orders|需要搬运大件订单的家具制作者
a workshop with a loading space beside the door|门边有装卸空间的作坊
load finished tables into a delivery van|把做好的桌子装上送货车
a cabinetmaker living above a small ground-floor workshop can unload timber without blocking a shared lift|住在底层小作坊楼上的橱柜工能卸下木材，不必占用共用电梯
some trades depend on moving large deliveries directly between workshop and street|有些行业依赖作坊与街道之间直接装卸大件货物
lower buildings still belong in a compact city|紧凑城市也需要为低层建筑留出空间
z: compact neighbourhoods suit transport hubs, with lower buildings for households needing street-level workspace|交通枢纽适合紧凑街区，需要临街工作空间的家庭则更适合低层建筑
families gain time when childcare is within walking distance|托育设施步行可达时，家庭能省下时间
businesses moving heavy goods gain more from street access|需要搬运重物的商户更受益于临街通道
v: dependence on a second family car
对第二辆家用车的依赖
essays.transfer: 迁移到城市分区题时，把「更便利」落实到谁要往返哪两个地点，再判断分区会缩短还是拉长路程。
essays.stanceSummary: 公交周边宜集中建住宅和办公楼，需要直接临街的用途可用低层
r: adding floors need not shorten a commute|增加楼层未必能缩短通勤
jobs may still be across town|工作地点可能仍在城市另一端
a tower contains only flats|一座高楼只有住宅
location matters more than height alone|选址比单纯追求高度更重要
planners place new flats near existing workplaces|规划者把新住宅设在现有工作场所附近
housing far from jobs|住宅远离就业地点
compact development around transport hubs|在交通枢纽周边建设紧凑街区的做法
essays.noun2: street-level access for local trades|本地手工业所需的临街装卸条件

essays.title: 公共健康：营养食品立法与个人选择责任
essays.prompt: Some people think that public health within a country can be improved by government making laws regarding nutritious food. Others, however, think that health is a matter of personal choice and responsibility. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为政府可以通过制定有关营养食品的法律改善一国的公共健康；另一些人认为健康取决于个人选择，也应由个人负责。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。
ask: 法律怎样改变人们能选到的食物？
个人在日常饮食中还有哪些决定权？
essays.t: food laws and personal responsibility for a country's health|食品法规与个人对国民健康的责任
essays.s: governments should guarantee access to nutritious food while leaving adults free to choose their meals|政府应保障获得营养食物的机会，同时让成年人自由选择餐食
a: food standards are especially useful where people have little say over the menu|人们很难决定菜单时，食品标准尤其有用
a child eating at school depends on what the canteen buys and serves that week|在学校吃饭的孩子能吃什么，取决于食堂那一周采购并供应什么
requiring a vegetable option gives every pupil the chance to try it at lunch|要求提供一道蔬菜菜品，使每名学生都有机会在午餐时尝试
regular opportunities to taste unfamiliar food|经常尝试不熟悉食物的机会
greater willingness to eat a varied diet|更愿意选择多样的饮食
school menus can give pupils choices unavailable at home|学校菜单能给学生提供家中没有的饮食选择
b: individuals still decide what to eat from the options available outside public institutions|在公共机构以外，人们仍会从现有选项中决定吃什么
adults choosing meals for the week|为一周安排餐食的成年人
the time and cooking skills to use fresh ingredients|利用新鲜食材的时间和烹饪技能
turn good intentions into regular home-cooked meals|把良好意愿转化为经常在家做饭的习惯
someone finishing a late shift might prepare tomorrow's lunch in advance rather than rely on whichever takeaway happens to be open|刚下晚班的人可能提前准备次日午餐，省得只能购买碰巧还营业的外卖
working hours influence which meals people can realistically prepare|工作时间会影响人们实际上能准备哪些餐食
public policy should leave room for individual schedules|公共政策应给个人作息安排留出余地
z: governments should set standards where choice is limited and otherwise leave adults room to decide|选择有限时应由政府定标准，其他情况下应为成年人留出决定空间
standards can put vegetables on a school menu|标准能把蔬菜加入学校菜单
daily routines still shape what ends up on an adult's plate|日常作息仍会塑造成年人的饮食
v: 对菜单没有多少发言权
essays.transfer: 迁移到儿童垃圾食品题时，先说谁掌握食堂采购权，再说孩子面对这些选项怎样作选择。
essays.stanceSummary: 政府保障健康饮食条件和公共食品标准，成年人保留日常选择权
r: one nutrition standard can overlook individual needs|同一营养标准可能忽视个体需要
some ingredients are unsuitable for particular diners|某些食材不适合特定用餐者
a child cannot eat the only dish offered|孩子无法食用唯一供应的菜品
a standard can require several suitable options|标准可以要求供应多种合适的菜品

a rigid school menu|学校菜单缺少弹性
basic nutrition standards in schools|在学校实行基本营养标准的做法
essays.noun2: the influence of everyday routines|日常作息对饮食的影响

essays.title: 经济增长消贫饥与环境损害
essays.prompt: Some people say that economic growth is the only way to end world poverty and hunger. However, others say that economic growth is damaging the environment and should be stopped. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人说经济增长是消除全球贫困与饥饿的唯一途径；另一些人则认为，经济增长正在破坏环境，应当让它停止。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 经济增长怎样让人买得起食物，又有哪些人可能受不到帮助？
环境代价为什么会使人主张停止增长，你赞成怎样处理？
essays.t: economic growth as a response to global poverty and hunger|把经济增长作为应对全球贫困与饥饿的途径
essays.s: growth can ease hunger when wages reach poor households, but environmental damage can erase those gains|增长带来的工资若惠及贫困家庭，可以减轻饥饿；环境破坏却可能抵消收获
a: new employment can give families a reliable means of buying enough food between harvests|新增就业能让家庭在两次收获之间有稳定的手段购买足够的食物
a business that processes local crops needs workers even after farmers have finished picking them|加工本地作物的企业即使在农民收割完之后仍需要工人
a seasonal labourer may continue receiving wages through a month when farm work is scarce|在农活稀少的月份，季节工仍可能继续领到工资
regular food purchases without borrowing money|无须借钱也能定期买到食物
greater security between harvests|两次收获之间更有生活保障
growth reduces poverty when new jobs reach the poorest households|当新增岗位真正惠及最贫困家庭时，增长有助于减贫
b: some forms of growth destroy livelihoods and justify calls for limits|某些增长方式会破坏生计，因此有理由限制它们
families living by a river|住在河边的家庭
clean water and a healthy fish population|清洁的水和健康的鱼类种群
earn a living from fishing or feed themselves from their catch|靠捕鱼谋生或用渔获维持饮食
a factory may add to regional output while its untreated waste leaves fishing families with smaller catches|一家工厂也许增加了地区产出，它排出的未经处理废物却让渔民的收获减少
higher industrial output can conceal a loss of food and income|工业产出上升可能掩盖食物和收入的损失
damaging projects should stop and vulnerable households should receive direct aid|应叫停破坏性项目，并向脆弱家庭直接提供援助
z: governments should support growth that improves food security, protect livelihoods and assist those left out|政府应支持有助于粮食保障的增长，保护生计，并援助未能受益的人
a new wage can buy groceries between harvests|新增工资可让家庭在两次收获之间买到食物
a lost fishery can leave another household hungry|渔业资源消失却可能使另一个家庭挨饿
