essays.stanceSummary: 应支持能减贫且保护资源的增长，同时直接援助仍有需要的人
r: closing a polluting plant can deepen poverty|关闭污染工厂可能加剧贫困
local workers lose their wages|当地工人会失去工资
the plant is the town's largest employer|这家工厂是镇上最大的雇主
wage support can protect households during a closure|停工期间的收入补助可以保护家庭
authorities provide temporary income support during retraining|政府在再培训期间提供临时收入支持
sudden job losses|突然失业
limits on growth that destroys local food supplies|限制破坏本地食物供应的经济增长
essays.noun2: the loss of fishing livelihoods|渔业家庭丧失生计的影响

essays.title: 大学教育与人生成功
essays.prompt: Some people think that the best way to become successful in life is to get a university education, whereas others say this is no longer true. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为，获得大学教育是取得人生成功的最佳途径；另一些人认为，如今这种说法已不再成立。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 在什么样的人生目标下，大学教育确有独特价值？
还有哪些成功可以循其他途径取得？
essays.t: the place of a university education in a successful life|大学教育在人生成功中的作用
essays.s: a degree is essential for some ambitions, but meaningful careers can begin elsewhere|有些职业理想离不开大学学位，其他道路也能带来有意义的事业
a: university gives aspiring professionals access to carefully supervised training|大学让未来的专业人员能够接受有严密指导的训练
a nursing course can combine scientific teaching with supervised work on a hospital ward|护理课程可以把科学教学与医院病房里有指导的实习相结合
students learn to explain a procedure to a patient while an experienced nurse observes them|学生在有经验的护士观察下，学习向患者解释一项操作
immediate feedback on a student's explanation|及时得到有关讲解表现的反馈
greater confidence in addressing patients' concerns|更有信心回应患者的顾虑
university training matters when professional judgement affects others|专业判断会影响他人时，大学训练尤为重要
b: success can also mean useful work and independence|成功也可以指从事有价值的工作并实现自主
young people hoping to run neighbourhood businesses|希望经营社区小生意的年轻人
regular contact with customers and the chance to manage small orders|与顾客经常接触、处理小额订单的机会
learn what local people need and how much they will pay|了解当地人需要什么以及愿意支付多少
a bicycle mechanic can begin as an apprentice and later open a workshop that keeps local commuters on the road|自行车维修工可以从当学徒起步，后来开设作坊，帮助附近的通勤者继续骑车出行
a skilled trade can provide both a livelihood and personal fulfilment|一门熟练手艺既能谋生，也能带来个人满足
serving a neighbourhood is a credible measure of career success|服务社区也是衡量职业成功的合理标准
z: a degree serves ambitions requiring advanced study, while independent work can be equally fulfilling|需要深造的职业理想适合通过学位实现，独立从业同样可以令人满足
clinical careers require supervised practice|临床职业要求在指导下进行实践
running a neighbourhood workshop can bring both independence and personal fulfilment|经营街坊里的作坊既能带来自主，也能带来个人满足
v: 个人的成就感与满足感
essays.transfer: 与「毕业后直接就业」题区分开，本题写人生成功，可以把自立、成就感或社区贡献作为明确的衡量标准。
essays.stanceSummary: 大学适合有专业门槛的理想，创造工作和服务社区也可算成功
r: university can keep more career paths open|上大学能保留更多职业选择
one qualification may open several doors|一项学历可能通往多个岗位
two occupations accept the same degree|两种职业都认可同一学位
that flexibility can come at a high price|这种灵活性也可能需要付出高昂代价
apprenticeships offer recognised routes into further study|学徒项目提供获认可的升学途径
choosing a trade early|较早选择手艺行业
apprenticeship as a route to a fulfilling career|通过学徒训练发展有意义职业的道路
essays.noun2: success in skilled trades|手艺行业中的成就

essays.title: 儿童几岁开始上学
essays.prompt: Some people say that children should go to school as young as possible, while others believe that children should not start primary school until they are six or seven-years-old. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为儿童应尽可能早地去上学；另一些人认为孩子应等到六七岁才开始上小学。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 尽早进入学校会给幼儿带来什么？
为什么有人主张推迟正式的小学教学，你会怎样区分两者？
essays.t: the age at which children enter school|儿童开始上学的年龄
essays.s: young children benefit from learning through play, while formal primary lessons can usually wait until six or seven|幼儿能从游戏中学习，正式小学课程通常可以等到六七岁
a: an early start brings children into contact with others outside their families|及早参加共同学习能让儿童接触家庭之外的人
shared games give children a reason to listen, take turns and ask for help in words|共同玩游戏让孩子有理由倾听、轮流行动，并用语言寻求帮助
a child building a tower has to ask another child to pass the next block|搭塔的孩子需要开口请另一个孩子递来下一块积木
short conversations that children start themselves|孩子主动发起的简短对话
greater confidence in a larger class|进入较大班级时更为自信
early contact with peers can be valuable before formal lessons begin|正式课程开始前，尽早接触同龄人也有价值
b: waiting until six or seven can make formal primary lessons more worthwhile|到六七岁再接受正式小学教学可能更有收获
children starting to read and write|开始学习读写的儿童
enough concentration to follow instructions and the hand control needed to form letters|跟随指令所需的专注力和书写字母所需的手部控制能力
complete a classroom writing task without becoming discouraged|在不产生挫败感的情况下完成课堂书写任务
a five-year-old who enjoys telling a story aloud may tire quickly when asked to copy an entire sentence|喜欢口头讲故事的五岁儿童，可能在被要求抄完整句话时很快感到疲倦
children may tell stories fluently before they can write them down|儿童可能已能流畅讲故事，却还无法把它们写下来
play-based early learning and later formal schooling can coexist|游戏式早期学习与稍后开始正式入学可以并行
z: group learning can begin early, while formal primary schooling generally belongs at six or seven|儿童可以较早开始集体学习，正式小学课程通常适合在六七岁开始
shared games give young children a reason to talk|共同玩游戏能给幼儿开口交流的理由
older beginners may find classroom writing less frustrating|年长一些才开始的儿童可能不太容易对课堂书写感到挫败
essays.transfer: 遇到「儿童几岁入学」，要分别写清入学是指集体游戏还是正式读写，两者需要的准备程度不同。
r: delaying formal lessons may frustrate eager beginners|推迟正式课程可能让急于学习的孩子感到挫败
some already want to read and write|一些孩子已经想认字写字了
children regularly choose books during play|孩子在游戏时经常主动选择书籍
reading readiness does not require a full school timetable|已具备阅读能力并不意味着需要完整的学校课表
teachers offer optional reading tasks during play|教师在游戏时间提供可自选的阅读任务
postponing formal instruction|推迟正式教学
a later start to formal primary lessons|稍晚开始正式小学课程的安排
essays.stanceSummary: 幼儿宜及早参加游戏式学习，正式小学课程可等到六七岁
essays.noun2: readiness for formal classroom tasks|儿童完成正式课堂任务的准备程度

essays.title: 广泛学习与深入专攻
essays.prompt: Some people think that older school children should learn a wide range of subjects and develop knowledge. But other people think that they should only learn a small number of subjects in detail. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为高年级中学生应学习多门学科，拓宽知识面；另一些人认为他们只应深入学习少数几门学科。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 广泛学习怎样帮青少年发现兴趣或理解同一问题？
专攻少数科目有什么收获，如何避免过早放弃选择？
essays.t: the breadth of the curriculum for older school pupils|高年级中学生课程的广度
essays.s: older pupils should keep a small common core and study a few subjects in depth|高年级学生应保留少量共同必修课，深入学习几门选定的学科
a: a broad timetable lets teenagers discover abilities before they close doors|广泛接触学科能让青少年在放弃选项之前发现自己的才能
some pupils have little contact with a subject until a teacher gives them a practical task|有些学生直到老师布置实际任务时，才真正接触某一学科
a pupil who enjoys drawing may discover an interest in geometry when designing a room|喜欢绘画的学生在设计房间时可能发现自己对几何感兴趣
choices informed by first-hand experience|以亲身体验为依据的选科决定
more pupils pursuing subjects they genuinely enjoy|更多学生追求真正喜欢的学科
breadth matters while pupils are still discovering their interests|学生还在探索兴趣时，课程广度很重要
b: specialisation lets pupils work through a problem whose solution takes several lessons|专攻让学生能用连续几节课解决同一个问题
pupils designing a science investigation|正在设计科学探究活动的学生
long blocks of time in the same subject|在同一门学科中连续学习的整块时间
test an idea, spot an error and repeat the experiment|检验想法、发现错误并重复实验
a class investigating plant growth may discover that unequal watering spoiled its first trial and need time to repeat it|研究植物生长的班级可能发现浇水不均破坏了第一次试验，需要时间重做
depth gives pupils time to revise a conclusion after testing an idea|深入学习给学生时间在检验想法后修正结论
a balanced timetable must protect time for sustained investigations|均衡的课表也要为持续探究留出时间
z: older pupils need both exploratory subjects and protected time for the interests they develop|高年级学生需要探索不同学科，也需要时间深入发展已发现的兴趣
sampling subjects can uncover an unexpected interest|试学不同学科有机会发现意外的兴趣
a longer investigation gives pupils time to repeat an experiment that went wrong|较长期的探究为学生提供了重做失败实验的时间
essays.transfer: 迁移到大学跨专业选课时，可以沿用「发现兴趣」的逻辑，但应把例子改成专业选择或职业方向。
essays.stanceSummary: 高中保留共同基础课，把其余时间用于少数学科的深入学习
r: a common core can take time from a talented specialist|共同必修课可能占用专长生的时间
a portfolio requires sustained practice|准备作品集需要长期练习
an art college expects several finished pieces|艺术学院要求申请人提交多件成品时
schools can recognise a sustained commitment|学校能够识别长期而明确的投入
pupils can request an exemption with evidence of their work|学生可以凭已有作品申请免修
an inflexible common timetable|缺乏弹性的共同课表
a shared core with room for specialisation|在共同基础上留出专攻空间的课表
essays.noun2: protected time for specialist work|为深入专项学习而保留的时间

essays.title: 升学还是直接工作
essays.prompt: Some people believe that studying at university or college is the best route to a successful career, while others believe that it is better to get a job straight after school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为，读大学或学院是取得职业成功的最佳途径；另一些人认为中学毕业后直接工作更好。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。
ask: 高等教育在哪些职业中提供了难以替代的起点？
直接工作怎样积累职业本领，如何据此选择路径？
essays.t: the choice between higher education and work immediately after school|中学毕业后选择高等教育还是立即就业
essays.s: the better starting point depends on the skills and entry requirements of the chosen career|选择升学还是工作取决于目标职业的技能与入行要求
a: higher education provides a sound foundation for technically demanding careers|高等教育为技术要求较高的职业奠定扎实基础
students can study underlying principles and test their judgments before clients depend on them|学生能在客户开始依赖他们之前，学习基本原理并检验自己的判断
engineering students can compare the strength of several model structures in a laboratory|工程专业学生可以在实验室比较几个结构模型的强度
a clearer understanding of why designs fail under pressure|更清楚地了解设计在重压下失效的原因
safer design decisions later in a career|日后在职业实践中作出更安全的设计决定
complex professional decisions justify time spent studying beforehand|日后要作复杂专业判断，值得先花时间学习
b: early paid work suits occupations learned through repeated customer contact|依靠反复与顾客接触来培养能力的职业，适合尽早参加有薪工作
school leavers entering the hospitality trade|进入酒店接待业的中学毕业生
experience dealing with guests and resolving routine problems|与宾客打交道、解决常见问题的经验
take responsibility for a busy reception desk|负责繁忙的接待前台
a trainee receptionist learns to revise bookings while keeping guests informed about when a room will be ready|前台学员学习更改预订，同时及时告知宾客房间何时可以入住
early employment builds judgement through real conversations with guests|及早就业可以通过真实的宾客交流培养判断力
the training on offer matters more than the name of the route|一条路径能提供什么训练，比它叫什么更重要
z: technical careers may require advanced study, while supervised work can be better preparation for a practical occupation|技术性职业可能要求深造，有人指导的工作则可能更适合为实践型职业做准备
engineering students can test a design before clients depend on it|工程专业学生能在客户依靠设计之前对它进行测试
trainees can learn to handle real guests from their first shift|学员从第一个班次就能学习如何接待真实宾客
essays.transfer: 职业成功题要写清「入行要求」或「晋升所需能力」，再解释大学或直接就业具体提供哪一种条件。
essays.stanceSummary: 专业训练要求高可先上大学，能从岗位实践积累本领可先工作
r: starting work early does not guarantee useful training|早就业并不能保证得到有用的训练
some beginners repeat a single routine task|有些新人只会反复做同一项简单任务
an employer offers no chance to progress|雇主没有提供进阶机会
a structured placement can develop genuine responsibility|有计划的岗位实践可以培养真正承担责任的能力
employers assign a mentor and rotate trainees between tasks|雇主为学员指定导师并安排轮岗
an unstructured first job|缺少培养计划的第一份工作
supervised employment after school|毕业后先接受工作岗位训练的路径
essays.noun2: on-the-job practice with customers|工作中与顾客交往的实践

essays.title: 小组学习与独立学习
essays.prompt: Some people think that it is more effective for students to study in a group while others believe that it is better for them to study alone. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为学生小组学习更有效；另一些人认为独自学习更好。讨论这两种观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 与同伴讨论的哪一步能让人发现误解？
为什么独立练习仍是判断是否真正掌握的必要环节？
essays.t: the effectiveness of learning with classmates or studying alone|与同学共同学习和独自学习的效果
essays.s: students should discuss unfamiliar ideas together and then test their understanding individually|学生应先共同讨论不熟悉的概念，然后独自检验理解
a: explaining an answer to a classmate can reveal a gap that rereading leaves hidden|向同学解释答案能发现重读时仍没注意到的理解缺口
a listener can question the particular step that the speaker took for granted|倾听者能够追问讲解者视为理所当然的那个步骤
two students who obtained different answers can compare their working one line at a time|得到不同答案的两名学生可以逐行比较各自的解题过程
focused discussion of the first disputed step|就第一个有分歧的步骤展开有针对性的讨论
greater care in checking apparently correct answers|对看似正确的答案进行更仔细的核查
group work helps when learners question one another's reasoning|学习者相互追问推理依据时，小组学习能发挥作用
b: quiet individual practice shows whether each student can reproduce the reasoning independently|安静地独自练习能显示每名学生能否独立重现推理
students preparing for an individual examination|准备独立考试的学生
uninterrupted time to attempt unfamiliar questions|尝试解答陌生问题的一段不受打扰的时间
tell which steps they can perform without another person's hints|分辨哪些步骤自己不靠他人提示也能完成
after discussing fractions with friends, a pupil can close the notes and solve a new problem with different numbers|和朋友讨论分数之后，学生可以合上笔记，再独自解决一道使用不同数字的新题
a correct group answer can conceal one learner's uncertainty|小组回答正确，可能掩盖其中一名学生仍有困惑
an independent task should follow the discussion|讨论后应安排一次独立作答
z: discussion can uncover a difficulty, while independent practice shows whether each learner has resolved it|讨论能够暴露困难，独立练习则能检验每位学生是否已经解决问题
classmates can point out a missing step|同学可以指出一道推理中缺失的步骤
a fresh question reveals whether each pupil can now work through it alone|一道新题能说明每位学生是否已经可以独自完成整个过程
v: solve a new problem with different numbers
用不同的数值解答一道新题
essays.transfer: 迁移到远程学习题时，解释平台是否既有同伴追问的机会，又允许学生独立完成一道新题。
essays.stanceSummary: 一起讨论陌生概念，再用独立练习检验每个人的理解
r: discussion may give one confident pupil too much influence|讨论可能让一名自信的学生影响过大
quieter pupils may accept the first answer|比较安静的学生可能直接接受第一个答案
nobody has tried the problem independently|还没有人独立尝试过这道题
initial notes give each pupil something to compare|先写下自己的思路，让每名学生都有可供对照的内容
pupils write a tentative answer before discussing it|学生在讨论前先写一个初步答案
one voice dominating a group|一个人的意见主导小组
combining discussion with individual practice|将讨论与个人练习结合的方式
essays.noun2: individual checks on understanding|对个人理解程度的检验

essays.title: 暴力影视游戏的社会影响
essays.prompt: Films and computer games containing violence are popular. Some people say they have negative effects on society and should be banned. Others say they are just harmless relaxation. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 含暴力内容的电影和电脑游戏很受欢迎。有人认为它们对社会有负面影响，应予禁止；另一些人认为它们只是无害的放松方式。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 哪些限制能够真正减少幼儿意外看到暴力画面的机会，为什么有人会主张禁令？
成年人为什么会把虚构作品当成休闲，如何让年龄限制保留这种选择？
essays.t: limits on violent content in films and computer games|对电影和电脑游戏暴力内容的限制
essays.s: children need protection from distressing material, while informed adults should choose their own entertainment|儿童需要得到保护，免受令人不安的内容影响；知情的成年人应能自行选择娱乐
a: restricting frightening scenes can make shared screens safer for young children|限制恐怖画面有助于保护观看共用屏幕的幼童
young viewers may not recognise that fictional events have been staged|低龄观众未必明白虚构事件是表演出来的
a parent can pick a suitable film before a frightening trailer plays|家长能在恐怖预告播放之前选好适宜影片
calmer family viewing without unexpected images|更平静的家庭观影体验，避免意外画面打扰
greater parental confidence in children's access to films and games|父母对孩子安全接触影视与游戏更有信心
this protection explains why some parents favour a ban|保护孩子的需要解释了部分家长为何支持禁令
b: many adults can treat fictional conflict as an absorbing form of relaxation|许多成年人能把虚构冲突当成一种引人投入的休闲方式
adult viewers and players|成年观众和玩家
clear information about a film or game's content|有关影片或游戏内容的明确信息
choose material that suits their own tastes and limits|选择符合自己喜好与接受范围的作品
friends might choose a detective film for its plot or play a strategy game for the decisions it asks them to make|朋友们可能为了情节选择一部侦探片，或因喜欢作决策而玩一款策略游戏
an interest in a story need not imply approval of the behaviour depicted|对故事感兴趣并不意味着认可其中的行为
targeted age limits can preserve adult choice|有针对性的年龄限制可以保留成年人的选择权
z: age limits should protect children without denying adults access to fictional entertainment|年龄限制应保护儿童，同时保留成年人接触虚构娱乐作品的机会
a frightening scene can distress a child|恐怖场景可能使孩子感到不安
an adult can enjoy the plot without approving of the violence|成年人可以欣赏情节，同时并不认可其中的暴力
v: 一种让人投入的放松方式
自己的喜好与可接受范围
一则可能吓人的预告片
essays.transfer: 碰到「是否全面禁止」时，从低龄儿童的具体困难出发，再论证成年人选择权应否同样受到限制。
essays.stanceSummary: 应保护低龄受众，同时保留成年人选择暴力题材娱乐的自由
r: a simple age rating may fail to protect children|单靠年龄分级可能保护不了孩子
previews can appear before anybody chooses a film|在任何人选定影片前预告就可能出现
a violent trailer starts automatically|含暴力画面的预告自动播放
the preview can be restricted separately|预告片本身可以单独受到限制
services disable such trailers on children's accounts|平台在儿童账户上关闭此类预告
unsolicited exposure to frightening scenes|孩子意外接触恐怖画面
targeted limits in place of a blanket ban|以针对性限制代替全面禁令的办法
essays.noun2: informed adult choice|成年人知情选择的权利

essays.title: 淡水使用与政府管理
essays.prompt: Some people think they have right to use as much fresh water as they want, while others believe government should control the use of fresh water as it is limited resource. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为自己有权随意使用淡水；另一些人认为，淡水是有限资源，政府应该管控其使用。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。

a family caring for several young children may need to wash more clothes and bedding than a single adult|照顾多个幼童的家庭比单身成年人可能需要清洗更多衣物和床上用品
parents can wash extra bedding when a child is ill|孩子生病时，家长能额外清洗床上用品

residents served by the same reservoir|由同一座水库供水的居民
common rules during prolonged dry weather|长时间干旱天气下的共同规则
keep enough water in reserve for cooking and washing|为做饭和洗涤留足水
during a dry summer a town can restrict lawn watering while keeping taps running in homes and clinics|干旱夏季里，城镇可以限制草坪浇水，同时继续为居民和诊所供水
restrictions are easier to defend when they protect essential uses|当限制措施能保障必要用途时，它们更容易得到支持

z: households need freedom over everyday consumption, with public limits on less urgent uses during shortages|家庭应能自行安排日常用水，短缺时期则由政府限制较不紧迫的用途

v: 额外需要清洗的床上用品
essays.transfer: 可迁移到能源配额题，先区分基础生活需求和可延后的用途，再说明资源短缺时谁会受到影响。
essays.stanceSummary: 应保障家庭基本用水，供应紧张时由政府限制可避免的用水
r: outdoor watering restrictions can hurt low-income households|户外浇水限制可能损害低收入家庭
some families grow much of their food|有些家庭的大部分食物是自己种的
a vegetable crop is their main source of fresh produce|所种蔬菜是这个家庭新鲜食材的主要来源
food crops need not be treated like ornamental lawns|粮菜作物和观赏草坪可以区别对待
councils permit limited watering of food crops|地方政府允许为食用作物限量浇水
uniform restrictions on outdoor water use|对户外用水作统一限制
temporary controls on non-essential water use|临时管控非必要用水的做法
essays.noun2: public protection of essential water supplies|由公共管理保障基本供水

essays.title: 经济发展与清洁环境
essays.prompt: Some people think that it is possible for a country to be both economically successful and have a clean environment. Others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为一个国家可以同时实现经济繁荣和保持清洁的环境；另一些人不同意。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。

essays.t: economic success alongside a clean environment|经济繁荣与保持环境清洁能否兼得

a factory that reuses water buys less fresh water and produces less wastewater|循环用水的工厂购入的新水更少，产生的废水也更少
water can serve several production batches before treatment|一批水在处理前可以用于多个生产批次
continued production with lower water bills|在水费降低的情况下持续生产
cleaner rivers alongside competitive local businesses|河流更清洁，同时本地企业保持竞争力
one investment can advance both goals where industrial water demand is high|在工业用水需求高的地方，一项投资就能同时推进这两个目标
b: expensive changes can initially threaten jobs in smaller firms|昂贵的改造起初可能威胁小企业的岗位
small manufacturers with narrow profit margins|利润空间微薄的小型制造商
affordable finance and time to install cleaner equipment|可负担的融资以及安装更清洁设备所需的时间
meet a new standard while retaining all their workers|在保留全部员工的同时达到新标准

equipment must be paid for before its savings arrive|设备必须先付款，节省的成本要到后来才能体现
phased deadlines and access to credit can ease that conflict|分阶段的期限与获得信贷的渠道可以缓解冲突
z: a cleaner economy is achievable when policy takes transition costs and environmental risks seriously|政策充分考虑转型成本和环境风险时，清洁且繁荣的经济可以实现
reusing water can lower a factory's bills and reduce discharge|循环用水既能降低工厂水费，也能减少排放
small firms need finance before those savings arrive|小企业在节省这些成本之前需要先获得资金
essays.transfer: 迁移到环保规定与就业题时，说明改造费何时支出、节省的费用何时出现，短期和长期判断可能不同。
essays.stanceSummary: 给企业足够的时间和改造支持，经济繁荣与清洁环境可以兼得

a plant threatens a town's only water source|一家工厂威胁城镇唯一的水源
workers can receive support during a temporary closure|暂时停工期间可以向工人提供支持

strict deadlines for urgent repairs|对紧急修复设定的严格期限
a transition that protects both livelihoods and water quality|同时保护生计与水质的转型
essays.noun2: transition costs for smaller employers|小型雇主的转型成本

essays.title: 工作中的社交生活
essays.prompt: Some people think a job not only provides income but also a social life. Others think it is better to develop a social life with people you do not work with. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

shared breaks provide repeated, low-pressure opportunities for conversation|共同休息让人们反复有机会轻松交谈

employees who want to switch off after work|希望下班后能放松、暂时摆脱工作状态的员工
friends with interests unrelated to their workplace|兴趣与自己工作无关的朋友
spend an evening without returning to the same office concerns|度过一个无须再次谈论同样办公烦恼的夜晚
a junior accountant who plays football with neighbours can enjoy the match without worrying about a manager's opinion|初级会计与邻居踢球时可以享受比赛，无须总想着经理会怎么评价他
neighbours can meet on more equal terms than a manager and junior employee|邻里之间往往能比经理和初级员工更平等地交往

essays.stanceSummary: 同事可以成为真朋友，工作以外的朋友圈能让社交生活更均衡
r: two active social circles can be difficult to maintain|两个活跃的社交圈有时难以同时维持

essays.title: 科技发展与犯罪
essays.prompt: Some people think technological development can reduce crime, while others think it actually encourages crime. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为技术发展可以减少犯罪；另一些人认为技术进步实际上会助长犯罪。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 某种技术怎样在具体地点减少作案机会？

recordings can show where an incident happened when no witness saw it clearly|目击者没有看清时，录像可以显示事件发生的位置
staff can identify when and where a bicycle was reported stolen|工作人员可以确认某起报案中的自行车盗窃发生的时间和地点
better deployment of patrol staff|更合理地调派巡查人员
better protection at locations with repeated thefts|让反复发生盗窃的地点获得更好的保护
information helps when staff can act on it|当工作人员能据此行动时，信息才会发挥作用
b: new communication services also allow dishonest requests for money to reach more people|新通信服务也使欺骗性索款消息能够触达更多人
people receiving an unexpected request for payment|意外收到付款请求的人
a trusted way to check who sent the request|核实请求来自谁的可信方式
distinguish a genuine request from a dishonest one|区分真实请求与欺骗性请求

essays.title: 廉价航空与环境成本
essays.prompt: Cheap air travel should be encouraged because it gives ordinary people freedom to travel further. essays.q: 有人主张鼓励廉价航空，因为普通人能借此自由地前往更远的地方。另一些人认为，这会带来环境问题，因此应提高航空出行的价格以减少乘机。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。

a cheaper unsweetened option in the same shop|同一家商店中更便宜的无糖选择

essays.transfer: 迁移到公共交通补贴题时，同样先写家庭预算会怎样改变，再比较「替代选择变便宜」和「原选择变贵」的不同作用。

r: a sugar tax can improve the products themselves|糖税可能促使产品本身得到改进
changing a recipe can cost less than raising prices|调整配方有时比涨价损失更小
the tax depends on sugar content|税额取决于含糖量
reformulation still leaves some families unable to afford fruit|调整配方仍不能让部分家庭买得起水果
governments combine targeted taxes with produce discounts|政府把针对性税收与果蔬优惠相结合
relying on price penalties alone|单靠提高不健康食品价格
priority for affordable fruit and vegetables|优先保障果蔬价格可负担的做法
essays.noun2: affordable substitutes for taxed products|对被征税产品而言价格可负担的替代品

essays.title: 退休后个人自助或政府财务援助
essays.prompt: Some think individuals should support themselves after retirement, while others believe the government should be responsible for providing them with financial assistance. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为个人应在退休后自给自足；另一些人认为政府有责任向退休者提供经济援助。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 为什么主张能储蓄的人应为退休生活作准备？
哪些人在工作一生后仍难以自给，政府应承担多少责任？
essays.t: personal provision and public financial support in retirement|退休生活中的个人准备与政府经济援助
essays.s: the state should guarantee a basic retirement income, while households with spare earnings should save for additional needs|国家应保障基本退休收入，有余钱的家庭则应为额外需要作储蓄
a: saving from a regular wage gives people more control over retirement|从稳定的工资中储蓄，使人们更能自主安排退休生活
setting money aside creates a fund for spending beyond basic needs|留出积蓄能为基本需求之外的开支建立资金来源
retirees can draw on these savings to visit relatives|退休者可动用这些积蓄探亲
more freedom to make personal plans|更自由地安排个人计划
less reliance on public funds for optional expenses|在非必要开支上较少依赖公共资金
people who can save should prepare for these costs|有储蓄能力的人应为这些开支作准备
b: some people reach retirement without adequate savings for reasons beyond their control|有些人由于无法自行掌控的原因，在退休时缺少充足积蓄
older people who spent years providing unpaid family care|曾多年无偿照顾家人的老年人
a basic public pension or another reliable source of income|基本公共养老金或其他可靠收入来源
meet continuing expenses when they can no longer earn a wage|在不再能领取工资时负担持续产生的开支
a woman who left paid work to care for a disabled relative might reach retirement with very little saved|一名为了照料残障亲属而离开有薪工作的女性，可能在退休时积蓄很少
small savings can reflect years of valuable unpaid work|积蓄很少可能是长期从事有价值的无偿劳动所致
a basic pension protects people who had little opportunity to save|基本养老金能保护那些过去几乎没有机会储蓄的人
z: the state should guarantee essentials while individuals save what they can for greater choice in retirement|国家应保障基本生活，个人则应量力储蓄，以便退休后有更多选择
savings can cover a visit to relatives|储蓄可以支付一次探亲的费用
a public pension can cover essentials for someone who spent years caring for family|公共养老金能保障多年照顾家人的人支付基本开支
essays.transfer: 迁移到个人应否承担大学学费题时，先区分基本保障和可自选支出，再说明不同家庭实际承担费用的能力。
essays.stanceSummary: 政府保障退休者的基本收入，个人可用储蓄补充额外需要
r: public assistance can weaken the incentive to save|公共补助可能削弱储蓄动力
small savings may bring no net gain|少量储蓄可能无法增加实际可用收入
each pound saved means a pound less in assistance|每存一英镑补助就少一英镑
support need not disappear all at once|补助无须一下子取消
governments reduce benefits gradually as savings rise|政府随着储蓄增加逐步下调补助
abrupt withdrawals of assistance|骤然撤回补助
a guaranteed minimum income in retirement|退休后有最低收入保障的安排
essays.noun2: income protection for unpaid carers|为无偿照护者提供收入保障

essays.title: 医疗和教育费用的政府承担
essays.prompt: Some people think the government should pay for health care and education, but other people think it is not the government's responsibility. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为政府应支付医疗和教育费用；另一些人认为这并非政府的责任。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。
ask: 公共付费怎样影响一个家庭同时获得医疗和教育的机会？
为什么有人主张由使用者付费，你把公共责任的界线划在哪里？
essays.t: government responsibility for the cost of health care and education|政府承担医疗和教育费用的责任
essays.s: governments should fund essential health care and basic education, while users pay for optional extras|政府应资助基本医疗和基础教育，额外选项由使用者付费
a: public funding can keep both treatment and schooling accessible to a family in difficulty|公共拨款能让处于困境的家庭同时获得医疗和教育
medical bills and school fees can fall due in the same month|医疗账单和学费可能在同一个月到期
parents can arrange treatment without spending money set aside for school|家长能安排治疗而不动用为学业预留的钱
an uninterrupted return to class after treatment|治疗后可以顺利返校而不再中断上学
fewer educational opportunities lost to family illness|因家庭成员患病而失去的受教育机会减少
public funding prevents one urgent bill from disrupting both services|公共拨款可避免一笔急需支付的账单同时影响两种服务
b: charging for personal preferences can keep public money available for essentials|让个人偏好产生的开支由个人负担，可保留公共资金用于基本需求
patients and learners who want additional services|希望得到额外服务的患者和学习者
a clear price for each optional service|每项可选服务的明确价格
weigh the value of an optional service against its price|权衡一项可选服务的价值与价格
a hospital can offer treatment in a standard ward while charging someone who requests a private room|医院可以在普通病房提供治疗，同时向要求住单人间的人收取费用
privacy is an extra benefit separate from essential treatment|病房隐私是基本治疗之外的额外好处
optional tutoring can be distinguished from basic schooling in the same way|同样也能区分自选辅导与基础教育
z: public funds should cover necessary treatment and schooling, with personal payment for extras chosen for comfort|公共资金应承担必要治疗和上学费用，为舒适而选的额外服务由个人付费
public funding keeps clinics and classrooms accessible|公共拨款使人们能使用诊所和教室
personal budgets can cover private rooms and optional tutoring|个人预算可以支付单人病房和自选辅导
v: 需要另行选择的额外服务
essays.transfer: 审题时把医疗和教育都圈出来，两个领域都要有例子或对应说明，避免全文只讨论医保。
essays.stance: 双边·支持基本公共付费
essays.stanceSummary: 政府应承担基本医疗和基础教育费用，可选额外服务由个人付费
r: some apparent extras meet genuine needs|某些看似可选的服务确实满足必要需求
ordinary lessons may be impossible without extra teaching|没有额外补课可能无法跟上常规教学
a child misses a term through illness|孩子因病错过一个学期
targeted catch-up provision can meet this need|有针对性的补课支持能满足这种需要
schools fund catch-up lessons after long absences|学校为长期缺课后的补课提供经费
rigid definitions of optional tuition|对自选辅导过于僵硬的界定
public funding focused on essential services|把公共资金用于基本服务的做法
essays.noun2: the distinction between care and comfort|基本照护与额外舒适之间的区分

essays.title: 艺术与健康教育公共预算
essays.prompt: In many countries, the government likes to spend more money on the arts. Some people agree with this. However, others think government should spend more on health and education. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
essays.q: 在许多国家，政府倾向于把更多经费投入艺术。有人赞成；另一些人则认为政府应把更多钱花在医疗和教育上。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。
ask: 公共资助为何能让一些艺术活动真正发生？
医疗或教育存在急迫缺口时，新增预算应先投给谁？
essays.t: public spending on the arts, health and education|艺术、医疗和教育领域的公共开支
essays.s: arts funding should continue, but essential health and education services should receive extra money where staff are scarce|应继续资助艺术；若医疗和教育缺人，新增资金应优先投入这些基本服务
a: a public grant keeps local art accessible to people on limited budgets|公共补助让预算有限的人也能接触本地艺术
a theatre must pay performers and rent a venue before selling tickets|剧院在售票前就要支付演员报酬并租用场地
a small company can stage a play in a local language at affordable ticket prices|小剧团可以用本地语言上演一出戏，并以可承受的价格售票
regular performances for audiences rarely served by commercial theatre|为商业剧场很少照顾到的观众提供定期演出的条件
a living tradition that younger performers can learn|能由年轻演员学习传承的活传统
ticket sales alone might not sustain this work|仅靠票房也许难以维持这种创作
b: vacancies in schools and clinics may give them first claim on extra funds|当学校和诊所岗位空缺时，新增资金可能应先投给它们
local authorities responsible for schools and clinics|负责学校和诊所的地方政府部门
enough qualified staff to cover each day|足以维持每日运作的合格人员
keep classes running and offer patients appointments within a reasonable time|维持正常教学，并让患者在合理时间内获得预约
funding a vacant teaching post can stop two classes from being combined whenever a teacher is absent|为一个空缺教师岗位提供经费，能避免每当教师缺勤时就要把两个班合并
filling one teaching post can protect several classes from repeated disruption|补充一个教师岗位能避免好几个班的教学反复中断
an identified gap in a basic service deserves priority|基本服务中已经查明的缺口应获优先处理
z: arts funding should be stable, with extra money going first to urgent staffing gaps in essential services|艺术资助应保持稳定，新增资金应先填补基本服务中的紧迫人手缺口
a small grant can keep a local theatre open|小额补助就能让当地一家剧院继续开门
filling a vacant nursing post can meet a more urgent need|补充一个空缺护理岗位可以满足更紧迫的需要
v: 优先获得新增资金的资格
essays.transfer: 这种预算比较题要说明争的是现有经费还是新增经费，并指出若钱投向另一处，哪个具体缺口会继续存在。
essays.stanceSummary: 保留适度艺术预算，但若缺教师或医护，新增经费应先补缺口
r: even a small arts cut can cause an irreversible loss|即使只削减少量艺术经费也可能带来无法挽回的损失
a troupe could lose its only rehearsal room|一个剧团可能失去唯一的排练室
the lease is about to expire|租约即将到期
a short grant can prevent that loss|短期补助可以避免这种损失
councils protect threatened groups with modest bridging grants|地方政府用少量过渡补助保护濒临解散的团体
an abrupt cut in arts support|突然削减艺术支持
priority for urgent health and education needs|优先满足紧迫的医疗和教育需求
essays.noun2: staffing gaps in essential services|基本服务的人手缺口

essays.title: 博物馆的娱乐与教育功能
essays.prompt: Some people think museums should be enjoyable places to attract and entertain young people. Others think the purpose of museums is to educate, not to entertain. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为博物馆应当让人享受参观，以吸引和娱乐年轻人；另一些人则认为博物馆的目的是教育，而非娱乐。讨论双方观点，并给出你自己的看法。
ask: 有趣的体验能让年轻访客多做哪一步？
怎样让这一步产生学习，而不只留下好玩的印象？
essays.t: the educational and recreational roles of museums for young visitors|博物馆面向年轻参观者时的教育和娱乐功能
essays.s: museums should use enjoyable activities to draw young people towards something worth learning|博物馆应通过有趣的活动吸引年轻人学习有价值的内容
a: an enjoyable task invites visitors to stop at objects they might overlook|有趣的任务能让游客在原本可能略过的展品前驻足
turning a handle can give a child a question to investigate|转动手柄能使孩子产生一个值得亲自探究的问题
a young visitor can test two model waterwheels with different blades|年轻访客可测试叶片不同的两个水轮模型
closer comparison of the effort each wheel requires|更仔细地比较转动两个水轮各需要多大力气
greater curiosity about the collection beyond the display|对互动展台以外的馆藏产生更大的好奇心
enjoyment can earn an exhibit the attention that learning requires|乐趣能为展品赢得学习所需的注意力
b: a museum still has a duty to explain why its objects matter and what evidence they provide|博物馆仍有责任说明展品为何重要，以及它们提供哪些证据
young visitors using an interactive display|正在使用互动展台的年轻访客
a clear link between the activity and an original object|互动活动与一件展品原件之间的清晰联系
understand what the activity reveals about people in the past|理解活动揭示的过去人们的生活情况
a label beside the models can show which wheel a village mill used and how it helped grind grain|模型旁的说明可以展示村中磨坊使用哪种水轮，以及它如何帮助磨谷物
the label connects a physical experience to the mill's history|说明文字将亲身体验与磨坊的历史联系起来
interactive play earns its place by making the collection easier to understand|互动游戏因帮助人们理解馆藏而值得保留
z: learning should determine what a museum shows, while enjoyment can encourage young people to explore it|教育目标应决定博物馆展示什么，乐趣则能鼓励年轻人深入探索
a working model invites a child to experiment|能够运作的模型吸引孩子亲自试验
a mill exhibit can show how the wheel helped grind grain|磨坊展品可以展示水轮怎样帮助磨谷物
v: 转动每个水轮所需的力气
essays.transfer: 迁移到课堂游戏题时，写清游戏里的哪一个动作或观察对应哪一个知识点，再判断其教育价值。
r: too much explanation can put young visitors off|过多讲解可能让年轻参观者失去兴趣
lengthy instructions delay the chance to experiment|冗长说明推迟了动手尝试的机会
children must read a full panel before touching a model|孩子触碰模型前必须读完一整块展板
a short question after play can focus attention|体验后一个简短问题也能引导注意力
curators place brief prompts beside working models|策展人在可操作模型旁放置简短提示
overloading visitors with explanations|向参观者灌输过多讲解
learning as the guiding purpose of museum design|以学习指导博物馆展陈设计的做法
essays.stanceSummary: 馆藏的教育价值决定展示内容，趣味活动帮助年轻人接近展品
essays.noun2: the educational purpose of a hands-on exhibit|互动展品的教育目的

essays.title: 进口影视与本土制作
essays.prompt: Some people think that it is good for a country’s culture to import foreign movies and TV programmes. Others think that it is better to produce these locally. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essays.q: 有人认为，进口外国电影和电视节目对一个国家的文化有好处；另一些人认为，在本地制作这些作品更好。讨论双方观点，并给出你的看法。
ask: 进口影视怎样影响观众理解其他生活方式？
本土制作能保留哪些进口作品难以提供的文化内容？
essays.t: importing foreign films and television or producing them locally|进口外国影视作品与在本地制作影视作品的选择
essays.s: a country should welcome foreign programmes while giving local producers room to tell their own stories|一个国家应欢迎海外节目，同时给本地制作人讲述自己故事的空间
a: foreign films introduce audiences to everyday customs beyond their own experience|外国电影让观众了解自身经历以外的生活习俗
characters can reveal different attitudes within one family celebration|同一次家庭庆祝活动中的不同人物可以展现不同态度
viewers can compare the preparations on screen with a celebration at home|观众可将银幕上的准备过程与自己家乡的庆祝方式作比较
conversations about the reasons behind familiar customs|围绕熟悉习俗背后的缘由展开交流
a greater willingness to question assumptions about other cultures|更愿意反思对其他文化习以为常的看法
imported programmes can prompt people to reconsider familiar traditions|进口节目可促使人们重新审视熟悉的传统
b: local production gives communities control over which details appear on screen and how they are presented|本地制作能让社区掌控哪些细节出现在银幕上以及如何呈现
writers and performers from a small language community|来自较小语言社群的编剧与表演者
opportunities to make programmes in their own language|用自己的语言制作节目的机会
share local humour and expressions with younger audiences|向年轻观众分享本地幽默和表达方式
a comedy about neighbours can use a familiar dialect whose jokes would lose much of their meaning in translation|一部讲邻里故事的喜剧可以使用大家熟悉的方言，方言笑话在翻译中往往大幅失去原意
local productions can preserve cultural details that imported stories seldom explore|本地制作可以保留进口作品很少探究的文化细节
broadcasters should reserve space for domestic voices alongside imports|播出机构应在引进海外作品的同时为本土声音保留空间
z: broadcasters should combine imports with local work whose language and humour deserve to be heard|播出机构宜把进口节目与语言、幽默值得被听见的本地作品结合起来
imported dramas introduce unfamiliar customs|进口剧集可以介绍观众不熟悉的习俗
local comedy preserves humour that depends on a particular dialect|本地喜剧保留了依赖特定方言才能理解的幽默
v: lose much of their meaning in translation
在翻译中大幅失去原意
essays.transfer: 迁移到全球化与文化认同题时，举出一种具体的本土表达，再解释谁有机会让它持续被听见。
essays.stanceSummary: 进口影视让人接触异国生活，本地制作让社区自己讲述故事
r: supporting local drama can reduce variety|扶持本地剧集可能减少节目多样性
one series can absorb a small broadcaster's budget|一部连载剧就可能耗去小型播出机构的预算
every programme must be made locally|每个节目都必须本地制作
selective commissions still leave room for imports|有选择地委托制作仍能为引进节目留出空间
broadcasters commission local stories missing from imported schedules|播出机构优先委托创作引进节目中缺少的本地故事
an all-domestic schedule|所有节目均为本地制作的播出安排
a mix of foreign and local programmes|兼顾海外节目与本地制作的安排
essays.noun2: local productions in less widely spoken languages|使用较少人使用的语言制作的本地作品

charts.title: 四款手机套餐的月费变化
charts.prompt: The chart below shows the average monthly contract cost for four different mobile phones in a European country from January to September 2002, measured in euros. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
charts.promptZh: 折线图展示某欧洲国家四款手机套餐在 2002 年 1 月至 9 月的平均月费，单位为欧元。概述主要特征，并在适当处进行比较。

sentences.fill: how much customers in one European country paid per month for each of four mobile phone contracts from January to September 2002
sentences.zh: 折线图比较了 2002 年 1 至 9 月某欧洲国家四款手机套餐的月费。

sentences.fill: Domo was the most expensive option for the first eight months, but Alpha overtook it in September
sentences.zh: Domo 前八个月最贵，9 月被 Alpha 超过。

sentences.fill: Sim TX ended slightly cheaper than it had started, whereas each of the other three contracts finished at a higher price
sentences.zh: Sim TX 的期末月费略低于期初，其余三个套餐均高于期初。

sentences.full: Upon closer inspection, it is readily apparent that {}.
sentences.fill: Domo started at €15, reached €20 in May and June and then peaked at €25 in July before dropping slightly
sentences.zh: Domo 从 15 欧元起步，五六月为 20 欧元，7 月达到 25 欧元的峰值后略有回落。

sentences.fill: Alpha cost only €5 in January and again in June, but rose to €10 in July and €13 in August
sentences.zh: Alpha 一月和六月均只需 5 欧元，七月涨至 10 欧元，八月为 13 欧元。

sentences.fill: it jumped to €25, while Domo slipped to €23, leaving a gap of just €2 between them
sentences.zh: 9 月 Alpha 跃升至 25 欧元，Domo 降至 23 欧元，两者相差 2 欧元。

sentences.full: Equally noteworthy is the fact that {}.
sentences.fill: Lex rose from €12 to €18 despite a fall early in the year and a small dip in June
sentences.zh: Lex 虽然年初回落、六月也略降，总体仍由 12 涨到 18 欧元。

sentences.fill: Sim TX reached its highest price of €14 in June before dropping to €8, the lowest September figure
